izzyondroid:chromahub.rhythm.app.summary: Your Music, Your Rhythm - Privacy-first player with Material 3 design.
izzyondroid:chromahub.rhythm.app.description:
Your Music, Your Rhythm
 Experience your music collection like never before. Rhythm is a beautiful, open-source Material You music player built for audiophiles, supporting both local and streaming playback. Enjoy high-quality audio with zero tracking and absolutely no ads.
 🔊 Audiophile-Grade Sound * High-Res Audio: Preserves native sample rates and bit depths for pure, unaltered sound. * Advanced EQ: Perfect your audio with a 10-band equalizer and over 6,000 AutoEQ presets tailored to your specific headphones. * Premium Playback: Enjoy true gapless playback and support for all major formats (FLAC, ALAC, Opus, WAV, MP3, OGG, and Dolby Atmos/EAC3-JOC).
 🎨 Gorgeous Material 3 Design * Dynamic Colors: The app's theme adapts beautifully to your wallpaper (Android 12+) and the current album artwork. * Fluid UI: Experience expressive shapes, smooth animations, and an immersive, distraction-free lyrics view. * Responsive Widgets: Control your music straight from your home screen with modern Material 3 layouts.
 📚 Smart Library & Lyrics * Dual-Mode Playback: Seamlessly switch between your local music library and streaming servers (Subsonic, Navidrome, Jellyfin). * Synced Lyrics: Sing along with word-by-word highlighting via LRCLib, or use the local editor for custom offsets. * Ultimate Organization: Browse by Songs, Liked, Playlists, Albums, Artists, Album Artists, Dates, or the folder Explorer. * Multi-Select Power: Manage your queue, share, or delete multiple tracks at once with batch actions. * Reliable Scanning: A full-scan media scanner ensures no songs are ever missed, with configurable allowed formats.
 ⚙️ Feature-Packed * Rhythm Guard: Integrated hearing safety system with age-aware volume protection. * Built-in metadata editor with artwork integration from Deezer and YouTube Music. * Sleep timer, playback statistics, and stability tools for a crash-free experience. * Easy queue management and M3U playlist import/export. * In-app auto-updates directly from GitHub.
 🔒 100% Private Rhythm respects your data. There are no ads, no analytics, and no accounts required. It is completely offline-capable and proudly open-source (GPL v3).

izzyondroid:com.shayan.firewall.name: FireWall Blocks
izzyondroid:com.shayan.firewall.summary: Simple, open-source firewall blocking internet access via Shizuku or VPN.
izzyondroid:com.shayan.firewall.description:
FireWall Blocks is a simple, open-source Android firewall that blocks app internet access using either Shizuku or a local VPN, with no root requirement.
 Features:
 Dual Mode: Choose between the efficient Shizuku mode (recommended) or the no-setup-required VPN mode. You can even use them at the same time!
 Network Monitoring Screen: Real-time traffic tracking via local VPN. See which apps are actively trying to access the network and block or allow connections directly from the live monitoring log.
 Per-App Rules: Control Wi-Fi and Mobile Data access for each app individually.
 Import/Export: Save and load your firewall rules as a simple .json file.
 Sorting: Advanced filtering based on user apps, system apps, network permission, disabled status, uninstalled leftover rules, or blocked-placement priority.
 Efficient: The app doesn't need to be constantly running in the background when utilizing Shizuku mode.
 Elegant Reapplying: Hassle-free user experience on startup.
 App search and more
 How to Use:
 Enable the Firewall: Press the "Enable" button on the main screen.
 Choose Mode: Toggle between "Shizuku" (requires setup) or "VPN" (works instantly).
 Block Apps: Tap the Wi-Fi or Data icons next to any app to block its access.
 Network Monitoring: Access "Network monitoring" from the top-right menu to see app connection requests in real-time.
 Note: After rebooting your phone, for Shizuku mode, you must first start Shizuku, then re-open the app to re-apply the rules.

fdroid:app.smarzaro.foss4g2024.schedule.name: FOSS4G 2024 Schedule
fdroid:app.smarzaro.foss4g2024.schedule.summary: Conference program app for the FOSS4G 2024 conference in Belém, Brazil
fdroid:app.smarzaro.foss4g2024.schedule.description:
https://2024.foss4g.org
 About FOSS4G 
FOSS4G is the acronym for Free and Open Source Software for Geospatial. It is the annual recurring global event hosted by OSGeo, the non-profit organization that supports and promotes the collaborative development of free and open source geographic technologies and open geospatial data.
The conference covers all kinds of topics related to geospatial information and earth observation openness from Software development to Transition to FOSS4G, Use cases and applications, Education and research and Open data.
This event is for all kinds of people interested in sharing experiences about maps, from developers who write code to users of geomatics software, people who make decisions, researchers, students and anyone who wants to learn, share and meet like GIS interested people.
It attracts over 1,000 practitioners and advocates for free and open source software for geospatial and the tendency is to increase this number every year. It is the main meeting place and educational outreach opportunity for OSGeo members, supporters and newcomers - to share and learn from one another in presentations, hands-on workshops and a conference exhibition.
For appreciating the quality and variety of the presentations, you can watch video recordings of past FOSS4G events on the FOSS4G YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/c/FOSS4G/)
 Features 
* View program by day and rooms (side by side)
* Custom grid layout for smartphones (try landscape mode 🙃) and tablets
* Read detailed descriptions (speaker names, start time, room name, links, ...) of events
* Add events to favorites list
* Export favorites list
* Setup alarms for individual events
* Add events to your personal calendar
* Share a website link to an event with others
* Keep track of program changes
* Automatic program updates (configurable in settings)
* Vote and leave comments on talks and workshops
 🔤 Supported languages 
(Event descriptions excluded)
* Danish
* Dutch
* English
* Finnish
* French
* German
* Italian
* Japanese
* Lithuanian
* Polish
* Portuguese (Brazil)
* Portuguese (Portugal)
* Russian
* Spanish
* Swedish
* Turkish
💡 Questions regarding the content can only be answered by the
FOSS4G content team. This app simply offers a way to consume and
personalize the conference schedule.
💣 Bug reports are very welcome. It would be awesome if you
can describe how to reproduce the particular error in the
issue tracker at https://github.com/EventFahrplan/EventFahrplan/issues.
🏆 The app is based on the EventFahrplan app
which was initially built for the camp and annual congress of
the Chaos Computer Club. The source code of the app is publicly
available on GitHub at:
https://github.com/Smarzaro/Foss4g2024Schedule/tree/foss4g-belem-2024.
🎨 FOSS4G 2024 logo is CC-BY-ND 4.0.

fdroid:com.conanizer.pockettracker.name: PocketTracker
fdroid:com.conanizer.pockettracker.summary: Tracker-style music maker for handhelds and phones — sampler, SF2, 8 tracks
fdroid:com.conanizer.pockettracker.description:
PocketTracker is a music tracker in the spirit of LSDJ, LGPT and the M8 — built for Android gaming handhelds with physical buttons, with an on-screen control layout for phones.
Features:
* 8-track sequencer with the classic Song → Chain → Phrase structure
* Sampler instruments: load WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, Opus and M4A files
* SoundFont instrument support: SF2 and SF3
* Sample editor: trim, chop, slice, time-stretch (SOLA), pitch-shift, destructive FX
* Sample from video: extract audio from screen recordings (MP4/MKV/WebM)
* 31 step effects: arpeggio, retrigger, pitch slides, vibrato, chance/randomize, tables, grooves, mixer-fader automation and more
* Per-instrument modulation: AHD/ADSR envelopes and LFOs with 10 destinations
* Mixer with per-track sends, true dBFS meters, reverb and delay send buses
* Master bus with OTT-style multiband compression or DUST lo-fi chain, plus limiter
* WAV export: full mix or per-track stems; resample selections into new instruments
* Interface color themes, a theme editor and multiple top-bar visualizers
* Low-latency native audio engine (Oboe); runs well on 1 GB RAM devices
Storage: PocketTracker requests no permissions. The first time you open its file browser it offers a single "ADD FOLDER..." row, which opens Android's own folder picker; the folder you choose becomes its home and is where projects, samples and renders live. You can grant it further folders at any time from the top of the browser, so a sample library anywhere on the device — or a video copied over from a PC — is reachable without giving the app access to everything.
Requires Android 8.0+ on a 64-bit device (arm64-v8a or x86_64).

fdroid:com.example.timenotification.name: Voltascano
fdroid:com.example.timenotification.summary: Voltascano shows battery voltage in the system status bar
fdroid:com.example.timenotification.description:
Voltascano shows Android phone’s real-time battery voltage. The information is always visible in an icon in the status bar and in a notification, even while you use other apps.
Practical uses of monitoring battery voltage:
 🔋 Check battery real health
 Spot signs of battery degradation. Watch for sudden or irregular voltage drops—these are early signs that the battery is degrading.
 🔌 Catch bad chargers or cables
 During charging, voltage should rise smoothly (e.g., 3.7 V → 4.2 V). If it stays flat or jumps irregularly, the cable or adapter is likely defective.
 💀 Avoid unexpected shutdowns
 Monitoring voltage lets you see the exact point where the phone shuts down from low battery. Helping you avoid surprises like the device shutting down at 30% charge.
 📈 Save money on unnecessary battery replacement
 Monitor battery’s voltage to know its true health and decide a battery replacement only when it is actually needed.
 ⚠️ Prolong battery lifespan
 Batteries experience high stress when charged to their maximum voltage, which often happens before the charge indicator shows 100%. By monitoring voltage, you can unplug your phone at the optimal point to reduce stress and extend battery life.
 🔎 Evaluate aftermarket replacement battery capacity
 Quickly know a replacement battery’s quaity. A good battery holds stable voltage under load, while a poor-quality battery drops quickly under use and spikes sharply when charging.
The Voltascano Battery Voltage Display app is a tool for anyone who wants detailed insights into their Android smartphone’s battery health. 
Key Features:
 - User-Friendly Interface: Designed with simplicity in mind, ensuring easy navigation and quick access to vital battery data.
 - Automatic Startup Support: Enables continuous monitoring without requiring manual app relaunches after a reboot.
 - Resource Efficiency: The app operates with minimal RAM usage, ensuring it does not interfere with system performance.
 - No Hidden Processes: Unlike many background apps, it does not run covert services, preventing unnecessary battery drain.
 - Manual Exit Functionality: Allows users to completely exit the app with a single button press, ensuring full control over system resources.
 - Ad-Free Experience: The app is entirely free to use without any intrusive advertisements disrupting the user experience.
 - Wide Compatibility: Works seamlessly on devices running Android 8 and newer versions.
Created by Eugen Barilyuk EB43 https://eb43.github.io

fdroid:com.tokyoxpa3.socksclient.name: 5G Proxy Client
fdroid:com.tokyoxpa3.socksclient.summary: Routes device traffic through a remote SOCKS5 proxy via TUN. No root, TCP/UDP.
fdroid:com.tokyoxpa3.socksclient.description:
Android SOCKS5 TUN tunnel client — routes the device's entire network traffic through a remote SOCKS5 server using a TUN virtual interface. No root required.
Features:
- User-space TCP state machine forwarded via SOCKS5 CONNECT
- UDP / DNS / QUIC relay via SOCKS5 UDP ASSOCIATE (UDP-in-UDP or UDP-in-TCP 0x04)
- Remote DNS (fakedns) with fake IPv4 (198.18.0.0/15) and fake IPv6
- IPv4 + IPv6 dual-stack support
- Per-App routing modes: Global, Allowlist, or Exclusion
- Auto-reconnect with exponential backoff on connection drop
- Live traffic statistics (up/down bytes & session count) in persistent notification
- Custom primary & secondary DNS servers
- Start tunnel on boot
- Quick Settings tile for one-tap tunnel toggle
- Multiple profile management with JSON export/import via clipboard
- Native C (epoll) engine + JNI + Kotlin UI
Privacy notes:
- While the tunnel is up, the proxy server's hostname is re-resolved outside the tunnel (needed to follow DDNS / IP changes without tearing the TUN interface down). That lookup is sent to the DNS servers of the network the tunnel actually runs over. The custom DNS servers above are used only as a fallback when that resolver gives no answer, and the fallback is written to the log.
- With Remote DNS enabled, DNS queries from apps are relayed to the proxy exit instead of being answered locally.
Open source (MIT), reproducible builds.

fdroid:de.metager.metagerapp.fdroid.name: MetaGer: Search & Browser
fdroid:de.metager.metagerapp.fdroid.summary: Anonymous search and tab groups, private browsing with tracker and ad blocking.
fdroid:de.metager.metagerapp.fdroid.description:
MetaGer.de is a German meta search engine with a focus on privacy and variety of results, run by the non-profit SUMA-EV.
This app is a full browser built around that search: native, fast, and private by default.
• Search your way: switch between web, image, news, science and product search, all in one tap.
• Tab groups: keep work, shopping and private browsing apart, each with its own cookies, logins and history — move a tab into another group whenever you like.
• Anonymous search: your MetaGer key for ad-free searches is separated from your queries by blind signatures.
• Account and top-up without leaving the app: sign in once, or hand your key to another device with a QR code.
• Tracker and ad blocking, on from the start.
• Set MetaGer as your default browser: links from other apps open here, protected the same way.
• Address bar with local history — encrypted on-device, never on a server.
• Instant dark, light or system theme.
• Open anonymously: view a page in a remote browser without loading it yourself.
• No account required, no profile, no advertising IDs.
The source code of this app is free (AGPL-3.0).

fdroid:de.quavon.jackpoll.name: Jackpoll
fdroid:de.quavon.jackpoll.summary: Open-source surveys & quizzes: build, share and analyze. Self-hostable.
fdroid:de.quavon.jackpoll.description:
Jackpoll is an open-source tool to build, share and analyze surveys and quizzes: a privacy-friendly, self-hostable alternative to closed survey platforms.
Create surveys with a drag-and-drop builder, run scored quizzes (also live, with a leaderboard), collect responses and see results update in real time. Everything is open source, and you can run your own instance.
Features:
• Drag-and-drop builder with pages and conditional logic
• Many question types: short and long answers, multiple choice, checkboxes, dropdown, grids, rating, slider, ranking, date, file upload, signature and word cloud
• Text and image blocks between questions for source texts and instructions
• Quiz mode with automatic scoring, plus grading of open answers student by student
• Live quizzes and word clouds with a presentation mode
• Real-time results with charts, PDF and Excel export
• Collaboration with role-based permissions
• Share links and embeddable surveys
Privacy and openness:
• 100% open source (MIT), no ads, no tracking
• Self-hostable: connect the app to your own Jackpoll instance
• No Google Play Services in this build
Notifications:
Push notifications use UnifiedPush. Install a distributor such as ntfy (available on F-Droid) and Jackpoll delivers notifications through it, via ntfy.sh or your own ntfy server.
The app is a client for a Jackpoll server. On first launch it connects to the official instance (app.jackpoll.org), and the app's interface is loaded from the server you are connected to. To use your own deployment, tap "Change server" below the login form before signing in. Links to other websites open in your browser.

apple-macos:1369524274.name: QR Capture
apple-macos:1369524274.description:
The most simple & easy QR Reader. Capture QR codes just like you would on a phone. Perfect for computer beginners. Works with iPhone & webcams (EpocCam...).
FEATURES
- Code Scanner - scans QR codes (screen, clipboard, file or camera*), scans other 2D barcodes (screen, clipboard or file)
- Drag & Drop on the app icon to scan a QR code / barcode
- Scan your clipboard for a QR code / barcode
- Full-screen barcode scanning (File-> Full-Screen scan, App Icon-> Full-Screen scan)
- Export scanned QR codes / barcodes as CSV text
- Automatic copy to clipboard (enabled in preferences )
- Quickly scan a selected area with the keyboard shortcut CMD+1 (also available from the top menu)
- Shortcuts support
- Double click to open in the corresponding app (Safari, Contacts, Mail, TextEdit, FaceTime...)
- Saves all successfully scanned texts in a local database
- Stage Manager ready
- Keep scanning window on top of other windows (Phone->Float on Top)
*(7 codes limit that can be removed using in-app)
WEBCAM:
- use your USB-attached webcam /iPhone or phone camera app (EpocCam) to quickly scan QR codes into your computer. Phone camera significantly improves scanning performance.
IMPORTANT NOTICE:
- use the button at the bottom of the screen to switch to the iSight camera.
- iSight camera has no autofocus feature. It is necessary to place the QR code at the correct distance so it appears sharp.
- always ensure that your room is bright to improve scanning results. Use additional light sources in semi-dark / poorly lit rooms.
- iPhone as a camera requires macOS 13 Ventura, iOS 16, and iCloud. iPhone as a camera on macOS Sonoma/Ventura/Monterey requires 3rd party iOS app such as EpocCam.

fedora-packages:aftertheflood-sparks-fon.description: After the Flood Sparks is a font that allows for the combination of text and visual data to show an idea and evidence in one headline. This builds on the principle of Sparklines defined by Edward Tufte and makes them easier to use. Sparklines are currently available as plugins or javascript elements. By installing the Sparks font you can use them immediately without the need for custom code. Sparks data needs to be formatted as comma-separated values, with curly brackets at both ends of the set, e.g., {30,60,90}. You can also have numbers at the beginning and end of the set, which are useful for providing the start and end points, e.g., 123{30,60,90}456 – Sparks has numerals built in. fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension for enumerated reference processing.

Because mpibash includes various MPI functions for data transfer and synchronization, it is not limited to parallel workloads, but can incorporate phased operations where all workers must finish operation X before any worker is allowed to begin operation Y. mpibash compiled with MPICH, package incl. binaries and libraries.

fedora-packages:NaturalDocs/NaturalDocs.name: NaturalDocs

fedora-packages:NaturalDocs/NaturalDocs.description: Natural Docs is an open-source documentation generator for multiple programming languages. fedora-packages:notmuch/notmuch-devel.name: notmuch-devel
fedora-packages:notmuch/notmuch-devel.summary: Development libraries and header files for the Notmuch library
fedora-packages:notmuch/notmuch-devel.description: Notmuch-devel contains the development libraries and header files for Notmuch email program. These libraries and header files are necessary if you plan to do development using Notmuch. Install notmuch-devel if you are developing C programs which will use the Notmuch library. You'll also need to install the notmuch package.

fedora-packages:nwchem/nwchem.name: nwchem
fedora-packages:nwchem/nwchem.summary: Delivering High-Performance Computational Chemistry to Science
fedora-packages:nwchem/nwchem.description: NWChem aims to provide its users with computational chemistry tools that are scalable both in their ability to treat large scientific computational chemistry problems efficiently, and in their use of available parallel computing resources from high-performance parallel supercomputers to conventional workstation clusters. Please cite the following reference when publishing results obtained with NWChem: M. Valiev, E.J. Bylaska, N. Govind, K. Kowalski, T.P. Straatsma, H.J.J. van Dam, D. Wang, J. Nieplocha, E. Apra, T.L. Windus, W.A. de Jong, "NWChem: a comprehensive and scalable open-source solution for large scale molecular simulations" Comput. Phys. Commun. 181, 1477 (2010) There is currently no serial version built.

fedora-packages:peazip/peazip-common.description: This package provides common data files (icons, translations, etc.) used by the PeaZip file archiving utility.

fedora-packages:perl-AnyData/perl-AnyDat.name: perl-AnyData
fedora-packages:perl-AnyData/perl-AnyDat.summary: Easy access to data in many formats
fedora-packages:perl-AnyData/perl-AnyDat.description: The AnyData modules provide simple and uniform access to data from many sources -- perl arrays, local files, remote files retrievable via http or ftp -- and in many formats including flat files (CSV, Fixed Length, Tab Delimited, etc), standard format files (Web Logs, Passwd files, etc.), structured files (XML, HTML Tables) and binary files with parseable headers (mp3s, jpgs, pngs, etc). There are two separate modules, each providing a different interface: AnyData.pm provides a simple tied hash interface and DBD::AnyData provides a DBI/SQL interface. You can use either or both depending on your needs.

fedora-packages:perl-Class-C3/perl-Class.name: perl-Class-C3
fedora-packages:perl-Class-C3/perl-Class.summary: Pragma to use the C3 method resolution order algorithm
fedora-packages:perl-Class-C3/perl-Class.description: This is a pragma to change Perl 5's standard method resolution order from depth-first left-to-right (a.k.a - pre-order) to the more sophisticated C3 method resolution order.

fedora-packages:perl-Class-Exporter/perl.name: perl-Class-Exporter
fedora-packages:perl-Class-Exporter/perl.summary: Export class methods as regular subroutines
fedora-packages:perl-Class-Exporter/perl.description: This module makes it much easier to make a module have a hybrid object/method interface similar to the one of CGI.pm. You can take any old module that has an object- oriented interface and convert it to have a hybrid interface by simply adding "use base 'Class::Exporter'" to your code.

fedora-packages:perl-Crypt-Curve25519/pe.name: perl-Crypt-Curve25519
fedora-packages:perl-Crypt-Curve25519/pe.summary: Generate shared secret using elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman function
fedora-packages:perl-Crypt-Curve25519/pe.description: Curve25519 is a Diffie-Hellman function suitable for a wide variety of applications. Given a user's 32-byte secret key, Curve25519 computes the user's 32-byte public key. Given the user's 32-byte secret key and another user's 32-byte public key, Curve25519 computes a 32-byte secret shared by the two users. This secret can then be used to authenticate and encrypt messages between the two users.

fedora-packages:perl-Date-ISO8601/perl-D.name: perl-Date-ISO8601
fedora-packages:perl-Date-ISO8601/perl-D.description: The international standard ISO 8601 "Data elements and interchange formats - Information interchange - Representation of dates and times" defines three distinct calendars by which days can be labeled. It also defines textual formats for the representation of dates in these calendars. This module provides functions to convert dates between these three calendars and Chronological Julian Day Numbers, which is a suitable format to do arithmetic with. It also supplies functions that describe the shape of these calendars, to assist in calendrical calculations. It also supplies functions to represent dates textually in the ISO 8601 formats. ISO 8601 also covers time of day and time periods, but this module does nothing relating to those parts of the standard; this is only about labeling days.

fedora-packages:perl-Exception-Base/perl.name: perl-Exception-Base
fedora-packages:perl-Exception-Base/perl.description: This class implements a fully OO exception mechanism similar to Exception::Class or Class::Throwable. It provides a simple interface allowing programmers to declare exception classes. These classes can be thrown and caught. Each uncaught exception prints full stack trace if the default verbosity is increased for debugging purposes.

fedora-packages:perl-File-Read/perl-File.name: perl-File-Read

fedora-packages:perl-File-Read/perl-File.description: This module mainly proposes functions for reading one or more files, with different options.

fedora-packages:perl-Mail-Box/perl-Mail-.description: The Mail::Box folder is a modern mail-folder manager -- at least at the moment of this writing ;) It is written to replace Mail::Folder, although its interface is different.

fedora-packages:perl-XML-Entities/perl-X.description: This module provides a mapping from the standard XML entities to their Unicode characters. A function for decoding is provided. The mapping can be generated from a DTD file with entity definitions.

fedora-packages:perl-XML-Handler-YAWrite.name: perl-XML-Handler-YAWriter
fedora-packages:perl-XML-Handler-YAWrite.summary: Yet another Perl SAX XML Writer

fedora-packages:perl-XML-Twig/perl-XML-T.name: perl-XML-Twig
fedora-packages:perl-XML-Twig/perl-XML-T.summary: Perl module for processing huge XML documents in tree mode
fedora-packages:perl-XML-Twig/perl-XML-T.description: This module provides a way to process XML documents. It is build on top of XML::Parser. It allows minimal resource (CPU and memory) usage by building the tree only for the parts of the documents that need actual processing, through the use of the twig_roots and twig_print_outside_roots options.

fedora-packages:perl-pmtools/perl-pmtool.name: perl-pmtools
fedora-packages:perl-pmtools/perl-pmtool.summary: A suite of small programs to help manage Perl modules
fedora-packages:perl-pmtools/perl-pmtool.description: This is pmtools -- a suite of small programs to help manage modules. The names are totally preliminary, and in fact, so is the code. We follow the "keep it small" notion of many tiny tools each doing one thing well, eschewing giant megatools with millions of options. Tom Christiansen

fedora-packages:perl-rpm-build-perl/perl.description: The provides/requires scripts packaged along with perl-rpm-build-perl.

fedora-packages:php-pecl-ip2location/php.name: php-pecl-ip2location

fedora-packages:php-psr-simple-cache/php.name: php-psr-simple-cache

You can find implementations of the specification by looking for packages providing the psr/simple-cache-implementation [2] virtual package. Autoloader: /usr/share/php/Psr/SimpleCache/autoload.php [1] https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-16-simple-cache.md [2] https://packagist.org/providers/psr/simple-cache-implementation

fedora-packages:pianobar/pianobar.name: pianobar
fedora-packages:pianobar/pianobar.description: pianobar is a free/open-source, console-based client for the personalized online radio Pandora. Features * play and manage (create, add more music, delete, rename, ...) stations * rate songs and explain why they have been selected * upcoming songs/song history * customize keybindings and text output * remote control and eventcmd interface (send tracks to last.fm, for example) * proxy support for listeners outside the USA

fedora-packages:postgresql17/postgresql1.name: postgresql17-private-devel
fedora-packages:postgresql17/postgresql1.summary: PostgreSQL development header files for this build of PostgreSQL server
fedora-packages:postgresql17/postgresql1.description: The postgresql-private-devel package contains the header files and libraries needed to compile C or C++ applications which will directly interact with a PostgreSQL database management server. You need to install this package if you want to develop applications which will interact with a PostgreSQL server.

fedora-packages:psad/psad.name: psad
fedora-packages:psad/psad.summary: Port Scan Attack Detector (psad) watches for suspect traffic
fedora-packages:psad/psad.description: Port Scan Attack Detector (psad) is a lightweight system daemon written in Perl designed to work with Linux iptables firewalling code to detect port scans and other suspect traffic. It features a set of highly configurable danger thresholds (with sensible defaults provided), verbose alert messages that include the source, destination, scanned port range, begin and end times, tcp flags and corresponding nmap options, reverse DNS info, email and syslog alerting, automatic blocking of offending ip addresses via dynamic configuration of iptables rulesets, and passive operating system fingerprinting. In addition, psad incorporates many of the tcp, udp, and icmp signatures included in the snort intrusion detection system (https://www.snort.org) to detect highly suspect scans for various backdoor programs (e.g. EvilFTP, GirlFriend, SubSeven), DDoS tools (mstream, shaft), and advanced port scans (syn, fin, xmas) which are easily leveraged against a machine via nmap. psad can also alert on snort signatures that are logged via fwsnort (https://www.cipherdyne.org/fwsnort/), which makes use of the iptables string match module to detect application layer signatures.

fedora-packages:pulseaudio/pulseaudio.name: pulseaudio
fedora-packages:pulseaudio/pulseaudio.description: PulseAudio is a sound server for Linux and other Unix like operating systems. It is intended to be an improved drop-in replacement for the Enlightened Sound Daemon (ESOUND).

fedora-packages:pybind11/pybind11-devel.name: pybind11-devel
fedora-packages:pybind11/pybind11-devel.description: pybind11 is a lightweight header-only library that exposes C++ types in Python and vice versa, mainly to create Python bindings of existing C++ code. This package contains the development headers for pybind11.

firefox-addons:884118.description:
While most PDF files can be viewed directly in the browser some PDFs will trigger a "Save as"-dialog or will be downloaded automatically. This addon views all PDF files directly in the browser. You can still save the PDF by pressing CTRL+S (or CMD+S) after viewing them.
Please make sure that the setting under Firefox > Preferences > Applications > PDF is set to "Preview in Firefox" in order for this addon to work.
Some web servers are misconfigured and don't tell the browser that a file is a PDF. In this case the file will still be downloaded even when this addon is active. If you encounter a PDF that is downloaded feel free to send the URL to the support email address so I can check if this it's a bug in the addon or just a server issue.

bluejetty:00079249:ios.summary:
CNOR Exam Pass 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the CCI Certified Perioperative Nurse (CNOR) Exam with a high score on your first attempt.
CNOR Exam Pass 2026 will not only help you gain insight into concepts related
bluejetty:00079249:ios.description:
CNOR Exam Pass 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the CCI Certified Perioperative Nurse (CNOR) Exam with a high score on your first attempt.
CNOR Exam Pass 2026 will not only help you gain insight into concepts related to CCI CNOR exam preparation, but will also help you increase your confidence in passing the exam on your first attempt by practicing thousands of exam-like questions.
### Pass the exam on the first attempt ###
In CNOR Exam Pass 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the scope of the official CCI exam requirements. In total, you will need to master seven subject areas according to the exam requirements, each of which covers a dozen areas that need to be mastered. You have the flexibility to choose which subjects you need to practice, depending on your situation.
Specifically, these subjects include
- Pre/Postoperative Patient Assessment & Diagnosis (15%)
- Individualized Plan of Care Development and Expected Outcome Identification (8%)
- Patient Care and Safety (25%)
- Management of Personnel, Services and Materials (9%)
- Professional Accountability (6%)
- Emergency Situations (10%)
- Infection Prevention and Control of Environment, Instrumentation and Supplies (16%)
- Communication and Documentation (11%)
### Key Features ###
- Over 1300 questions to practice, each including detailed answer explanations
- Specialized exercises by content area, with the flexibility to switch at any time
- View analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the CNOR exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that each time you practice in Pass CNOR Exam 2026, your knowledge of the exam will increase, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions while hinting to yourself to do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high not only on the CNOR exam, but on any other exam!
### Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://cnor.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://cnor.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html
Please let us know if you have any questions or comments about your use by emailing us at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 business days at the latest.

- Casual walking throughout your day
- Building healthy habits with rewards

— Create an account quickly and access the Crypto market instantly
— Buy and sell BTC and altcoin assets using Visa, Mastercard, and Google Pay

— Hold Crypto securely while following your trading strategy
— Deposit and withdraw BTC and other Cryptocurrency easily

— Market and limit orders across Crypto markets
— Spot trading for BTC and altcoin assets
— Margin trading and futures for advanced strategy
— Staking options to earn while you hold Crypto
— Real-time charts, indicators, and market data
These features help users build a Strong trading strategy and optimise their Cryptocurrency portfolio.

Security features include:
— Two-step authentication
— PIN and password protection
— Secure access across devices
Your BTC, altcoin, and Cryptocurrency holdings remain protected at all times.
LOW FEES AND GLOBAL ACCESS
HitBTC exchange offers competitive fees across Crypto markets, helping traders maximise returns while managing a long-term portfolio. Trade Crypto efficiently with transparent costs.
TRUSTED SINCE 2013
Founded in 2013, HitBTC exchange is trusted by millions of users worldwide. Traders rely on HitBTC exchange for deep liquidity, broad market access, and a Strong trading Interface.
24/7 MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT
Trade Crypto anytime with round-the-clock support. The HitBTC exchange support team is available 24/7 to assist users worldwide.
CONTACT HITBTC
For questions or feedback, contact support@hitbtc.com.

Cryptocurrency trading involves risk. Always research Crypto markets, BTC assets, and altcoin investments before trading. Only trade Cryptocurrency if you understand and accept the risks.

bluejetty:00164544:ios.description:
Unleash Your Creativity with Custom Emojis!
Introducing the AI Emoji Generator for emoji lovers – an AI-powered app that lets you design, create, and use your own unique emojis! No more being limited to the standard set of emojis. With this app, you can bring your ideas to life in just a few simple steps. Describe the emoji you want or upload a photo, and our AI will instantly generate it for you. Whether you want something fun, personal, or totally off-the-wall, the possibilities are endless!
How the App Works:
1. Describe Your Emoji: Start by typing a brief description of the emoji you want to create. Be as specific or creative as you like – whether it’s an emotion, an object, a combination of both, or something that doesn’t even exist yet!
or
Add Picture or Photo: Start by choosing photo or picture based on which you would like a unique Emoji to be created.
2. AI Generates It: Watch the magic happen as our advanced AI processes your description or photo and creates a custom emoji just for you. In no more than a minute, you’ll have a unique emoji that you won’t find anywhere else.
3. Use Your Emoji Everywhere: Your emoji is ready and is compatible with iMessage. You can instantly use it there. Or save it as an image. Want to share it with friends? Easily send your new emoji via other messaging apps, post it on social media, or share it directly from the app (as a picture).
Key Features:
- AI Emoji Creation: Describe any emoji you can imagine, and our cutting-edge AI will generate it. No design skills required!
- Photo to Emoji: Use photos of friends, family, pets or just a picture you like and turn it into an Emoji
- Compatible with iMessage: We’ve made it easy for you to use your custom emojis directly within your conversations.
- Share & Save: Once created, save your custom emojis as high-quality images to your device. You can also share them instantly across social media platforms or send them to friends.
- Personalized Emoji Library: Every emoji you create is saved within the app, so you can build your own library of personalized emojis for any mood, situation or conversation.
- Unlimited Possibilities: Whether you want to express a rare emotion, create a combination of emojis that don’t exist, or invent something totally new, the only limit is your imagination!
- Unlimited Emoji Creations: There’s no limit to how many emojis you ca

bluejetty:00073088:ios.description:
Experience a new era of outdoor cooking with the Kamado Joe mobile app. Set and monitor your grill time and temperature, view session graphing for long cooks, and receive alerts and notifications all within the palm of your hand. Serve up adventure with the Kamado Joe app. 
Features: 
Pioneering Technology – Sync your Kamado Joe grill to the app for a digitally-driven grilling experience. 
Set Time and Temperature – Easily set your desired cooking time and temperature. 
Notifications and Alerts – Receive alerts and notifications to help power on/off grill, notify when your meat probe has reached desired temperature, and more. 
Interactive Cooking Graphs – Scroll through temperature graphs as you cook to experience the epitome of grilling precision. 
Cooking History – Easily compare and interact with your past cooking adventures with a new session history feature. 
Serve Up Adventure – Discover hundreds of curated recipes and filter by food type, cooking style, or cook time. 
Product Compatibility – The Kamado Joe App is compatible with Konnected Joe™ and Pellet Joe® grills. 
Compatible Products: 
• Konnected Joe Digital Charcoal Grill (KJ15041123)
• Big Konnected Joe Digital Charcoal Grill (KJ15042425) 
• Pellet Joe (KJ15260020)

bluejetty:00131616:ios.description:
Universal Truck Simulator (UTS) brings next-gen simulation experiance to mobile devices, developed with constant feedback/suggestions from players.
NEW!!
Enjoy traveling through the US thanks to the new real maps that we have incorporated into the game! The beautiful cities of Reno, Tahoe and Roseville are now available. Are you prepared for the new challenges and surprises that the road will bring you?
Germany
The game encompasses a detailed large map which is set in Wesern Germany, featuring real locations such as Munich, Rosenheim, Ebersberg, Vorderiss, Autobahn and the beautiful Bavarian mountain range.
Main Features:
1. Large Map: Detailed 3D Real world locations with landmarks and long distance routes. 
2. Trucks: European/American Trucks split in various axle formations (4x2,6x2,6x4 & 8x4).
3. Trailers: Wide range of European/American trailers (box, flatbed, lowboy, refrigerated, log, tanker, cattle etc..)
4. Own Garage: Players have the ability to Buy/expand their own garage with total freedom to move around inside and out. 
5. Parts: All vehicles parts can be changed/upgraded such as the engine, gearbox, turbo, tyres, battery, radiator, coolant, oil, and horn.
6. Engine sounds: All engines include real sounds and performance
7. Damage system: The game features physical damage and truck body deformation on collision. vehicle parts have wear and tear system 
8. Customisation: Vehicles can be fully be customised such as the color, body attachements, lights. interior customisation include change of dashboard color, steering wheel, dash lights.
9. Skin Maker: Players can create custom skins for both trucks, trailers inside the game. 
10.Weather: day/night and multi weather system which includes sunshine,
rain, thunder and fog.
and much more

Universal Truck Simulator (UTS) brings next-gen simulation experiance to mobile devices, developed with constant feedback/suggestions from players.

NEW!!
Enjoy traveling through the US thanks to the new real maps that we have incorporated into the game! The beautiful cities of Reno, Tahoe and Roseville are now available. Are you prepared for the new challenges and surprises that the road will bring you?

Germany
The game encompasses a detailed large map which is set in Wesern Germany, featuring real locations such as Munich, Rosenheim, Ebersberg, Vorderiss, Autobahn and the beautiful Bavarian mountain range.

Main Features:
1. Large Map: Detailed 3D Real world locations with landmarks and long distance routes. 

2. Trucks: European/American Trucks split in various axle formations (4x2,6x2,6x4 & 8x4).

3. Trailers: Wide range of European/American trailers (box, flatbed, lowboy, refrigerated, log, tanker, cattle etc..)

4. Own Garage: Players have the ability to Buy/expand their own garage with total freedom to move around inside and out. 

5. Parts: All vehicles parts can be changed/upgraded such as the engine, gearbox, turbo, tyres, battery, radiator, coolant, oil, and horn.

6. Engine sounds: All engines include real sounds and performance

7. Damage system: The game features physical damage and truck body deformation on collision. vehicle parts have wear and tear system 

8. Customisation: Vehicles can be fully be customised such as the color, body attachements, lights. interior customisation include change of  dashboard color, steering wheel, dash lights.

9. Skin Maker: Players can create custom skins for both trucks, trailers inside the game. 

10.Weather: day/night and multi weather system which includes sunshine,
rain, thunder and fog.

and much more

bluejetty:00199415:android.description:
Free Front Flashlight Notifications (Samsung J7 Prime, J7, J5, J2, Moto Z and others).
FREE AND NO ADS - FREE AND NO ADVERTISING.
FEATURES/CHARACTERISTICS:
*Activate/Deactivate notifications.
*Automatic selection of the flash to use depending on the position of the phone:
**If it is turned around, turn on the rear flash, if not, turn on the front flash.
**The proximity sensor is used to know which flash to turn on.
*Flash with front camera.
*Flash with rear camera.
*Do not flash with the screen on.
*Do not flash with battery less than a percentage of your choice.
*Do not flash between a period of time of your choice.
*Remind notifications every few seconds of your choice.
*Possibility of choosing which applications to include in the notification reminder and which ones not to include!!!
*Ability to choose which applications to notify and which not to!!!
*Possibility of choosing the amount of flash for each application!!!
*If "Flash with front camera" is activated and the phone is turned upside down or in your pocket, the flash will not turn on!!
*If "Flash with front camera" is activated and the phone does not have a front flash, you will be given the option to turn on the screen when a notification arrives.
*Test notifications in app according to selected options.
And still in development!!!
Special for Samsung J7 Prime, J7, J5, J2, Moto Z and any smartphone with flash on the front and/or rear camera.
Your smartphone does not have an LED for notifications, but does it have a camera with a flash?
Now you can use the flash to know when you receive a notification!
Does not require special permissions.
Tell us which other smartphone has worked for you!
Exclude from energy savings just in case!
NOTE: The application is under development, suggestions and comments are welcome!
Contact: info@douxim.com
Douxim.

bluejetty:00183469:ios.description:
YAHOO FINANCE: YOUR COMPREHENSIVE INVESTING RESOURCE
Stop reacting to the market and start anticipating it. Yahoo Finance is more than a tracking tool; it is a complete financial resource designed for those who take an active role in managing their own future. Whether you are optimizing a long-term retirement account or executing sophisticated daily trades, we provide the data and real-time reporting you need to stay informed.
UNIFIED PORTFOLIO WATCH
For the active strategist, total visibility is essential. Sync your brokerage accounts to track your entire net worth in a single, secure dashboard. By bringing your external accounts together, you can monitor how your total assets are performing in real time without toggling between multiple platforms.
• PERFORMANCE TRACKING: Analyze your holdings with cost-basis tools and view real-time gains and losses across your entire portfolio.
• BROAD ASSET COVERAGE: Go beyond standard equities. Monitor Crypto, ETFs, Bonds, Commodities, Currencies, and World Indices in one unified view.
• CUSTOM WATCHLISTS: Build multiple lists to organize your investments. Separate your long-term core holdings from your high-conviction active plays to keep your strategy focused.
LIVE VIDEO AND EDITORIAL COVERAGE
In a market moved by headlines, context is everything. Our dedicated newsroom provides the background and analysis behind the numbers to help you understand the broader market picture.
• DAILY LIVE BRIEFINGS: Tune into daily broadcasts featuring market experts and analysts breaking down the opening and closing bells.
• LIVE EARNINGS AND EVENTS: Listen to corporate earnings calls directly within the app as they happen. Stay connected with live coverage of FOMC meetings, economic summits, and significant breaking news events.
• IN-DEPTH REPORTING: Our editorial team connects the dots between global current events and market performance, giving you a clearer view of how the world impacts your portfolio.
ADVANCED RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS
For those who want a deeper understanding of their investments, we provide the tools to dig into the details. Use our data to vet new opportunities and monitor your current positions.
• INTERACTIVE CHARTING: Utilize full-screen charts with technical indicators and drawing tools to identify market patterns and potential entry or exit points.
• FUNDAMENTAL DATA: Access years of historical financials, ESG ratings, and top holder information to evaluate a company’s long-term sustainability and performance.
• REAL-TIME ALERTS: Set custom price triggers and news notifications so you are immediately informed of pivots in the market or news affecting your watchlists.
THE PULSE OF THE INVESTING COMMUNITY
Join a massive global community of self-directed investors. Gain perspective from others who are navigating the same market conditions.
• COMMUNITY INSIGHTS: Gauge market sentiment and read diverse perspectives through our ticker-specific message boards.
• PERSONALIZED FEED: Our news feed surfaces the specific stories and updates that impact the companies and sectors you follow most closely.
WHY CHOOSE YAHOO FINANCE?
In a world of constant information, Yahoo Finance helps you focus on what matters. We provide the data, the tools, and the expert analysis to help you make more informed financial decisions. From the long-term planner looking for stability to the active researcher hunting for the next opportunity, this is where the most engaged investors stay connected to the markets.
Take control of your financial future. Download Yahoo Finance today to start building your edge.

Terms of Service: https://legal.yahoo.com/us/en/yahoo/privacy/index.html

bluejetty:00083902:ios.description:
Transform your nutrition journey with Calrizz, the intelligent calorie tracking companion that makes healthy eating effortless.
SNAP & TRACK INSTANTLY
Simply take a photo of your meal or upload from your gallery. Our advanced AI instantly identifies foods and calculates calories and nutrients with remarkable accuracy.
POWERFUL FOOD DATABASE
Access the comprehensive USDA food database for manual logging when needed. Save your favorite meals and foods for quick, one-tap tracking in the future.
SMART GOAL SETTING
Whether you’re maintaining, losing, or gaining weight, Calrizz adapts to your journey. Set your target weight, and let our smart algorithm suggest three personalized daily calorie goals - from relaxed to accelerated progress. Prefer full control? Set your own custom targets.
KEY FEATURES:
• AI-powered food recognition
• Instant calorie and nutrient calculation
• Photo logging from camera or gallery
• USDA database integration
• Customizable goals
• Favorite meals quick-access
• Comprehensive nutrient tracking
• Personalized calorie recommendations
Make mindful eating a natural part of your daily routine. Calrizz helps you understand your nutrition better, make informed food choices, and achieve your health goals with confidence.
Download Calrizz today and take the first step toward a healthier relationship with food. Your journey to better nutrition starts with a simple photo.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Calrizz offers auto-renewable subscriptions to access premium features. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
IMPORTANT NOTICE
Calrizz is developed for informational purposes only. The information provided by the app should not be used as a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult with your physician or other qualified healthcare provider before beginning any nutrition or weight loss program.

bluejetty:00183126:ios.description:
You remember that arcade machine at the bowling alley. The one you fed quarters into for hours.
Ball-Hop Bowling brings it back — right in your pocket.
Roll the ball. Aim for the rings. Chase the high score. It's the closest thing to the real arcade experience on mobile — and it's been the #1 arcade ball roller game for over 15 years.
THE ORIGINAL BONUS ICON SYSTEM
The mechanic the whole category copied — and nobody does better.Three targets. Three rewards. One compounding streak.Hit the Ticket Icon to bank bonus tickets. Hit the Exclamation Icon to stack your score multiplier — x2, x3, x4 and beyond. Hit the Ball Icon to earn an extra ball and keep your game alive.Chain 3 Bonus Icons and you're On Fire. Chain 6 and you're Burning Up.The longer your streak, the higher your multiplier, the more you earn.Simple to learn. Impossible to put down.
WHY PLAYERS KEEP COMING BACK
- Simulation physics that actually feel like the real thing
- Dozens of unique balls to collect and show off
- Multiple lane themes to unlock and play
- Bonus multipliers to chase insane high scores
- Ticket rewards — earn them, redeem them, collect prizes
BUILT FOR ALL AGES
Whether you're killing five minutes or chasing leaderboard glory, Ball-Hop Bowling fits your pace. No learning curve. No complicated controls. Just swipe, roll, and score.
COMPETE WITH THE WORLD
Sign in with Game Center and climb the global leaderboards. Every roll counts.
YOUR GAME, YOUR WAY
Customize everything — your ball, your lane, your style. Unlock new gear with tickets you earn just by playing.
Swipe up to launch. Tilt to aim. Bank shots welcome.
Install Ball-Hop Bowling — the original arcade ball roller.
Bug reports or suggestions? Skip the review — reach us at support@renownent.com or facebook.com/ballhopbowling

bluejetty:00032984:ios.description:
Bring your Bible questions to a clearer starting point.
Christian Companion pairs a KJV Bible reader with AI study chat, daily reflections, and help writing personal prayers.
ASK A BIBLE QUESTION
Ask about a verse or passage. Explore an explanation, then read the surrounding chapter and check quoted text in the Bible.
READ SCRIPTURE IN CONTEXT
Read the King James Version by book and chapter, or open a specific verse. Translation preferences for chat replies do not change the KJV Bible reader.
FIND WORDS FOR PRAYER
Ask for help writing a prayer of gratitude, patience, or guidance. Make the suggested words your own.
BUILD A DAILY RHYTHM
Return to a daily verse, prayer, and devotional. Mark daily activities complete as you make time for reflection.
KEEP YOUR STUDY TOGETHER
Sign in to keep conversation history. Saved study preferences can personalize later chats; view and clear them in Settings.
Chat replies are generated by AI and can contain mistakes. Check Scripture quotations and interpretations against the Bible. Character styles are AI portrayals, not the actual biblical people.
Some features require a paid Plus subscription. Available prices and subscription terms are shown in the app before purchase.

• Получайте короны за заказы и обменивайте на еду за 1 рубль.

• Питайтесь разнообразно - Вы можете найти блюда на любой вкус.
• Экономьте - эксклюзивные и выгодные купоны со скидками и акции от ресторанов.
• Быстро находите ближайшие рестораны.

Ежедневно в рестораны BURGER KING® во всем мире приходит более одиннадцати миллионов посетителей. И неудивительно: ведь наши рестораны известны вкусом фирменных блюд и отличным соотношением цены и качества. Welcome to Word Chain, an exciting word game that blends the joy of solving a word puzzle with the challenge of discovering clever combinations. 
In this game, you'll guess words to form chains of familiar compound words or well-known phrases, making it an ideal choice for those who love to connect words in creative ways. Welcome t
bluejetty:00134484:ios.description:
PokeZone is the only app you need to enhance your Pokémon GO experience. Join more than 4.000.000 trainers to find worldwide remote raids and practice PvP battles. Build clans to play with local trainers.
Host & Join Remote Raids
Welcome to the world of Legendary and Mega Raids. More than 50.000.000 Remote Raids have been hosted worldwide since the beginning of the Remote Raid feature. Trainers host and join remote raids every hour of every day! Just join PokeZone and start battling on Remote Raids, no matter where you are.
Raid with High Rated Trainers
PokeZone has the best Remote Raid community. With an integrated rating system, rate the trainers you battled with. Keep up your good rating and battle with high-rated trainers!
Contact Verified Trainers
To ensure you communicate with the right trainer, PokeZone verifies all trainers by asking for their in-game profile screenshots.
Find New Global Trainers, Receive Gifts, and Grind XP
Among 3.5 million trainers around the world, find a new friend instantly. Send or receive gifts and get friendship XP for each of them.
Receive Worldwide Post Cards & Collect All Vivillon Patterns
Receive postcards from all over the world to complete your Vivillon patterns.
Meet Your Local Community with PokeZone Clans
Trainers around your area are waiting for you. Organize local raids, mirror trades, and more. Find out who plays in your area and meet them for in-person events.
Find In-Game Trainers
Did a remote raid but cannot communicate with other trainers in the lobby? Saw trainers in your local gym and want to message them? They are all on PokeZone.
Synchronize Your Lucky Eggs
Don’t stress about not being able to use a lucky egg before becoming best friends. Just chat with your soon-to-be best friends to synchronize your lucky eggs.
Receive Worldwide Gifts
Find worldwide friends to receive gifts from all over the world! Obtain your Platinum Pilot badge with the help of your long-distance friends.
Find Trainers to Trade
List the Pokémon you have and explore the other trainer’s Pokémon in your city. Find trainers having the Pokémon you are looking for and organize a trade.
Built-in Direct Messaging
Trainers can easily get in touch through our built-in direct messaging to arrange a trade without any 3rd party messaging application. This makes the whole communication easier and safer!
Practice to Become a GBL Champion
Practice makes perfect, so try and test as many strategies as possible without affecting your GBL Ranking.
Grind XP
The more you battle with new people, the more XP you earn through new friendships and friendship milestones! You can find opponents who are ready to battle instantly. Battle with them daily to increase your friendship level while practicing your skills!
Earn Rewards
You can earn rewards up to 3 battles daily, like Stardust & Rare Candy. Bring your buddy to the fight with you to earn a heart too!
Break the Language Barrier
Break the language barrier! Use the integrated translation service to connect with your friends even though you don’t speak the same language.
Location Privacy
We respect your privacy. Therefore we do not share your location with other trainers.
DISCLAIMER
PokeZone is a third-party application to help trainers to get in touch with each other. It is not affiliated with Pokémon GO, Niantic, Nintendo, or The Pokémon Company.
EULA
Please visit https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Receive Worldwide Gifts

Find Trainers to Trade

bluejetty:00064627:ios.description:
Bills Manager helps you stay on top of your payments and avoid costly late fees.
With a clean and intuitive design, it makes tracking your bills simple and stress-free.
The concept is straightforward — easily keep track of what’s been paid and what’s coming due each month.
No registration, no bank connection, and no Internet required. All your data stays safely on your iPhone, and you can manually back up or restore it at any time.
Main Features:
- Monthly bill list, sorted by status and due date
- Calendar view
- Past due and upcoming bills overview
- Passcode and Touch ID protection
- Recurring bills
- Attach photos to bills
- AutoPay tracking
- Customizable notifications (choose how many days before and at what time you’re reminded)
- Backup and restore via Dropbox
- Account history
- Quick Pay option
- Charts by month, quarter, or year
- Custom icons and colors to identify bills easily
If you enjoy using Bills Manager, please take a moment to rate or review the app — your feedback helps us make it even better!

Power at your fingertips
Control, monitor, and even automate your EcoFlow devices using the EcoFlow app.
[Space tab]
2 ways of connection
1. IoT connection - Connect your devices at home to the internet using your home Wi-Fi. This allows you to control your devices through the app no matter where you are.
2. Direct connection - No internet? No problem. You can directly connect your phone to your device via Bluetooth or your device's hotspot.
Monitor and control
1. Taking the DELTA series as an example, you can monitor the device in real-time, update its firmware, and adjust settings such as auto timeout, AC charging power, and charging/discharging limits.
2. Some devices support advanced features like AC always on, scheduled tasks, and energy management.
One-stop energy management
In the Space tab, you can efficiently manage multiple devices by adding them to an energy system. With features like system overview, scheduled tasks, and dashboard, you can easily manage the entire system and save on your electricity bills.
[Automation tab]
Create automation to let your devices perform tasks with a single tap or when specific conditions are met. Easily control your devices with automation.
For successful execution of automation, make sure the device is connected to the internet.
[Profile tab]
Account settings and more
1. EcoCredits - Join the EcoCredits reward program to earn points and redeem them for coupons or exclusive rewards.
2. Warranty registration - Upload a proof of purchase to get a digital warranty card.
3. Device sharing - Invite family or friends to manage devices together.

Method 2: Alternatively, you can go to the iTunes/Apple ID “Subscription” page and disable the automatic renewal to terminate this Service.

bluejetty:00151817:ios.description:
A calming fusion of word puzzles and classic solitaire — no timers, no pressure, just pure fun!
Match word or image cards to category cards (e.g., Jewellery → Necklace).
- Words go with words, images with images
- Complete all stacks to win
- Levels grow richer in logic — from simple pairs to layered associations
How to play:
- Start with a crown-marked category card
- Add matching word or image cards
- Finish when all cards are correctly sorted
Help when stuck:
- Hint — suggests a valid move
- Undo — go back one step
- Wildcard — place any card on it
- Shuffle — shuffles only the closed cards
- Dictionary — look up any word
Key features:
- Solitaire + word puzzle — unique hybrid
- Hundreds of thoughtfully designed levels
- Dual modes: words & images → stronger associations
- All ages: teens, adults, seniors
- Mindful & stress-free play
Perfect for fans of association games, solitaire, and meaningful puzzles — where every match rewards logic, memory, and calm focus.

bluejetty:00159944:ios.description:
The Ultimate Family Quran Learning Experience
Qupil is the perfect Quran learning app for families, designed to help every family member build a deep and lasting connection with the Quran. It empowers users to fulfill their rights towards the Quran—listening, recitation (tilawa), memorization (hifdh), reflection (tadabbur), and practice. With Qupil, learning the Quran becomes effortless, engaging and effective for everyone.
Three Powerful Learning Modes
A. Qupil Tadabbur: Deep Reflection, Step by Step
Discover the beauty of the Quran through bite-sized, self-paced lessons that guide you from recognizing the sounds of ayat to understanding their meanings and applying them in your daily life. This gamified, engaging experience taps into your inner child, making learning fun, exciting, and spiritually enriching.
B. Qupil Halakat: Elevate Your Recitation and memorization, with a group
Experience the joy of reciting the Quran in a live audio-only halaka, where an Ijaza-certified tutor listens and corrects your mistakes in real-time. Strengthen your recitation skills in a supportive and interactive environment. With on-demand audio-only group sessions, you can practice in total privacy while receiving expert guidance. 
C. Qupil Private: Personalized One-on-One Learning
For a more tailored approach, Qupil Private offers one-on-one lessons with an Ijaza-certified tutor of your choice. The platform intelligently matches you with the best tutor based on your profile and learning needs. Whether you seek to refine your recitation or master memorization, private lessons provide a customized plan for continuous progress. Plus, after every session, students can review their Tajweed mistakes directly on their personal Mushaf and track progress through detailed teacher evaluations.
Empowering Families & Recognizing Achievement
Parents can easily track their family’s progress, manage lessons, and preserve special learning moments. Watch motivation soar with our leaderboards and rewards, celebrating every milestone as you and your loved ones grow in your Quranic journey.
Qupil isn’t just an app—it’s a transformative Quran learning experience that brings families together. Add your family members, start your journey today, and invite friends to earn exciting referral rewards!

bluejetty:00045188:ios.summary: Kencor SAMi is a secure patient companion app designed to keep you and your healthcare team connected. With SAMi, patients can easily log and view vital signs such as blood pressure, weight, heart rate, and oxygen levels, and see clear tren
bluejetty:00045188:ios.description:
Kencor SAMi is a secure patient companion app designed to keep you and your healthcare team connected. With SAMi, patients can easily log and view vital signs such as blood pressure, weight, heart rate, and oxygen levels, and see clear trends over time.
SAMi allows patients to connect with their care team, supporting better communication and proactive care once they leave the clinic or hospital.
Key features:
 • Record and track vital signs with ease
 • View daily and long-term health trends
 • Connect securely with your provider team
 • Stay connected to your prescribed treatment plan
SAMi is not a fitness, diet, or nutrition app. It does not provide meal plans, weight-loss programs, or exercise routines. It is strictly designed to support remote patient monitoring and healthcare team communication.
Developed in collaboration with physicians, Kencor SAMi helps improve ongoing care by keeping vital information accessible to both patients and providers.
Disclaimer: This app is for informational and monitoring purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice. Consult a healthcare provider before making medical decisions.
NB: The devices that are integrated to connect with this app are regulated within the US region only.

In the future world of Eighth Era, embark on an epic journey where heroes rise, champions clash, and tactical prowess reigns supreme. In this immersive RPG adventure, every decision matters as you lead your squad through legendary battles. 
Build and Strengthen Your Squad: Heroic Growth
Level up your heroes, unlock new abilities, and gear up your squad to face even greater challenges. With each level achieved, your heroes become more formidable, ready to take on even the baddest bosses.

Dominate the battlefield by unleashing the power of Super Swaps. Inspired by classic arcade mechanics, Super Swaps bring reserve champions into the field with devastating attacks. Whether you need brute strength, tech powers, or swift agility, Super Swaps allow you to supercharge your strategy and conquer any encounter.

Unleash your heroes’ full potential with dynamic combat sequences, each move rendered in cinematic animation. From exhilarating smashes to awe-inspiring powers, every charge attack adds depth and excitement to your journey.

Build your squad and devise a cunning strategy to vanquish powerful bosses and claim legendary treasures on your quest. But beware, these bosses will test your skill like never before, requiring all your cunning to emerge victorious.

In your quest to save the Eighth Era, collecting powerful champions is essential. Unlock legendary heroes from forgotten worlds, recruit mythical creatures, and forge alliances with mighty warriors. Each champion brings unique abilities and strengths to your squad, offering endless possibilities for customization and strategy.
Earn Real-World Rewards: Triumph in Solo Tournaments
In Eighth Era, fight your way to the top of the leaderboard for the chance to win physical rewards: real-life coins! With new tournaments always on the horizon, players of all skill levels have a shot at building a treasure trove of exclusive collectibles.

bluejetty:00015637:ios.summary: Brought to you by Fetyaton Amanou and Designed & Developed by Massyve.tech, a beautiful and ad-free Holy Quran application with the latest available mobile technologies. The app is specially designed to both display and provide audio for th
bluejetty:00015637:ios.description:
Brought to you by Fetyaton Amanou and Designed & Developed by Massyve.tech, a beautiful and ad-free Holy Quran application with the latest available mobile technologies. The app is specially designed to both display and provide audio for the Holy Quran and its explanation by Sayid Abbas Ali Al Mousawi in a simple and interactive way.
We hope this app will increase your blessings in this world and the hereafter. We will be working on updating the app regularly and would love to hear your feedback and feature requests. You can reach us at support@massyve.tech
Key Features:
1- Browse by Soura & Juz'.
2- Listen to your favorite reciter from the wide variety of world famous reciters.
3- Read or listen to 3 different Quran explanations (أوضح البيان في تفسير القرآن للسيد عباس علي الموسوي, تفسير الميزان للسيد الطباطبائي, تفسير الأمثل الشيخ ناصر مكارم الشيرازي).
4- View "لفتة" for special golden verses.
5- Click on any green keyword to view its meaning.
6- View all keywords meanings for each a page.
7- Worldwide daily prayer times and notifications with full customization to your preference.

Yatzy Arena is a game of luck, risk and quick decisions multiplayer dice game. Make the highest total score and win the game against your opponent.

bluejetty:00073406:ios.description:
We are Nashville’s leading source of local news because we know this: If it’s important to you, it’s important to us. Music, jobs, transportation, government, economic news, education, the Predators and the Titans, plus expert opinions on all your favorite subjects. 
We’re our community’s trusted storytellers. We’re here for it. 
 WHAT WE’RE ALL ABOUT: 
• Impactful insider coverage of Nashville politics that keeps the government in check. 
• Journalism that makes our home better by celebrating the good, solving the bad, and investigating the ugly. 
• Music city coverage and what it means for Nashvillians (transplants and unicorns alike). 
• Award-winning sports coverage that makes sense of every move and the strategy behind them and always puts the wins and losses in context. 
• Expert guides to our dining scene, plus reviews of the Top 25 restaurants in Nashville. 
• App features like real-time alerts, challenging puzzles and lively podcasts, a personalized feed, the eNewspaper, and more. 
APP FEATURES: 
• Real-time breaking news alerts 
• A personalized feed on the all-new For You page 
• The eNewspaper, a digital replica of our print newspaper 
Subscription Information: 
• The Tennessean app is free to download, and all users can access a sampling of free articles every month. 
• Subscriptions are charged to your account at confirmation of purchase and automatically renew each month or year, unless turned off in your account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. See "Subscription Support" in the app's Settings for more details and customer service contact information.  
MORE INFORMATION: 
• Privacy Policy: https://cm.tennessean.com/privacy/ 
• Terms of Service: https://cm.tennessean.com/terms/ 
• Help Center: https://help.tennessean.com

bluejetty:00132171:ios.description:
Daily Countdown is the ultimate event tracker and days counter for life's most important moments. Track the days until your wedding, the hours until vacation, or the time since your sobriety milestone. This powerful app acts as your personal retirement timer and anniversary tracker, ensuring you never miss a due date or important holiday.
Add unlimited countdowns, use beautiful Home Screen widgets, and keep everything synced across devices with iCloud.
Key Features:
• Widget Support: Display your top countdowns directly on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• All Event Types Supported: Countdown to wedding, baby due date, exams, retirement, sober milestones, holiday trips, or any goal you want to achieve.
• Event Countdown Lists: View all your events in one place. Drag to reorder and focus on what matters most.
• Themes & Personalization: Customize your countdown background, layout, and fonts to match your mood or the occasion.
• Flexible Notifications: Schedule alerts minutes, hours, days, or even months in advance for each countdown. Get repeat alerts daily, weekly, or at custom intervals.
• Cloud Sync: Access the same countdown lists on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud.
• Event Notes: Add details, links, or ideas to each countdown.

You can manage your subscriptions in the Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00185129:ios.description:
Step into a wild, dangerous world full of giant monsters and unpredictable challenges. In this survival game, your mission is to hunt fearsome creatures, gather resources, and stay alive in a land where danger lurks around every corner. Each monster is unique, with its own strengths, weaknesses, and behavior. You’ll need to observe them, plan your attacks, and use the environment to your advantage.
Survival isn’t just about fighting. You’ll need to gather food, craft tools, and build shelters to protect yourself from harsh weather and wild creatures. Explore vast areas, including dense forests, scorching deserts, and icy mountains, each filled with secrets and rare materials to collect. These materials can be used to craft stronger weapons and armor, helping you take on even bigger challenges.
Play alone or join friends in multiplayer mode to hunt together. With stunning landscapes, intense battles, and endless adventure, this game offers the ultimate test of survival and skill.

bluejetty:00091653:ios.description:
RentCheck helps Property Operators, Owners, and Residents.
SAVE TIME
Keep your properties at your fingertips! Grow your business utilizing fully remote property inspections from a mobile device. Request and track routine property inspections that residents will complete on their own. 
RentCheck will walk residents through an easy-to-follow guided inspection and checklist. Residents will take the photos, check appliances, evaluate each room’s condition, add notes, and create an unalterable and time-stamped record of the property’s condition.
MINIMIZE COSTS
Prevent unexpected repairs and ensure your properties are in tip-top shape. Organize and schedule move-out inspections to enable faster turnover; take the pain out of security deposit deductions.
AVOID STRESS AND FRUSTRATION
Organize all property and inspection reports in one place! All data collected is available the moment needed; stored securely and safely via the Cloud. 
Complete and accurate inspection documentation means less conflict at move-out. Eliminate disputes over security deposit deductions. 
SEAMLESS INTEGRATIONS
Simplify your workflow! We currently partner with AppFolio, Rent Manager, Zapier and Latchel. 
Our integrations offer work order creation, inspection automation and link directly to your property management software.Easily get data in and out - pull in property and resident data, schedule inspections, and then take action once inspections are completed.
Build your own integration with RentCheck API, we’ll support you every step of the way!
Residents
PEACE OF MIND
Complete inspections on your own without having to coordinate with your landlord. Our simple standardized guided walkthrough process covers all the bases and makes completing inspections easy. 
Take photos, check appliances, evaluate each room’s condition, and add notes to create an unalterable and time-stamped record of the property's condition all from your mobile device. 
MAXIMIZE THE RETURN OF YOUR SECURITY DEPOSIT
Securely share inspection reports with time-stamped images and notes anytime. Easily transfer inspection updates to your property manager for greater transparency and a faster return.
PREVENT SECURITY DEPOSIT DEDUCTIONS
Complete and accurate inspection documentation prevents disagreements over property conditions at move-out. Inspection reports & data are backed up via Cloud and are available the moment you need them.

FIND A MEETING

• Just for Today and A Spiritual Principle a Day: today's reading, with no connection needed.
• A private, fillable version of the IP #9 daily inventory. You can keep your own copy as a PDF.
• Read NA booklets and informational pamphlets.
• Listen to recordings of the Basic Text and other NA literature, even with the screen locked.
CLEAN TIME
• Count your clean time, with an optional reminder on your anniversary. Your clean date stays on your phone.
STAY CONNECTED
• NAWS News and Reaching Out.
• NAWS events and webinars.
• Get Involved: focus groups, surveys and issue discussion topics.
• Contribute to NA World Services, shop the NAWS store, and visit na.org.
YOUR PRIVACY
• No account, no sign-in, no ads.
• The app sends NAWS usage statistics and error reports so we can see what is used and fix what breaks. You can turn either off at any time in Preferences.
• Privacy Policy: https://na.org/privacy-policy/
• Terms of Use: https://na.org/naws-terms-of-use/
