bluejetty:00068721:ios.description:
Experience the Gujarati Panchang 2027 App : a Hindu calendar, redesigned for today’s generation, rooted in timeless tradition.
As we step into our 10th year, we thank our loyal users across the world. Your support inspires us to keep offering this app completely free, year after year!
Quick Highlights
* Instantly view Day, Date, Tithi, Sunrise-Sunset timings, and feature of the day on your dashboard and the widget
* Get notifications for all major festivals and vrats
* Works offline after first download
* Available in English, Hindi, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Gujarati too
Key Features of Gujarati Panchang 2027 (Sanatan Calendar)
Detailed Tithi Information
Every date includes complete tithi details from the Amavasyant system, displayed clearly in Gujarati.
Monthly Festivals Highlighted
Easily keep track of all celebrations, each month highlights upcoming festivals and vrats so you can plan in advance.
Listed Public Holidays
Public holidays are indicated and listed for multiple states, helping you schedule family trips or special gatherings.
Reminders
Set a custom reminder for any day and time : useful for remembering vrats, pujas, or important family occasions.
Insights from Hindu Dharma
Short, practical notes from Sanatan Dharma help you bring spirituality into your daily routine.
Arogyam : Your Wellness Guide
Learn how to live a healthy, happy, and balanced life through Ayurvedic tips and time-tested lifestyle guidance.
Daily Inspirational Quotes
Start every morning with a thoughtful quote that spreads positivity and guides you through the day.
Share what you like on WhatsApp, Facebook, or other social apps.
More Features You’ll Love
* 2027 Dindarshika – High-resolution monthly pages from January to December 2027 (plus last 3 months of 2026)
* Muhurtas – Find auspicious dates for marriage, upanayan, and more
* Panchang Details – Know the Tithi, Yog, Nakshatra, and Karan for each day
* Festival Articles – Learn the meaning and rituals underlying every Hindu festival
* Sankashti Chaturthi – Accurate moonrise timings for major Indian cities
* State-wise Holidays – Updated list of public holidays for multiple states across India
* Share Easily – Forward any article, festival info, or tithi with one tap
* Printed Calendars – Order your Sanatan Panchang 2027 hard copy for home or office
The Gujarati Panchang 2027 App is not just a calendar, it is your daily guide to spiritual living.
Your feedback helps us grow! So please share your thoughts and suggestions with us anytime on contact@sanatanpanchang.com

bluejetty:00183584:ios.description:
baha - the information company
Real-time prices, historical data, intuitive analytics – track your portfolio, get price alerts and receive 24/7 global news straight to your phone with our market-leading mobile app. 
All your US & international market information needs covered in one innovative app.
Get access to free live quotes and push prices from markets around the world, including quality news from our newsroom, company profiles, full screen real-time charts, stock screener, currency converter and much more. Full personalization possible with custom watchlists, portfolios and price-based push alerts. 
REAL-TIME DATA & LIVE SEARCH
- Live quotes with push prices - no manual reloading of the data is necessary!
- Powerful live search featuring our huge data universe - look up your individual symbols 
- Current news updates for global events 
- Covers markets around the world (stocks, futures, indices, commodities, currencies…)
PRE-DEFINED MARKET OVERVIEWS & EXTENSIVE DETAIL PAGES
- Overviews of most popular symbols for Markets, Commodities, Indices, Currencies, Interest Rates, Hot Stocks
- Extensive detail view for each symbol based on symbol type (stock, commodity, currency etc.) 
- Arbitrage lists: View a symbol on different markets
- Company profiles & company news for stocks
- Related futures/options for a symbol
PORTFOLIO
- Multiple personal portfolios to keep track of your gains and losses
- Define the starting capital, portfolio currency, fees, deposits and redemptions 
- Add / remove symbols with simulated buy/sell transactions (incl. fees & comments)
- Show profit/loss per position and for complete portfolio
- Share your portfolio with our other mobile apps (e.g. for iPad) 
PERSONAL WATCHLISTS
- Customisable price lists for monitoring your assets
- Real-time prices with many display options (Last & Change%, Performance View, QuoteBoard, Chart View and more)
REAL-TIME PUSH ALERTS
- Automatically triggered price-based notifications
- Daily e-mail notifications about a customised list of securities 
- Alerts sent automatically by Apple Push 
- E-mail alerts and text messages
ADVANCED REAL-TIME CHARTING & TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
- Track price movements on our interactive full screen charts 
- Candlesticks, OHLC Bars, Mountain or Line charts (incl. Volume)
- Timeframes: Daily, Weekly, Monthly or Intraday (1 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 30 / 60 Minutes)
- Linear, percentage or logarithmic scaling available
- Additional features like zooming, crosshair, chart templates, benchmark comparison 
- Supports the most popular indicators for technical analysis, like Moving Average, ADX, Average True Range, Bollinger Bands, CCI, Directional Movement Plus/Minus, DM System, Envelopes, Highest High, Lowest Low, Ichimoku, MACD, Momentum, Money Flow Index, OBV, Price Change, Parabolic SAR, ROC, TRIX, Volatility, RSI,...
STOCK SCREENER 
- Easy picking of the most promising securities out of thousands 
- Covering the world's major stock exchanges 
- Performance filters (Change %, Performance 1 Week, 1 Month, 3 Months, 6 Months,1 Year, 3 Years, 5 Years, 10 Years)
- Fundamental filters like market cap, EBIT, EBITDA, net income & turnover
CURRENCY CONVERTER
- Easy-to-use calculator using current rates from major world currencies (also includes Bitcoin)
- Online and offline
MARKET COVERAGE
- Major Stock markets & Indices, like Nasdaq, Dow Jones, S&P 500, S&P 100, FTSE 100, DAX, EuroStoxx 50, Nikkei 225 etc.
- Commodities markets, incl. precious metals (gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper), energy, agricultural and livestock products
- Futures / Options markets, for example CME, CBOT etc.
- Major Currency pairs, such as EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY etc. as well as Bitcoin rates (BTC/USD) 
- Interest Rates, Bonds, ETFs
- Free real-time data (where available) 
- Additional real-time data packages from your baha Terminal accounts

bluejetty:00077603:ios.description:
The world's most popular free-flight app!
The most comprehensive source for site info, forecasts, webcams, photos & more!
See where you can fly right now. Worldwide!
▪ Explore over 15,000 launch sites, 7,500 landings, 30,000 weather stations and 39,000 webcams.
▪ Official data from the DHV, Flyland, FFVL, Paragliding Earth and more.
▪ Forecasts from Meteoblue, Windy and WindFinder.
▪ Live webcams.
▪ Photos give you a great impression of each spot.
▪ Valley winds - Arrows show valley wind directions in the European Alps.
▪ Wind animation - View clouds, thunderstorms, rain and wind at different altitudes.
▪ Airspace - View airspace and NOTAMs (short notice, daily airspace restrictions) on the map.
▪ Official NOTAMs - View Notices to Airmen (NOTAMs) on the map from international aviation authorities. A vital safety feature for every flight!
▪ Automatic NOTAM warnings - A prominent warning is displayed when an active NOTAM impacts your launch or landing.
▪ Filter the map to show only launches for paragliding, hang gliding, speed flying, thermalling, soaring, hike & fly, public transport, wind speed and much more!
▪ See soaring index, cloud cover, weather warnings and much more!
▪ Many forecast providers: UK MetOffice, German Weather Service, Meteo France, meteoblue, ECMWF, NOAA and others!
▪ Real-time weather station data from Pioupiou, Holfuy, MADIS and FFVL show you actual weather conditions.
▪ 3D view.
▪ "Hike & fly" trails.
▪ Ski lifts, cable cars and gondolas.
▪ Automatic translation of site descriptions into English.
▪ See future flying conditions on the map by using the Time Travel Slider.
▪ Directions to each spot using navigation.
▪ Favourites can be saved for easy access later.
▪ Alerts - Receive push notifications the evening before selected launches are flyable.
▪ Advanced search.
▪ Send “SOS!” and “I need a ride” messages to friends, including your GPS coordinates.
▪ Links to original info from the DHV, Flyland, FFVL und Paragliding Earth.
▪ No advertising.
▪ Full support included.
Your feedback is always welcome. Help us to make the best paragliding app in the world!
Many feature of Paragliding Map are free but supported by advertising. If you choose to make any in-app purchase, advertising will automatically turn off and your purchase will be enabled (webcams, forecasts, etc). 
Information about subscriptions:
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will auto-renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and will renew for the same price as the original subscription. You can cancel your subscription after purchasing by clicking the "manage subscriptions" button within the app or by opening Account Settings on your device. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing the subscription.
Paragliding Map is a fully supported product. If you have any problems, please let me know and I will help you personally.
Privacy policy and terms and conditions can be found at https://www.paraglidingmap.com/TermsAndConditions.aspx

bluejetty:00086606:ios.summary:
Martı: TAG & Scooter
With Martı, you can travel in the comfort of a private vehicle using TAG, request a courier to deliver your packages, or move around the city easily with scooter, mobilet, or moped.
Martı is a transportation app that
bluejetty:00086606:ios.description:
Martı: TAG & Scooter
With Martı, you can travel in the comfort of a private vehicle using TAG, request a courier to deliver your packages, or move around the city easily with scooter, mobilet, or moped.
Martı is a transportation app that lets you get wherever you want, whenever you want, in the way that suits you best. With the TAG option, you can request a private vehicle and reach your destination comfortably. With the Courier option, you can quickly send or receive your packages, or you can choose an electric vehicle (scooter, mobilet, or moped) to travel in a fun, fast, and environmentally friendly way.
Don’t waste your valuable time in traffic, don’t be late meeting your friends, don’t walk long distances after getting off public transport, and don’t rush to catch a minibus. Martı is by your side with technology and convenience. As one of the most environmentally friendly transportation options on the streets, Martı offers affordable, on-demand, and enjoyable scooter, mobilet, and moped ride experiences. If you prefer to travel faster and in the comfort of a private vehicle, you can request a ride with TAG and go wherever you want.
How to use TAG?
- Download the MARTI: TAG & Scooter app!
- Open the TAG section when the service is available in your area.
- Set your destination.
- Select the vehicle type and tap “LET’S GO.”
- Travel to your destination in the comfort of a private vehicle.
- Request TAG, get picked up, and go!
How to use Martı Courier?
- Download the MARTI: TAG & Scooter app.
- Open the Courier tab when the service is available in your area.
- Set the sender or receiver address.
- Select the courier type and tap “Create Delivery.”
- Your courier arrives within minutes and delivers your package.
How to use Martı Scooter, Mobilet, or Moped?
- Download the MARTI: TAG & Scooter app!
- Check nearby vehicles (scooters, mobilets, mopeds) on the map and find the closest one.
- Tap “START RIDE”, scan the QR code, and start your ride.
- If you are using a Martı Scooter, push off with your foot and press the throttle to move.
- If you are using a Martı Mobilet, close the side stand and twist the throttle on the right handle.
- If you are using a Martı Moped, wear your helmet, release the center stand, and twist the throttle.
- Enjoy your ride and always follow traffic rules.
- When ending your ride, park according to the rules and take a photo showing the entire vehicle (scooter, mobilet, or moped) to complete the ride.
When can you use Martı?
You can use Martı whenever you want. Please remember to follow traffic rules while riding a Martı Scooter, Martı Mobilet, or Martı Moped.
Would you like to see TAG, Martı Scooter, Mobilet, or Moped in your city? Or do you have suggestions to share with us?
Contact us at support@marti.tech
.
Make city transportation easier by riding rentable electric vehicles or request TAG and travel anywhere in the comfort of a private vehicle.

bluejetty:00156139:ios.description:
Tulare County FCU is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Tulare County FCU:
 -Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
 -Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
 -Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
 -Transfer money between your accounts
 -Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
 -Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
 -View and save your monthly statements
 -Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the TCFCU Mobile Banking app, you must be enrolled as a Tulare County FCU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00151436:ios.name: Megaphone & Microphone
bluejetty:00151436:ios.summary: Need your voice to carry? Megi is a megaphone and microphone app: talk into your iPhone's microphone and your voice plays live through a Bluetooth speaker. Turn your iPhone and any Bluetooth speaker into a portable megaphone for classes, to
bluejetty:00151436:ios.description:
Need your voice to carry? Megi is a megaphone and microphone app: talk into your iPhone's microphone and your voice plays live through a Bluetooth speaker. Turn your iPhone and any Bluetooth speaker into a portable megaphone for classes, tours, events and parties.
YOUR PHONE AS A MEGAPHONE
Connect a Bluetooth speaker, tap to talk and speak into your phone's microphone. Megi sends your voice from the phone microphone to the Bluetooth speaker as you talk, so the two work together as a megaphone or a simple PA system. A wired speaker works too, with a cable or adapter to your phone.
USE MEGI AS A
• Live microphone for any Bluetooth or wired speaker
• Megaphone through a Bluetooth speaker at tours, sports and events
• Voice amplifier for classes, presentations and meetings
• Voice changer for parties
ECHO CANCELLATION
A microphone and a speaker in the same room can cause echo and howling. Echo cancellation in Megi has three levels – low, medium and high – so you can set it for your room and keep your megaphone voice clearer on any Bluetooth speaker.
VOICE CHANGER
Change how your megaphone voice sounds on the Bluetooth speaker with deep voice, chipmunk, robot and more voice effects. Great for parties, games and fun announcements.
WHO IS MEGI FOR?
Teachers, tour guides, presenters, coaches, event hosts and anyone who needs a megaphone or a microphone and has a Bluetooth speaker at hand.
QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS
Can I use my iPhone as a megaphone?
Yes, with a separate speaker. Megi doesn't make the iPhone itself louder: you talk into its microphone and a Bluetooth or wired speaker you connect plays your voice, so together they work as a megaphone.
How loud is the megaphone?
As loud as the speaker you're connected to. Megi plays your voice through it, so a bigger Bluetooth speaker gives you a louder megaphone.
Is there a megaphone app for iPhone?
Yes. Megi is a megaphone app for iPhone: connect a Bluetooth or wired speaker and Megi plays your voice through it.
How do I use my iPhone as a microphone for a Bluetooth speaker?
Pair the Bluetooth speaker with your iPhone, open Megi and tap to talk into the microphone. Your voice plays through the speaker while you speak.
Does Megi work with wired speakers?
Yes. Connect it to your phone with a cable or adapter and use Megi as a wired microphone or megaphone.
Do I need a special microphone?
No. Megi uses your phone's built-in microphone, so all you need for a megaphone is your phone and a Bluetooth or wired speaker.
How do I stop echo and feedback?
Turn on echo cancellation and pick low, medium or high. Keeping the Bluetooth speaker away from the phone's microphone helps too.
Can I change my voice?
Yes. The voice changer adds deep voice, chipmunk, robot and more effects to your megaphone voice.
Can I use Megi with headphones?
Yes. With headphones, Megi plays what your phone's microphone picks up, so you can hear the sounds around you louder.
Download Megi, connect any Bluetooth speaker and make it your megaphone, with your phone as the live microphone!
Privacy Policy: https://mrjohn10.github.io/megi/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://mrjohn10.github.io/megi/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00062637:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
SKIDOS Pirates:
The pirates have plundered your swag! Show those scurvy dogs who the real pirate is!
Aim your cannon and fire down the thieving pirates to reclaim your stolen swag. Shoot them quickly before they bounce away with your precious treasure, but remember to dodge their cannonballs.
Features:
* Sail around five different worlds - beat the 21 levels and the five bosses!
* Shoot the pirates before they bounce away!
* Choose between ten different ships – and a bathtub!
* Upgrade your cannon to make it a deadly pirate destroyer!
* Spend your swag on lethal power-ups, ships and cannon upgrades!
__
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00063545:ios.description:
The Hilton Head Island Packet newspaper app is faster and easier to use. Read or watch daily local news coverage, investigative reporting, national headline news, crime, sports, local business, and more from Hilton Head Island, Bluffton, Hardeeville, Beaufort, and communities across the South Carolina Lowcountry.
The Island Packet is your trusted source for local, daily journalism serving coastal South Carolina. Our newsroom provides reporting on local government, public institutions, public safety, education, business, and community issues affecting residents throughout the Lowcountry, alongside statewide coverage and national headline news.
LOCAL NEWS
• Daily local news and stories from Hilton Head, Bluffton, Hardeeville, Beaufort, and the Lowcountry
• AI generated summaries on all articles reviewed by our newsroom
• The Hilton Head Island Packet newspaper opinions, editorials and columns
• Edition, a digital destination providing a complete daily report of local, statewide, national, and world news curated overnight by our editors
LIVE VIDEO
• Watch live video of local news stories and major national news coverage
• View photos and videos from local reporting and community events
LOCAL SPORTS
• Full coverage reporting on local, pro and college sports teams
• Stay connected to your favorite teams and favorite sports writers
PERSONALIZATION
• Stay informed on the topics and articles that matter to you
• Favorite topics to get personalized feeds
• Search for news articles, videos, games and more
• Bookmark news articles to read later
• Read articles your way with full support for dark mode and light mode
Other Features
• Browse articles by category
• Share articles on Facebook, X Twitter or by email
• Comment on news articles
• Access and download previous issues of our newspaper
• Recharge and unwind with puzzles and games

bluejetty:00087540:ios.description:
Discover the Vivo TV app
Watch your favourite content wherever and whenever you like. Access live channels, films, series and programmes all in one place.
How to access it
Log in using the account holder’s CPF and your Vivo app password to watch on your mobile, tablet, computer or Smart TV.
Available content
On the Vivo TV app, you’ll find:
• Live channels
• Films and series
• TV programmes
• Over 25,000 on-demand titles (depending on your subscription plan).
Integration with streaming partners
Find content from partners such as Amazon Prime Video, Disney+ and others directly on Vivo TV, with simpler, more integrated navigation.
Access for Vivo customers
Vivo Pós, Controle, Fibra and TV customers have access to over 20 live channels at no extra cost.
More subscription options
Vivo Pós, Controle and Fibra customers can also subscribe to the Vivo TV Inicial and Vivo TV Estendido packages.
Find out more at: https://vivo.com.br
Required permissions
To provide the best experience, Vivo TV requests certain permissions:
• Location: required to correctly display some local channels.
• Notifications: used to send news and content recommendations.
Customer service
Need help?
Our live chat service is available Monday to Friday, from 8 am to 10 pm:
• Chat: https://vivo.tl/chat_app
Other customer service channels are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week:
• Email: suporte.vivotv.br@telefonica.com
• Customer Service Centre: 10315
• Support for people with hearing impairments: 142

bluejetty:00136028:ios.name: BoBo World: Vacation Game
bluejetty:00136028:ios.summary:
BoBo World: Vacation Game is a creative vacation pretend play game where kids can travel with BoBo, explore colorful holiday scenes, collect hidden treasures, save travel memories, and create their own holiday stories.
Start a joyful trip
bluejetty:00136028:ios.description:
BoBo World: Vacation Game is a creative vacation pretend play game where kids can travel with BoBo, explore colorful holiday scenes, collect hidden treasures, save travel memories, and create their own holiday stories.
Start a joyful trip across different vacation destinations. Relax in a hot spring cabin, ride the travel train, play on a tropical beach, visit a snowy ski resort, discover Atlantis under the sea, explore a magical wonderland, and enjoy cultural fun in Earth Village.
Explore Vacation Destinations
Travel to different places and create your own holiday moments:
- Relax in the hot spring cabin
- Ride the travel train
- Play on the tropical beach
- Visit the snowy ski resort
- Discover underwater Atlantis
- Explore wonderland and Earth Village
- Create your own vacation stories
Every destination is designed for imagination, free play, and discovery.
Collect Hidden Treasures
Look carefully in every scene.
Find hidden travel coins and treasures as you explore. Collect items, discover surprises, and enjoy the fun of searching through each vacation spot.
Save Memories in Your Travel Album
A vacation is full of memories.
Open your travel album and view the photos collected during your journey. Record special holiday moments and build your own BoBo travel story.
Pretend Play Without Fixed Rules
BoBo World: Vacation Game is made for open-ended pretend play. Kids can move characters, interact with objects, explore different scenes, and make up stories in their own way.
Features
- Vacation pretend play game for kids
- Multiple travel destinations
- Hot spring, beach, ski resort, train, Atlantis, wonderland, and Earth Village
- Hidden travel coins and treasures to collect
- Travel album to save holiday memories
- Open-ended roleplay without fixed rules
- Colorful graphics and vivid sound effects
- Multi-touch support for playing together
BoBo World: Vacation Game is free to download. Some content is free to explore, and additional content can be unlocked through in-app purchases. Once purchased, unlocked content will be linked to your account.
If you have any questions during purchase or use, please contact us:
contact@bobo-world.com
Privacy Policy:https://privacy.kalegames.com/privacy/bobo-privacy.html#app=BoBo%20World%20Vacation%20Game
Term of Use: https://privacy.kalegames.com/privacy/bobo-eula-en.html

bluejetty:00145641:ios.summary: Retrica is a digicam filter camera app that recreates the Y2K CCD digital camera and 2000s point-and-shoot film look in real time. Retro color grading, film grain, and light leaks are applied before you shoot, not after. What you see in the
bluejetty:00145641:ios.description:
Retrica is a digicam filter camera app that recreates the Y2K CCD digital camera and 2000s point-and-shoot film look in real time. Retro color grading, film grain, and light leaks are applied before you shoot, not after. What you see in the viewfinder is what you save. 388 presets, 260+ of them free.
DIGICAM AND CCD PRESETS
Bring back the look of early 2000s digital cameras and disposable film: punchy saturated color, blown highlights, low-light grain, and the soft imperfection that modern phone cameras remove.
- Digicam: heavy saturation and coarse low-light grain from early CCD sensors
- Faded film: low saturation and soft contrast, disposable camera and lomo feel
- Cinematic: teal and amber color grading
- Warm analog: incandescent glow for indoor and evening light
- Monochrome: high-contrast black and white with visible film grain
- Clean and bright: modern presets for everyday shots
REAL-TIME CAPTURE
Every filter is applied live in the viewfinder before you press the shutter.
- Switch presets with a single tap while you frame the shot
- Light leaks, film grain, and vignettes for a lo-fi texture
- Timer, burst mode, flash, and front camera support
388 PRESETS, 260+ FREE
- Most filters usable without a subscription
- Save photos and videos with no watermark
- Favorites to manage the presets you use most
COLLAGE AND STUDIO
- Collage maker with retro stamps, vignettes, and grain
- Apply a different preset to each frame
- Double exposure: blend two shots into one film-style image
- Studio editing: exposure, color, and detail adjustments
- AI Beauty: natural portrait retouching that works with any preset
Vintage camera, retro filter, film camera look, digicam feel, disposable camera, and 35mm film, all covered in one app. Retrica introduced the first real-time camera filter in 2012 and has been downloaded over 600 million times.
FREE TO USE, WITH PRO OPTIONS
Retrica is free to download. You can use presets, capture photos and videos, and save without a watermark at no cost. Some features are part of Retrica Pro: saving custom presets, AI-powered enhancements, advanced editing tools, and exclusive preset packs.
SUBSCRIPTION PLANS
Retrica Pro is available as a Monthly or Annual subscription with auto-renewal enabled. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings.
Questions or feedback? Reach us at contact@retrica.co

Earn quick cash donating plasma with Parachute, the easiest way to get paid at a comfortable center near you. Get matched to your center, find the highest-paying appointments, and book in minutes. Track your earnings, bonuses, and donation history all in one secure app.
Earn with Parachute's side income app by donating plasma at licensed plasma centers.
Plasma donation is a regulated medical process. Parachute partners with verified plasma centers that follow strict health and safety standards. Donors are screened for eligibility, and every visit is supervised by trained medical professionals.
Get paid instantly for each donation on your Parachute card and earn up to $200 after 3 donations.
How our app works:
• Create your account
• Find plasma centers near you
• Check eligibility requirements
• Book visits and track donations.
• Manage all donations in one app.
Make a real medical impact: Donated plasma is used to create treatments for patients with immune disorders, trauma, and chronic conditions. Your donation directly supports therapies that save and improve lives.
The fastest way to get started: Whether you are donating for the first time or returning, Parachute makes it easy to find centers, understand the process, and donate.
Download Parachute to donate plasma and get paid while making a difference. Your payment gets instantly processed to your Parachute card every time you donate.
Requirements
• Donors must be 18-64 years old.

bluejetty:00019454:ios.description:
Discover Stickman Hook, the new MadBox game!
Tap to hook and make incredible jumps; Avoid every obstacle that stands in your way. Can you execute all these acrobatic tricks in a row like a boss?
In this game, embody the spider stickman.
Finish all the levels with the same agility as a spider.
For that, you just have to:
- Tap to hook and make incredible jumps
- Press your screen to hook your stickman with your grapnel and release to let go
- Avoid every obstacle that stands in your way
- Swing from hook to hook to pass all the levels
Thanks to the bumpers and your grapnel, execute acrobatic tricks and show your friends who is the boss! You think you can do better than a spider? Prove it!
The faster you go, the more amazing your tricks will be.
Why is Stickman hook so perfect?
- Because you can swing like a spider
- Because your stickman dances at the end of each game (We challenge you to reproduce his dance)
- Because there is a grappling hook (and grapples are cool, right?)
You LOVE Stickman Hook? Discover all the MadBox games here : https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/stickman-hook/id1435807944
You want to share videos or screenshoot of your best performance on Stickman Hook, post theme here: https://www.facebook.com/madbox.apps/
If you dance better than our stickman, please prove it! :sunglasses:: https://www.facebook.com/Stickman-Hook-343939029681779/
And obviously if you have any request, please, contact us : contact@madboxgames.io

bluejetty:00178241:ios.description:
RG Nacional GO é o aplicativo oficial de identidade digital do Instituto de Identificação da Polícia Civil do Estado de Goiás.
Agora você pode ter o seu RG Digital de Goiás sempre disponível no seu dispositivo celular. RG Nacional GO é um aplicativo gratuito que proporciona maior privacidade de dados, segurança e praticidade ao se identificar.
IMPORTANTE:
Para utilizar o RG Nacional GO, verifique se a sua carteira de identidade possui Código QR na parte interna (disponível no RG impresso emitido a partir de março de 2019).
A versão digital através do RG Nacional GO é válida em todo o território nacional e possui o mesmo valor jurídico da versão impressa.
Para a sua segurança, este aplicativo não pode ser utilizado em dois ou mais dispositivos ao mesmo tempo.
Confira os benefícios de se identificar no seu dia a dia através da versão digital:
Acesso ao seu RG Digital, independentemente de conectividade à internet, após a conclusão da primeira validação do documento;
Armazenamento e transporte das suas informações de identificação com maior segurança por meio de proteção biométrica e senha;
A versão digital dispensa cópia autenticada em cartório, uma vez que é válida assim como o documento impresso;
Identidade digital na palma da sua mão através do dispositivo celular para ter acesso a serviços de instituições públicas e privadas;
Inclusão e gerenciamento de documentos de identificação de filhos e dependentes no aplicativo;
Possibilidade de compartilhar cópia segura, assinada digitalmente com certificado digital, compatível e adequado aos padrões ICP-Brasil.
COMO UTILIZAR O RG DIGITAL:
Passo 1: Instale o aplicativo RG Nacional GO no seu dispositivo celular. Para o primeiro acesso, é necessário ter em mãos a versão impressa emitida após março de 2019.
Passo 2: Identifique o Código QR na parte interna do seu RG impresso e siga as instruções para validação do código e verificação biométrica do seu rosto.
Passo 3: Pronto! Agora é só aguardar a confirmação dos seus dados.
Em poucos minutos, o seu RG Digital estará disponível no seu dispositivo celular para maior praticidade e segurança.
O RG Nacional GO é um aplicativo oficial do Instituto de Identificação da Polícia Civil do Estado de Goiás desenvolvido através da prestação de serviço pela empresa Valid.
Copyright: @VALID

bluejetty:00145868:ios.description:
BikeMi is the bike sharing service of Milan Municipality.
Born to encourage the mobility of citizens and city users, bikeMi is easy, practical and ecological.
A real public transport service to be used for short trips, that combines innovation, design and sustainability.
The fleet is composed by bicycles with muscle pedaling, pedal assisted and with child seat. Choose your subscription and start your ride.
Use the app to find the stations near you and to unlock a bicycle, you can ride up to 2 hours.
You can save your trips into the Apple Health app so you'll get credited for the effort, if you're into that kind of thing. Give Health access via the account view within the app.
Enjoy the the city and respect the environment.

bluejetty:00061560:ios.description:
Carry the power of Microsoft Power Automate in your pocket. Boost your team's productivity with Microsoft's best-in-business workflow automation service. 
Use Power Automate to: 
Get a notification when you receive an email from your boss 
Record your work hours to a spreadsheet with the tap of a button 
Automatically download email attachments to cloud storage 
Capture, track, and follow up on sales leads, and connect to your CRM platform 
Get notified when a work item is updated 
And so much more! 
Key features: 
Trigger flows to run with just a tap 
Create and edit flows on the go 
View flow run details 
Monitor flow activity directly from your mobile device 
Grant approvals from the palm of your hand 
Send and receive push notifications 
Create a shortcut for an instant flow on your mobile device's home screen 
Hundreds of apps and services connect with Power Automate, including the following: OneDrive, Dataverse, Office 365, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, SAP, Twitter, JIRA, Google Drive, Azure, Dropbox, and more! 
Download the Power Automate for mobile app and start automating your tasks today!

bluejetty:00183709:ios.name: PillarX: Smart DeFi Wallet
bluejetty:00183709:ios.summary: PillarX app is a self-custodial Web3 wallet that makes it easy to manage your crypto, explore DeFi, and interact across multiple networks. It works as a secure smart-contract wallet supporting Ethereum, Polygon, Base, BNB Smart Chain, Optim
bluejetty:00183709:ios.description:
PillarX app is a self-custodial Web3 wallet that makes it easy to manage your crypto, explore DeFi, and interact across multiple networks. It works as a secure smart-contract wallet supporting Ethereum, Polygon, Base, BNB Smart Chain, Optimism and Arbitrum.
Designed as a multi-chain and user-friendly crypto wallet, PillarX gives you a simpler and smarter way to interact with Web3 without managing multiple wallets or switching networks.
Get started today with a wallet built for secure, flexible, and future-ready Web3 experiences.
Features:
- Cross-chain swaps. Swap tokens across supported networks with the in-app Offers Engine that helps you find the best available options.
- Pay gas with stablecoins. Make transactions on any supported chain without holding the native gas token like ETH or POL.
- Smart-contract security. Your assets are protected by secure smart-contract architecture in this self-custodial wallet, you stay in control of your keys.
- Multi-chain asset management. Manage assets across multiple EVM networks with one Web3 wallet and a unified address.
- Token insights. View trending tokens, essential data, and access audit information within the wallet.
- Automatic network handling. Interact with your assets without manually switching networks.
- Open-source & community-governed. PillarX is open-source and governed by PillarDAO, a decentralized community helping shape the app’s evolution.
Why PillarX?
- A secure, self-custodial, multi-chain crypto wallet built for Web3.
- Powered by smart-contract infrastructure and advanced account & chain abstraction technology.
- Made to simplify DeFi and make Web3 more accessible.
Connect with PillarX & our community!
Web: pillarx.app
X: x.com/PX_Web3
Discord: chat.pillar.fi
YouTube: www.youtube.com/c/PillarProject

bluejetty:00115458:ios.name: Photo Shield AI
bluejetty:00115458:ios.summary: There are photos of you and your family on websites you've never heard of. Private photos. Photos you forgot existed. Photos from past relationships. Old social media posts. Content you never uploaded yourself. Photos you didn’t know were p
bluejetty:00115458:ios.description:
There are photos of you and your family on websites you've never heard of. Private photos. Photos you forgot existed. Photos from past relationships. Old social media posts. Content you never uploaded yourself. Photos you didn’t know were public. PhotoShield puts you in control by finding these photos and helping remove them.
SEARCH THE INTERNET FOR YOUR PHOTOS 
Add yourself and your family members. PhotoShield scans the web and shows you exactly where photos appear with direct links to every site.
REQUEST REMOVAL WITH ONE TAP
Found photos you want gone? Request deletion directly through the app. PhotoShield sends your request to delete photos directly to the websites that host them. 
CONTINUOUS WEB MONITORING & ALERTS
We keep scanning for new photos of you and your family. Monthly reports show everything we find so nothing slips by unnoticed. Get ongoing alerts when new photos of you are found online.
SCAN YOUR PHONE FOR RISKS
Identify and protect sensitive photos on your device: private images, IDs, location data. All scanning stays private on your phone.
Secure Photo Album:
PhotoShield enables you to secure sensitive photos in a private, password-protected, hidden album within Apple Photos.
Location Data Removal: PhotoShield enables you to strip location metadata (EXIF data) from photos before you share them, enhancing photo safety for you and your family.
Privacy-First Design: PhotoShield’s mission is to put you in control of your photos everywhere and to ensure your privacy is protected. Find and control your photos across the web. 
If it's online, you deserve to know.
If you want it gone, now you can act.
*Some features require a paid subscription. 
Privacy Policy: https://photoshield.ai/privacy 
Terms of Use: https://photoshield.ai/terms

bluejetty:00186793:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00186793:ios.description:
Ready to put your brainpower to the test and sharpen your problem-solving skills?
Enter the exciting world of binary numbers with CodingGame, the ultimate challenge that tests your decimal-to-binary conversion skills like never before!
-- Why You’ll Love CodingGame --
 • Challenge your friends and set unbeatable records!
 • Over 125,000+ downloads in 54+ countries – join the global community!
 • Learn the binary system and boost your mental math skills.
 • Compete on leaderboards and climb to the top!
 • Unlock stunning themes and save wallpapers directly to your photo library.
-- How to Play --
Each position in the binary code represents a value: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 and so on. Your goal? Convert the given decimal numbers into binary as quickly as possible to score points. The faster you solve, the higher your score – can you outpace your friends and claim the #1 spot?
-- Key Features --
-* Sharpen Your Mind *-
CodingGame is perfect for both math enthusiasts and programming pros. Challenge your brain, improve problem-solving skills, and enjoy hours of addictive fun – all in one app!
-* New Themes and Rewards *-
Earn keys with every successful conversion and unlock exciting new themes and wallpapers. Customize your game and show off your unlocked wallpapers to friends and family.
-* Unlock Themes and Rewards *-
Compete globally, rise through the ranks, and prove you’re the ultimate binary code hacker. Play against friends, set new records, and feel the thrill of victory.
-* Climb the Leaderboards *-
With intuitive gameplay and addictive puzzles, CodingGame is suitable for all skill levels. Whether you’re a beginner learning binary numbers or an expert refining your skills, there’s something here for you.
-* Play for FREE *-
Enjoy the challenge of coding and decoding binary numbers at no cost. Download CodingGame today and start mastering binary numbers while improving your mental math every single day!
Assets by @Penzilla on itch.io
Have ideas to make CodingGame even better? We’d love to hear from you! Reach out at 
daniel@styrianapps.com – your feedback helps us improve.

bluejetty:00156988:ios.name: SkyMD 24/7 Telehealth
bluejetty:00156988:ios.summary: SkyMD is a national telehealth platform, specializing in multiple fields of medicine like dermatology and primary care, staffed with doctors that treat patients every day across America. With online dermatologists and primary care doctors i
bluejetty:00156988:ios.description:
SkyMD is a national telehealth platform, specializing in multiple fields of medicine like dermatology and primary care, staffed with doctors that treat patients every day across America. With online dermatologists and primary care doctors in all 50 US States, SkyMD's medical team of doctors is literally available to treat patients in every zip code, from infants to centenarians!
Our online group of doctors operates no differently than any traditional doctor's office, other than no appointments, and you having more time to interact with your doctor. SkyMD accepts most medical insurances, and treats the privacy of your medical data with utmost importance. Our medical professionals are all board certified doctors, with years of experience in preventing, diagnosing, and treating a wide range of skin conditions and primary healthcare.
As a group of practicing medical doctors, SkyMD also prescribes medications, the same as if you were evaluated by a doctor in person. Today's medical industry, along with State Boards of Medicine and the majority of private insurance networks, considers telemedicine as equal to being seen in person, and most medical insurance networks consider telemedicine as a covered medical benefit. Dermatology and primary healthcare are obvious and practical fit for the use of telemedicine. Your SkyMD doctor now has the flexibility to evaluate your uploaded photos, or converse with you in a video conference, or even recommend that you still see a doctor in person, depending on what's the right treatment model for each patient.
Access your dermatologist and primary care doctor anytime, anywhere at your fingertips.
Here's how SkyMD works:
1. Download the app (for free) and connect to your dermatologist or primary care doctor. Tell us where you live by entering your zip code, and we will recommend you a doctor, or you can also select any doctor from the wide range of options available, who are licensed to practice in your home state.
2. Take photos of your condition like, skin, hair or nail concern, and complete a medical intake comprised of a few simple questions about your primary concern, symptoms, medical history, allergies, and any other information that you like to tell us about. This will help the doctor to understand your condition better in detail and provide the necessary treatment to you.
3. Your doctor will evaluate your case, diagnose your condition, and recommend a personalized treatment plan, including prescriptions if necessary. You tell us where to send the prescription by choosing the pharmacy of your choice and we will do! Yes, your choice of pharmacy!
Common issues that can be diagnosed and treated through the SkyMD include but are not limited to,
Dermatology conditions:
Acne
Rosacea
Skin discoloration
Rash
Hyperhidrosis
Eczema
Psoriasis
Skin lesion
Nail issues
Hair loss
Skin aging
Cold sores
Eyelash thinning
Dandruff
Excessive sweating
Cosmetic procedure follow up
Surgical procedure follow up
Any other skin conditions you have
Primary Care Conditions:
Cold & flu symptoms
Allergies
Sinus-related symptoms
Cough, breathing or asthma symptoms
Sore throat / infections
Diabetes-related symptoms
Painful joints
Headache, migraine, ear ache
Back problems
Depression, fatigue, low energy, anxiety
Stomach bug, abdominal pain, cramps
Sprains, strains, bruises and wounds
Urinary / bladder symptoms
I just don't feel good overall.
Other issues that are not mentioned on this list
Trust your doctors and their medical training to ensure you receive proper and correct diagnosis, followed by an effective treatment plan.
SkyMD is a HIPAA-compliant encrypted platform. All your information is protected with advanced security measures.
Are you a dermatologist or a primary care doctor? Contact us at jobs@skymd.com to join our growing network of online doctors.

bluejetty:00163189:ios.name: Volotea
bluejetty:00163189:ios.summary: Welcome to the official app for Volotea, the airline that connects Europe’s small and medium sized cities with direct flights at very competitive prices. Using our app means you have everything in the palm of your hand: you can find the bes
bluejetty:00163189:ios.description:
Welcome to the official app for Volotea, the airline that connects Europe’s small and medium sized cities with direct flights at very competitive prices. Using our app means you have everything in the palm of your hand: you can find the best offers, and access your bookings and boarding passes, as well as checking the status of your flight at any time too.
BOOK A FLIGHT
Book your flights more simply and easily from your mobile. During the booking process, you can access your recent searches, go forward and back at any time, and access our best tariffs and exclusive offers from the Megavolotea subscription service too. You’ll also be able to access all extra services and view the breakdown of your flight price, including all the details.
FLIGHT CHANGES AND ADDITIONAL SERVICES
Make changes to your booking and book extra services without having to go to one of our desks at the airport. Remember, you can make changes to your booking up to 7 days before departure and with our Flex plan, you can make unlimited date and itinerary changes up to 4 hours before your flight departs, at no additional cost.
ACCESS YOUR BOOKINGS
You can easily view all your bookings in the “Your Journeys” section of our app. You can view flights booked through the app or through any of our other sales channels, including travel agencies or our website.
PASSENGER PROFILE
In order to save time and avoid filling in details repeatedly, our app lets you enter passenger information, contact details and payment automatically while you’re booking your flight. Complete your profile and speed up your bookings. You can even save your payment methods so you don’t have to enter them again. You can also check your Volotea Credit balance on your profile and use it for future bookings; they’re all benefits!
FLIGHT STATUS
Our app lets you check the status of your Volotea flights at any time. You only need to enter your route information or flight number to check its updated status at any time, with additional information on our aircraft and the services we offer.
MOBILE CHECK-IN (at airports with permitted access)
For greater convenience you can check in for your flights directly from your cell phone. Save printing your boarding pass and go straight to the departure gate. You can store your boarding passes straight into your Passbook or, if you prefer, you can download them conveniently on your mobile or tablet.
HOTELS, CARS, FLIGHT + HOTEL AND MUCH MORE ON YOUR DESTINATION
Through our application, you may also reserve rental cars and hotel rooms at your destination. The reservation process is adapted for your mobile device, making it easier to use. You can also access our partner’s deals directly. You will also be able to access the best content about our destinations on our Travel Blog, with reviews and interesting facts you might not know about your favourite destination.
AUTOMATIC NOTIFICATIONS
Receive our top offers via automatic notifications.

bluejetty:00114553:ios.name: CloudGear: PC Gaming Browser
bluejetty:00114553:ios.summary: CloudGear is the browser designed for gamers - custom-engineered to deliver the speed, visuals, and control that other browsers can't. Stream from GeForce NOW, Xbox Cloud Gaming, Amazon Luna, Boosteroid, or any browser-based game with perfo
bluejetty:00114553:ios.description:
CloudGear is the browser designed for gamers - custom-engineered to deliver the speed, visuals, and control that other browsers can't. Stream from GeForce NOW, Xbox Cloud Gaming, Amazon Luna, Boosteroid, or any browser-based game with performance and immersion mobile gaming has never had. Plug into a TV, monitor, or AR glasses and your iPhone or iPad becomes a portable gaming rig. No console required.
UNCOMPROMISED PERFORMANCE
- High-Resolution Gaming: Stream at up to 5K video on supported platforms.
- Smooth Frame Rates: Up to 120fps for fast, responsive gameplay - plus frame pacing that helps to eliminate stutter.
- Advanced Codec Support: H.265 and AV1 for efficient streaming at maximum quality.
- Low-Latency Streaming: A custom rendering engine built for speed. Frames display sooner and gameplay feels closer to native.
YOUR GAME, ANY SCREEN
- External Display & AR Glasses: Connect to a TV, monitor, or AR glasses like XREAL, Rokid, VITURE, or RayNeo via USB-C or HDMI. CloudGear outputs at native resolution with no black bars, turning your iOS device into a portable gaming rig you can plug in and play anywhere.
- Apple TV Companion: Pair your iPhone or iPad with the CloudGear app for Apple TV and hand games off to the big screen.
- HDR & 10-Bit Color: High dynamic range and rich color depth bring games to life the way developers intended.
- Configurable Video Sizing: Zoom, stretch, or manually position the stream to fill every inch of your display.
- Spatial Audio & Surround Sound: Support for 7.1 channel surround sound and spatial audio.
DESKTOP-CLASS GAMING CONTROLS
- True Mouse Pointer & Keyboard Lock: Get the precision you need with mouse pointer lock that makes your mobile experience feel like playing on desktop.
- Steam Controller: First-class Valve Steam Controller support - use its trackpad as a mouse, with full control remapping for keyboard-and-mouse only games.
- Controller Vibration: Full rumble for any connected controller. For controllers without motors, vibration routes through your iPhone's Taptic Engine.
- Touchscreen Mouse Controls: No mouse or controller? Touchscreen mode turns touch gestures into a mouse pointer.
- Universal Compatibility: Works with any iOS-supported Bluetooth or USB-C controller, plus external keyboards and mice.
QUICK LAUNCH & WIDGETS
- Quick Launch Bookmarks: Bookmark individual games and launch them with a single tap - no menus, no browsing.
- Home Screen Widget: Add any game to your iOS Home Screen as a widget for instant access.
- iCloud Sync: All bookmarks sync automatically across your devices via iCloud.
CloudGear works with major cloud gaming services and enables the best experience for each:
- GeForce NOW: Up to 5K @ 120fps, H.265 & AV1 codec, HDR, 10-bit color, 7.1 surround sound
- Boosteroid: Up to 4K @ 120fps, AV1 codec, HDR, custom resolution selection
- Xbox Cloud Gaming: Up to 1440p video, built-in Better xCloud script manager for higher bitrate, improved input, and more
- Amazon Luna: Up to 1080p @ 60fps, max resolution and bitrate unlocked even on iPhone
- OnePlay: Up to 4K @ 120fps
- HTML5 Gaming Sites: Full controller support, mouse pointer lock, and keyboard lock for browser-based games
Actual streaming quality depends on each service's capabilities and your account tier. CloudGear enables the maximum quality available.
Please note: CloudGear is a premium utility. A subscription or one-off lifetime purchase is required to access the browser and all features. A 7-day free trial is available for new subscribers.
Disclaimer: CloudGear is an independent application and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by GeForce NOW, Boosteroid, Amazon Luna, OnePlay or Xbox. It is simply compatible with these third-party services in its capacity as a general web browser.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.cloudgear.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00160844:ios.description:
Discover a smarter way to create, edit, and manage Google Forms with our revolutionary app! Designed for ease and efficiency, our app empowers users to seamlessly build and customize forms, surveys, and quizzes, elevating your form creation experience to new heights. Whether you're an educator, business professional, event organizer, or researcher, our app offers a comprehensive suite of tools tailored to meet your needs.
With our intuitive interface, creating Google Forms has never been easier. Effortlessly drag and drop question types, customize themes, and see real-time previews of your forms as you build them. Our app ensures that users of all technical levels can create professional-quality forms without any hassle. The A Series specifically covers exams A1 through A9, which focus on various aspects of automotive repair and service, including engine repair, automatic transmission/transaxle, manual drive train and axles, suspension and steering, brakes, electrical/electronic systems, heating and air conditioning, engine performance, and light vehicle diesel engines.
Our application helps you to prepare for ASE A Series test with the required domain knowledge. 
With our mobile apps, you can practice with systematic testing features and you can study with specialized content created by our exam experts, which will help you prepare to pass your exams more efficiently.

- Choose the topics you need to focus on
- Versatile testing modes
- Great looking interface and easy interaction
- Study detailed data for each test.

You need to purchase a subscription to unlock the full range of features, topics and questions. The purchase will be automatically deducted from your iTunes account. Subscriptions are automatically renewable and billed according to the subscription plan and rate you choose. The auto-renewal fee will be charged to the user's account no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term.
After you purchase a subscription, you can manage your subscription and cancel, downgrade, or upgrade your subscription at any time in your Account Settings in iTunes. Unused portions of the free trial period (if provided) will be canceled when the user purchases a subscription to the publication, if applicable.

bluejetty:00066306:ios.summary:
*SOLITAIRE NOW with MORE THAN 50+ CLASSIC THEMES* :) Your free themes are waiting!
Play Solitaire with its all classic graphics and gameplay! Customize your game with tons of settings and make the game your own. Earn coins and unlock gorge
bluejetty:00066306:ios.description:
*SOLITAIRE NOW with MORE THAN 50+ CLASSIC THEMES* :) Your free themes are waiting!
Play Solitaire with its all classic graphics and gameplay! Customize your game with tons of settings and make the game your own. Earn coins and unlock gorgeous classic themes. Get lost in the world of classic Solitaire!
Key Features:
• 3 Game Modes: Play the Normal, Vegas and Cumulative Vegas (Vegas+) classic Solitaire game modes
• Solvable Deals: Choose to play solvable deals with our solvable deal algorithm
• 50+ gorgeous classic themes: Unlock these themes with coins. Complete deals to earn coins
• Win Animations: See the classic card waterfall animations when you complete a game!
• No More Moves: The game will tell you if there are no more moves to play
• Card Speed: Choose from 5 different card animation speeds from slow to fast
• 3D Animations: Card pick up and placement animations along with haptic feedback provide a great gameplay feel
• Landscape mode: Landscape lovers for the win! You can play in landscape mode on any device but nothing beats playing Solitaire in landscape mode on a tablet, while watching your favorite show picture-in-picture
• Auto Complete: You probably don’t want to collect all the cards that are left on the board towards the end of a game so the cards will be automatically collected for you
• Auto Hints: You can choose the game to show hints automatically after a period of inactivity
• How To Play: Learn how to play Klondike Solitaire with visual tutorials
• Tons of Settings: Customize your game with different settings such as enabling/disabling Card Shadows, Auto Hints, Vibration and much more
• Lefty Support: Are you a lefty? You can choose to change the board layout for left handed play
• Swipe Gestures: Swipe left to undo, swipe right to redo and swipe down to show a hint
• Undo Forever: Press & hold Undo to perform a series of undos
• Save/Load: The game will automatically continue where you left off from when you launch the app
• Stats: Keep track of your high scores, best times, win percentage and other stats for each game mode
• Leaderboards: Compete with players from around the world with global leaderboards
Functions:
• Solvable Deals: Select the solvable deal option from the New Game window to play solvable deals. An algorithm will work for you to find a solvable game of your specified game type so an online connection is not needed for this feature to work
• Card Animations: You can choose different card animations from the Settings window. This includes stars, points and card placement animations
• Swipe Gestures: Swipe on an empty area to perform an action. Press and hold on an empty area to see the allowed swipe gesture area and the actions you can perform. Check out the How To Play window for a visual tutorial
• Controls Bar (Bottom Bar): Tap on an empty area or hold the bottom bar and swipe it down to hide the bottom controls bar. Swipe up or tap on empty area to show the bottom bar again
• Themes: You can select the deck, card back and background of a theme separately so you can mix and match elements of different themes. Unlock themes with the coins you earn by playing deals in Solitaire
Save & Restore your themes with Game Center:
• Save your themes by logging into Game Center so you can restore them if you happen to switch to a different device
• Make sure your themes are saved by checking your achievements. If an achievement is unlocked for a particular theme then that theme is saved

listings.description:
*SOLITAIRE NOW with MORE THAN 50+ CLASSIC THEMES* :) Your free themes are waiting!

Play Solitaire with its all classic graphics and gameplay! Customize your game with tons of settings and make the game your own. Earn coins and unlock gorgeous classic themes. Get lost in the world of classic Solitaire!

Key Features:
• 3 Game Modes: Play the Normal, Vegas and Cumulative Vegas (Vegas+) classic Solitaire game modes
• Solvable Deals: Choose to play solvable deals with our solvable deal algorithm
• 50+ gorgeous classic themes: Unlock these themes with coins. Complete deals to earn coins
• Win Animations: See the classic card waterfall animations when you complete a game!
• No More Moves: The game will tell you if there are no more moves to play
• Card Speed: Choose from 5 different card animation speeds from slow to fast
• 3D Animations: Card pick up and placement animations along with haptic feedback provide a great gameplay feel
• Landscape mode: Landscape lovers for the win! You can play in landscape mode on any device but nothing beats playing Solitaire in landscape mode on a tablet, while watching your favorite show picture-in-picture
• Auto Complete: You probably don’t want to collect all the cards that are left on the board towards the end of a game so the cards will be automatically collected for you
• Auto Hints: You can choose the game to show hints automatically after a period of inactivity
• How To Play: Learn how to play Klondike Solitaire with visual tutorials
• Tons of Settings: Customize your game with different settings such as enabling/disabling Card Shadows, Auto Hints, Vibration and much more
• Lefty Support: Are you a lefty? You can choose to change the board layout for left handed play
• Swipe Gestures: Swipe left to undo, swipe right to redo and swipe down to show a hint
• Undo Forever: Press & hold Undo to perform a series of undos
• Save/Load: The game will automatically continue where you left off from when you launch the app
• Stats: Keep track of your high scores, best times, win percentage and other stats for each game mode
• Leaderboards: Compete with players from around the world with global leaderboards

Functions:
• Solvable Deals: Select the solvable deal option from the New Game window to play solvable deals. An algorithm will work for you to find a solvable game of your specified game type so an online connection is not needed for this feature to work
• Card Animations: You can choose different card animations from the Settings window. This includes stars, points and card placement animations
• Swipe Gestures: Swipe on an empty area to perform an action. Press and hold on an empty area to see the allowed swipe gesture area and the actions you can perform. Check out the How To Play window for a visual tutorial
• Controls Bar (Bottom Bar): Tap on an empty area or hold the bottom bar and swipe it down to hide the bottom controls bar. Swipe up or tap on empty area to show the bottom bar again
• Themes: You can select the deck, card back and background of a theme separately so you can mix and match elements of different themes. Unlock themes with the coins you earn by playing deals in Solitaire

Save & Restore your themes with Game Center:
• Save your themes by logging into Game Center so you can restore them if you happen to switch to a different device
• Make sure your themes are saved by checking your achievements. If an achievement is unlocked for a particular theme then that theme is saved

Make sure you are logged into Game Center (if you are not automatically logged in):
• Click on the leaderboards button located in the Settings window
• If the game doesn't log you in or prompt a login window after a few seconds close the app
• Go to your device's settings and login to Game Center from there
• Open Solitaire and click on the leaderboards button again and it should log you in

Enjoy!

bluejetty:00046513:ios.description:
**SIMPLIFY YOUR APP LIFE WITH MYLIFEWELL: THE FIRST ALL-IN-ONE HEALTH & WELLNESS APP **
MyLifeWell is your one-stop app to lead a healthy lifestyle. From on-demand classes to mindfulness, guided workouts to nutrition tracking and group challenges to personal training, MyLifeWell combines all your health and wellness needs in one seamless platform thereby eliminating the need for subscribing to multiple platforms. Your wellness is so much more than a yoga pose, a dumbbell workout or 5-minute meditation. MyLifeWell offers multidimensional personalized wellness that supports you physically, mentally, and emotionally in your everyday life.
FEATURES:
CLASSES-ON-DEMAND
Access 2000+ videos to get you moving, from yoga to kettlebell workouts, HIIT to barre.
CUSTOM PROGRAMS 
Over 5000+ 3D videos of guided exercises. Whether your goal is to build muscle or to improve wellbeing, our library of programs will get you there.
MINDFULNESS
Our MindVibe meditations and mindfulness guides nurture your mental and emotional wellbeing, decreasing stress and anxiety.
NUTRITION
Track your nutrition and caloric goals by easily inputting meals, ingredients and barcodes. 
COMMUNITY GROUPS
Join groups of your interest to talk to group coaches and other like-minded group members. Share your progress with community members.
CHALLENGES
Join custom-designed challenges to meet your health and fitness goals. Challenge your friends and family, track your progress and earn badges.
PROGRESS TRACKER
Get insights from each activity and track your KPIs and SMART goals across the most popular wearable tech like Apple Health, Google Fit and Fitbit. Connects with NEO Health wearables.
PERSONALIZED 
Create a personalized workout or a personalized wellness calendar that works for your schedule. 
SHOPWELL
Exclusive discounts for app subscribers at our curated shop of clean, conscious, sustainable and ethical brands. From yoga mats to supplements, athletic wear to skin care, ShopWell has everything you need to support your healthy lifestyle.
TRAVELWELL
Priority access to exclusive wellness trips and promotions.
_______
COMPATIBLE WITH THE MOST POPULAR DEVICES
Apple Health, Google Fit, FitBit, NEO Health
_______
STREAM CLASSES WITH AIRPLAY
You can sync this app with Apple Health App. If you enable this connection, any workout in the Health app with automatically be added to your Activity Calendar.

bluejetty:00188128:ios.description:
"Waka – Ứng dụng đọc sách online và nghe sách nói hàng đầu Việt Nam.
Kho ebook, sách nói, truyện ngôn tình, truyện tranh bản quyền. Đọc sách miễn phí, nghe sách mỗi ngày, tải về đọc offline!
Waka mang đến hơn 20.000+ đầu sách điện tử và sách nói bản quyền, truyện ngôn tình, truyện thiếu nhi, sách phát triển bản thân, sách tương tác… được cập nhật mỗi ngày.
Cùng Waka xây dựng văn hóa đọc hiện đại và đồng hành trên hành trình mang tri thức đến gần hơn với độc giả.
Điểm nổi bật của Waka:
Waka sở hữu kho sách điện tử và sách nói phong phú, được cập nhật liên tục thuộc nhiều thể loại như ngôn tình, kinh doanh, khởi nghiệp, kỹ năng sống, thiếu nhi, lịch sử… Giao diện đọc đẹp mắt, dễ sử dụng, hỗ trợ chế độ nền tối dịu mắt, cùng tính năng tìm kiếm thông minh và lọc sách theo chủ đề, tác giả, thể loại giúp bạn nhanh chóng tìm được cuốn sách yêu thích. Người dùng có thể dễ dàng lưu sách vào thư viện cá nhân, tải về đọc offline, theo dõi lịch sử và thành tích đọc sách, đặt mục tiêu đọc mỗi ngày, và thậm chí đặt mua sách giấy ngay trong app. Ngoài ra, Waka còn là nơi lý tưởng cho những ai yêu sáng tác, với cộng đồng viết truyện và xuất bản sách dễ dàng. Đặc biệt, người dùng chưa đăng ký hội viên vẫn được truy cập vào kho sách điện tử miễn phí đa dạng, phù hợp cho mọi đối tượng độc giả.
1. Thư viện ebook khổng lồ
Hơn 20.000 đầu sách điện tử và sách nói đủ mọi thể loại: văn học, kinh doanh, kỹ năng, tâm lý, sách thiếu nhi, truyện tranh, v.v.
Có nhiều sách bản quyền chính thức, hợp tác với các nhà xuất bản lớn trong nước.
Giao diện đọc dễ sử dụng, hỗ trợ nền tối dịu mắt và tìm kiếm thông minh.
2. Đọc online & offline
Cho phép nghe, đọc sách khi không có mạng (sau khi đã tải về).
Đồng bộ dữ liệu đọc giữa nhiều thiết bị.
3. Giao diện cá nhân hóa thông minh
Gợi ý sách theo sở thích, thói quen và lịch sử đọc.
Điều chỉnh kích thước chữ, nền đọc, chế độ ban đêm phù hợp với mắt.
Tùy chọn đặt mục tiêu đọc mỗi ngày, theo dõi tiến độ và thành tích.
4. Sách nói
Giao diện nghe sách chuyên biệt, có tính năng đánh dấu, tua nhanh/chậm, hẹn giờ tắt.
Giọng đọc dễ nghe, chuyên nghiệp.
5. Sách ngoại văn & song ngữ
Kho sách ngoại văn được cập nhật liên tục, gồm các tựa best-seller quốc tế.
Tính năng dịch trực tiếp ngay trong lúc đọc, giúp bạn hiểu nghĩa từng đoạn mà không cần rời khỏi trang sách.
6. Chatbot AI – Trợ lý đọc sách thông minh
Tích hợp AI chatbot hỗ trợ gợi ý sách phù hợp với sở thích của bạn.
Có thể trò chuyện trực tiếp với AI để hỏi về nhân vật, cốt truyện hoặc khái niệm trong sách.
7. Tính năng đánh dấu & ghi chú
Cho phép đánh dấu trang, tạo ghi chú trong sách – phù hợp với người đọc học thuật hoặc nghiên cứu.
8. Cộng đồng đọc sách
Có mục đánh giá, nhận xét và bảng xếp hạng sách theo lượt đọc/thích, giúp chọn sách dễ hơn.
9. Đa nền tảng
Waka mang đến trải nghiệm đọc liền mạch trên mọi nền tảng - từ điện thoại, máy tính bảng đến laptop và trên trình duyệt web. Dù bạn ở đâu, chỉ cần một tài khoản, bạn có thể tiếp tục đọc sách yêu thích mọi lúc, mọi nơi mà không bỏ lỡ trang nào.

Waka sở hữu kho sách điện tử và sách nói phong phú, được cập nhật liên tục thuộc nhiều thể loại như ngôn tình, kinh doanh, khởi nghiệp, kỹ năng sống, thiếu nhi, lịch sử… Giao diện đọc đẹp mắt, dễ sử dụng, hỗ trợ chế độ nền tối dịu mắt, cùng tính năng tìm kiếm thông minh và lọc sách theo chủ đề, tác giả, thể loại giúp bạn nhanh chóng tìm được cuốn sách yêu thích. Người dùng có thể dễ dàng lưu sách vào thư viện cá nhân, tải về đọc offline, theo dõi lịch sử và thành tích đọc sách, đặt mục tiêu đọc mỗi ngày, và thậm chí đặt mua sách giấy ngay trong app. Ngoài ra, Waka còn là nơi lý tưởng cho những ai yêu sáng tác, với cộng đồng viết truyện và xuất bản sách dễ dàng. Đặc biệt, người dùng chưa đăng ký hội viên vẫn được truy cập vào kho sách điện tử miễn phí đa dạng, phù hợp cho mọi đối tượng độc giả.

Hơn 20.000 đầu sách điện tử và sách nói đủ mọi thể loại: văn học, kinh doanh, kỹ năng, tâm lý, sách thiếu nhi, truyện tranh, v.v.

Có nhiều sách bản quyền chính thức, hợp tác với các nhà xuất bản lớn trong nước.

Giao diện đọc dễ sử dụng, hỗ trợ nền tối dịu mắt và tìm kiếm thông minh.

2. Đọc online & offline

Cho phép nghe, đọc sách khi không có mạng (sau khi đã tải về).

Đồng bộ dữ liệu đọc giữa nhiều thiết bị.

3. Giao diện cá nhân hóa thông minh

Gợi ý sách theo sở thích, thói quen và lịch sử đọc.

Điều chỉnh kích thước chữ, nền đọc, chế độ ban đêm phù hợp với mắt.

Tùy chọn đặt mục tiêu đọc mỗi ngày, theo dõi tiến độ và thành tích.

4. Sách nói

Giao diện nghe sách chuyên biệt, có tính năng đánh dấu, tua nhanh/chậm, hẹn giờ tắt.

Giọng đọc dễ nghe, chuyên nghiệp.

Kho sách ngoại văn được cập nhật liên tục, gồm các tựa best-seller quốc tế.

Tính năng dịch trực tiếp ngay trong lúc đọc, giúp bạn hiểu nghĩa từng đoạn mà không cần rời khỏi trang sách.

6. Chatbot AI – Trợ lý đọc sách thông minh

Tích hợp AI chatbot hỗ trợ gợi ý sách phù hợp với sở thích của bạn.

Có thể trò chuyện trực tiếp với AI để hỏi về nhân vật, cốt truyện hoặc khái niệm trong sách.

Cho phép đánh dấu trang, tạo ghi chú trong sách – phù hợp với người đọc học thuật hoặc nghiên cứu.

Có mục đánh giá, nhận xét và bảng xếp hạng sách theo lượt đọc/thích, giúp chọn sách dễ hơn.

Waka mang đến trải nghiệm đọc liền mạch trên mọi nền tảng - từ điện thoại, máy tính bảng đến laptop và trên trình duyệt web. Dù bạn ở đâu, chỉ cần một tài khoản, bạn có thể tiếp tục đọc sách yêu thích mọi lúc, mọi nơi mà không bỏ lỡ trang nào.

bluejetty:00187698:ios.description:
Start your day with stillness and intention. Practicing Presence - A Christian Way is a completely free, easy-to-use app designed to help you deepen your connection with your inner life and God's spiritual energy. Through a guided, flexible morning meditation, this app provides simple, practical tools to cultivate presence and inner peace that will carry you through your entire day.
Key Benefits:
• Cultivate Inner Stillness: Find easier access to quiet and calm in a noisy world.
• Deepen Your Peace: Experience a heightened, lasting sense of spiritual grounding.
• Reduce Daily Stress: Release anxiety and catch negative thoughts quickly so you can return to presence.
• Embrace Growth: Gently lower your natural resistance to change.
App Features:
• Guided Morning Practice: A flexible meditation timer to center your day (choose from 15 minutes, 20 minutes, or an open-ended session).
• Hourly Reminders: Gentle nudges to take "Three Breaths" or ask "Three Questions," helping you reconnect with God's spiritual energy from 8 AM to 8 PM.
• Accessible Anywhere: Designed to make building a daily habit as frictionless as possible.
• 100% Free & Private: No account creation, no emails to enter, no ads, and absolutely no in-app purchases. Just pure, uninterrupted stillness.
Regular use helps enhance your overall well-being, renewing your spirit and serving as the peaceful foundation for all your daily activities.

*Display the remaining time until the next photo
*Share photos
*Add to favorite photos
*Delete photos
*Hide photos
*Add and remove photos from albums
*Check EXIF of the photo
【Other useful functions】
*Selectable background - black / white / blur (dark) / blur (light)
*Shortcut key support for iPad and Mac

When you want to look back on your memories or view your favorite photos.

It also has a photo deletion function and a favorites function, so you can organize your photos in a slideshow.
and more…

bluejetty:00179846:ios.description:
MOSSA On Demand delivers the industry’s most professional and enjoyable ways to exercise and move – with anytime access to at-home workouts and recoveries that fit anyone. Available at health clubs and YMCAs around the world, now available on demand!
With MOSSA workouts and recoveries, you’ll become a better mover, be more resilient, and feel better in your body. Whether you’re new to exercise looking for where to get started with fitness, or you’re an experienced athlete needing to push your performance, MOSSA delivers home workouts people love, music to keep you motivated, and results to keep you coming back. 
Your trial and subscription includes these popular and effective workouts:
• 3D30 – HIIT-style workout using Loaded Movement Training and the ViPR Pro
• ACTIVE – Cardio, strength, mobility, and core workout with dumbbells and a step
• ATHLETE30 – High intensity 30-minute athletic training
• BLAST – Athletic cardio and agility workout using a step
• CENTERGY – Yoga and Pilates-based mind-body strength and mobility workout
• CORE – Athletic core workout for athletes and new movers
• FIGHT – MMA-inspired, full-body, stress-relieving workout
• GROOVE – Cardio dance fitness workout you can do anywhere
• MOVE30 – Movement Health program focused on functional movements for real life
• POWER – Muscle and movement strength training workout using a barbell
• RIDE – 60-minute cardio cycling workout on a stationary bike
• R30 – 30-minute cardio cycling workout on a stationary bike
Many MOSSA workouts require no equipment at all, meaning you can get started exercising right away.
Why MOSSA?
Here’s what makes our workouts standout in a crowded industry, and what makes MOSSA On Demand the best value in streaming workouts.
• Moving millions. Our professionally developed and tested programs keep people motivated and moving in health clubs and YMCAs.
• Movement Health focus. MOSSA programs will help you improve your fitness and your Movement Health, which is your ability to live and move well in real life.
• Moving music. Each workout playlist is custom engineered to help you enjoy exercise and feel motivated to return to exercise, again and again. 
• Motivating coaches. Our instructors – the best coaches in fitness – lead every workout with enthusiasm and energy and options to keep you inspired and feeling successful.
• Metrics. Our workouts undergo the industry’s most comprehensive field-testing process to ensure every experience is effective and fun!
Your subscription includes: 
• Immediate access to hundreds of workouts and recoveries, or work-ins
• Duration options – 10 minutues, 30 minutes, and 60-minutes for most workouts
• Recoveries – work-ins – including De-Desk® Your Body, Move & Mobilize, and NIMBL Percussion Therapy
• A personalized workout calendar
• A Fitness Tracker app on Apple Watch
• A community of movers connected on social media
• Fitness challenges and giveaways
• World premiere Sneak Preview workouts
• Workouts you can download and save, no WiFi required
• Workout and wellness education
MOSSA includes Apple Watch
- You can track your workouts and meet your fitness goals.
- Monitor Stats during Workouts: View heart rate/calories burned on your watch & video player.
- HEALTH App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Health app (Healthkit) to track workouts, duration, calories burned, heart rate, and active energy. You choose the data you want stored, and you can change it anytime in the Health app.
- FITNESS App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Fitness App, and workouts contribute to your daily goals. View stats, share your activity, and get those Activity Rings!
For more information view our:
• Terms of Service: https://www.mossaondemand.net/pages/terms
• Privacy Policy: http://www.mossaondemand.net/pages/privacy
