bluejetty:00019223:ios.description:
Achieve victory by destroying, capturing, and upgrading your mechs to become the most powerful commander in the Mech robots online world. While playing the mech games, it's important to show your strength and proficiency to others in order to win battles.
Utilize various tactics, such as jumping on buildings, hiding behind shields, teleport robots behind the enemy's defense, to play in the style that you desire. As you progress, you will also earn daily rewards by leveling up.
Get ready for intense robot action in the game, which features both Assault Mode and Deathmatch Mode! In Assault Mode, players must work together as a team to complete objectives and defeat their enemies. In Deathmatch Mode, it's every robot for themselves as players battle it out for dominance on the battlefield.
Join the Mech Wars universe and experience the thrill of victory as you destroy your enemies and collect valuable mech scraps. With every victory, you'll earn free rewards that will help you become the ultimate mech commander!

bluejetty:00186694:ios.description:
IS YOUR CHILD OVERWHELMED BY THEIR EMOTIONS?
Anger, sadness, fear, frustration… Emotions can sometimes be difficult to understand and even harder to express.
Created by a psychologist, the Emotions Management app helps your child put their feelings into words, understand their needs, and discover practical solutions to feel better.
A SIMPLE JOURNEY TO BETTER UNDERSTAND EMOTIONS
Your child is guided step by step:
• What emotion am I feeling?
• How intense is it?
• What do I need?
• What can I do to feel better?
The app includes:
• 16 emotions explained in simple terms
• A slider to assess emotional intensity
• 16 essential needs to better understand what may lie behind an emotion
• More than 40 practical actions and solutions
• Simple exercises that are easy to use in everyday life
AN APP DESIGNED TO SUPPORT YOUR CHILD
The goal is not to prevent children from feeling angry, sad, or worried. It is to help them understand what they are experiencing, put their needs into words, and gradually discover what can help them feel better.
The app can be used independently by children who are old enough, or together with a parent, caregiver, teacher, or professional.
AN APPROACH CREATED BY A PSYCHOLOGIST
The content was created by a psychologist specializing in emotional management and emotional support for children and adults.
The exercises are inspired by Nonviolent Communication (NVC), mindfulness, positive psychology, and NLP (Neuro-Linguistic Programming).
A SAFE, AD-FREE EXPERIENCE
The full version provides access to a safe, child-friendly experience without advertising.
Help your child move from “I don’t know what I’m feeling” to “I understand what’s happening to me and I know what I can do.”
Because developing emotional intelligence is the first step toward feeling better.

bluejetty:00142178:ios.description:
Flamme: Ignite Your Love with the Ultimate Paired Couples App
As seen in TechCrunch, The Guardian, and Product Hunt, Flamme is the #1 app designed to help couples strengthen their bond, stay close in a long distance relationship, and build habits that last. With Widgets, Coral Quizzes, and expert advice, Flamme makes connection fun, simple, and meaningful.
Why Choose Flamme?
Every couple deserves to feel connected. Flamme is more than a couples app—it’s a paired relationship companion built for love at every stage. Whether you’re living apart, navigating challenges, or just looking to spark joy, Flamme helps you thrive.
What’s New in This Release
- AI Relationship Coach improvements with new modes like Duo AI, LDR Buddy, and Date Planner.
- Connection Widgets: Celebrate milestones, countdowns, and shared memories directly on your home screen.
- Expanded Coral Quizzes with 1000+ new prompts across communication, family, conflict, and fun.
- Feelings Check-ins: Share your mood instantly—happy, loved, excited, or “call me please.”
- Performance improvements for a smoother, faster experience.
Key Features
- Daily Discovery Questions – Learn something new about your partner every day.
- Coral Quizzes & Challenges (Free & Premium) – Play 1000+ fun and heartfelt quizzes designed for couples.
- Widgets for Couples (Premium feature) – Track days together, anniversaries, and long-distance countdowns.
- AI Relationship Coach (Premium feature) – Get personalised advice on gifts, intimacy, and conflict resolution.
- Shared Bucket List (Premium feature) – Dream, plan, and tick off milestones together.
What Our Users Say
“Flamme keeps us close even in long distance. The widgets and daily questions make us feel connected every day.” – Emily R.
“The Coral Quizzes are so fun—it feels like date night, even when we’re apart.” – Daniel & Zoe
“Finally, an app that combines expert advice with fun, practical tools for couples.” – Mia & Alex
Download Flamme Today
Loved by 100,000+ couples worldwide, Flamme is your ultimate partner in building a stronger, happier, and lasting relationship.
Stay paired. Stay connected. Light the Flamme.
FAQ：https://www.flamme.app/frequently-asked-questions-faq
Have more questions or feedback? Contact us at hello@flamme.app

bluejetty:00160515:ios.summary:
I’m Noah, Your AI Emotional Coach, and I’m here to support you through stress, worry, overthinking, or any challenge you face. My goal is to help you to vent, reflect, build self-care habits, and help you feel calm every single day. 
Whene
bluejetty:00160515:ios.description:
I’m Noah, Your AI Emotional Coach, and I’m here to support you through stress, worry, overthinking, or any challenge you face. My goal is to help you to vent, reflect, build self-care habits, and help you feel calm every single day. 
Whenever you want to talk or chat, I’ll be here to listen and offer friendly, personalized support—so you always feel better and more in control.
How I Can Help You
1. Emotional Support
 * I’m available anytime you need to talk about your worries or process life’s ups and downs.
 * No appointment necessary—just chat whenever stress or anxiety shows up.
2. Guided Self-Care & Reflections
 * I adapt to your mood, offering mental wellness suggestions and tips that fit your day.
 * Learn to feel calm and less overwhelmed using quick exercises and soothing reflections.
3. Daily Check-Ins & Motivation
 * I’ll send gentle reminders to see how you’re doing, helping you stay on top of your mental health.
 * Celebrate small victories, track progress, and discover patterns that help you feel better.
4. Warm, Empathetic Conversations
 * Talk to me like you would a trusted friend. I’m here to guide, not judge.
 * My aim is to provide comforting support so you can take on life’s challenges with renewed confidence.
Why Choose Me as Your AI Emotional Coach?
* On-Demand Guidance: No waiting, no schedules—just hop in and chat the moment you need relief.
* Empathy & Encouragement: I’m programmed to understand your emotions and offer genuine, uplifting feedback.
* Safe & Private Space: All our conversations stay between us, so you can freely share your thoughts and worries.
* Simple, Actionable Advice: I believe small steps lead to big changes—so let’s tackle stress and anxiety in a friendly, achievable way.
Important Note:
Noah is here to support your mental wellness and self-care journey by offering a compassionate space to talk and feel heard. However, Noah is not a licensed mental health professional and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. If you are in crisis, experiencing severe distress, or need immediate support, please contact a licensed healthcare provider or emergency services in your area.
Ready to feel calmer and more supported every day? Download Noah: Your AI Mental Health and Emotional Coach now, and let’s start working toward a happier, more resilient you—together!

bluejetty:00026413:ios.description:
Creating your custom yoga sequence has never been easier! Pocket Yoga Teacher allows you to build, edit and share complete yoga practices.
Make a practice in minutes: select your desired poses, adjust their order and duration, add music, and you’re done! Try your practice by following along with the voice guidance, or share it with the Pocket Yoga Community and see what they think. Perfect for yoga teachers or intermediate to advanced level yogis.
Create
• Choose from over 500 poses, including variations and transitional poses.
• Follow suggestions on which pose to add next or choose from a complete list.
• Move poses around to your desired order.
• Add loops to repeat a set of poses, like a Sun Salutation.
Edit
• Set the duration to hold each pose.
• Adjust the voice guidance.
• Adjust the side and direction of each pose.
• Add music from Apple Music, Spotify, your music library, or our built-in selection.
Share
• Share your practice with the Pocket Yoga Community and spread well-being to the world.
• Email, Message or AirDrop a practice to your friends directly.
• Import your practices into our companion app, Pocket Yoga, to use its additional features.
• Create beautiful printouts for yourself or your students.
• Convert your practices to PDF documents.
• Play your practices on your Apple TV.
Pocket Yoga Community
Discover inspiring practices from yoga teachers around the world and share your own sequences! Download a practice, try it out, and see how other yoga teachers are sequencing their flows. The Pocket Yoga Community allows you to explore different yoga styles, get feedback on your practices, see full practice previews, and much more.

bluejetty:00089493:ios.description:
Braavos Wallet brings Bitcoin (BTC), Starknet (STRK), and crypto self-custody together in one secure, beginner-friendly wallet.
Store, manage, and earn a double-digit yield on BTC, ETH, STRK, and more — all while enjoying a gas-free experience on Starknet. Whether you're staking Bitcoin, exploring DeFi on Starknet, or sending Lightning payments, Braavos gives you full control with zero complexity.

Earn High Yield with DeFi
Stake BTC, ETH, STRK, and other top assets in one click. Earn a passive income and track your Bitcoin yield directly from your DeFi dashboard — no bridges, wrapping or lockups are required.
Bitcoin-Ready
Enjoy native BTC support, seamless Lightning payments, and fiat on-ramps. Braavos makes it easy to deposit, store, send, and earn with Bitcoin — without leaving the wallet.
Gas-Free on Starknet
Experience lightning-fast, zero-fee transactions on Starknet. Stake STRK and BTC into Starknet-native DeFi protocols with full control and zero gas costs.
Secure Self-Custody
Biometric transaction protection (FaceID or fingerprint), full seed phrase ownership, and zero record of security breaches. Braavos gives you secure access to Starknet and Bitcoin — without giving up control.
All-in-One DeFi Dashboard
Track your assets, staking positions, and real-time yield in one clean, powerful interface optimized for mobile.
Effortless Onboarding
Bridge crypto from centralized exchanges (CEXs), DeFi wallets, or start with fiat using Apple Pay, Google Pay or direct deposit. All crypto — including BTC and STRK — arrives directly in your Braavos Wallet.
ⓘ Assets You Can Stake or Earn Yield On:
- Ethereum (ETH)
- Bitcoin (BTC)
- US Dollar Coin (USDC)
- US Dollar Tether (USDT)
- Starknet (STRK)
No complexity, high yields. Just DeFi and self-custody done right.
Since launching in early 2022, over 1 million wallets have been deployed with no critical bugs, exploits, or user fund losses. You can earn BTC yield, stake STRK, swap tokens, and explore Starknet DeFi — all securely from a self-custodial mobile wallet.
Braavos is more than a wallet — it's a complete Bitcoin and Starknet DeFi platform.
Download Braavos Wallet today and unlock your BTC, STRK, and crypto's full potential — safely and seamlessly on Starknet.

bluejetty:00065335:ios.description:
Use the Standard Online Share Trading app for fast, secure real-time trading in shares, derivatives and other investment instruments listed on the JSE. 
Provided by SBG Securities (Pty) Ltd. (SBG Sec). 
Features
• Track and trade in any of your subscribed investment instruments
• Create watchlists of instruments you've got your eye on 
• Avoid risk by inserting stop losses and price alerts
• Withdraw or transfer funds between your accounts
• Access historical info on shares and delayed share price data
• Stay up to date via your smartphone and smartwatch
• Quick and simple sign in
Getting started
You should first register for your OST account on the Standard Online Share Trading website: www.standardbank.co.za/sharetrading
‎Although Standard OST is a standalone app, you can also download the Standard Bank Mobile Banking app, which gives you a full view of your OST and related Standard Bank accounts. 
You’ll need data to download the OST app and use its features. Data rates are set by your network service provider.
SBG Sec’s normal fees and charges apply when your trade through the OST app.
Legal info
SBG Securities (Pty) Ltd (Reg. no. 1972/008305/07) is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Standard Bank Group, an authorised user of the JSE Limited and an authorised financial services provider (26691).
Got an idea on improving the app? Send it to us. Found a bug? Tell us about it!
We’re proud of our app, but we know it’s not perfect. We’re constantly working on improvements and would love to get your feedback: appfeedback@standardbank.co.za

bluejetty:00170062:ios.description:
Unlock the full potential of your PDF files with our powerful PDF Compressor app! Seamlessly reduce the size of your PDF documents without compromising on quality. Whether you need to save storage space on your device, share files more efficiently, or simply optimize your PDFs for faster loading, our app has you covered.
Key Features:
Efficient Compression:
Our advanced compression algorithms ensure that your PDF files are reduced to the smallest possible size without sacrificing quality. Experience faster file transfers, quicker uploads, and more efficient storage utilization.
Retain Quality:
Rest assured that your document's quality remains intact throughout the compression process. Our app maintains the integrity of text, images, and formatting to ensure your content looks as good as ever.
 File Management:
Organize and manage your compressed PDF files effortlessly. Access a user-friendly file manager to rename, delete, or share your optimized documents with ease.
Share Anywhere:
Compressed PDFs are perfect for sharing via email, messaging apps, or cloud storage. Share your files hassle-free with colleagues, clients, or friends, knowing they'll receive a lightweight yet high-quality document.
Subscription Policy
- Subscriptions are billed weekly or monthly at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package, unless cancelled 24-hours in advance prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy - https://sites.google.com/view/pdfcompress/projects
Service Terms - https://sites.google.com/view/pdfcompress/terms

bluejetty:00075605:ios.description:
A small note found inside a drawer in the old bakery.
“When it’s complete, you’ll understand.”
When Jenny’s grandmother suddenly moved into a care facility, she left behind only a dusty old bakery and a mysterious note.
Jenny begins repairing the old oven, completing customer orders one by one, and following the story her grandmother left behind.
Merge matching desserts, unlock new recipes, and build the bakery floor by floor as you complete Jenny’s sweet journey.
○ A bakery that grows upward, not outward
Instead of expanding across a town, your bakery grows toward the sky: floor 1, floor 2, floor 3…
Each new floor brings a new dessert-themed space and fresh customer orders.
○ Sweet recipes made by merging
Merge matching bread, fruit, and desserts to create delicious new treats.
Complete customer orders, collect rewards, and bring the old bakery back to life little by little.
○ Cute cat guests and surprise rewards
Give special snacks to the cats that visit your shop and receive delightful gifts in return.
Level up to unlock extra merge boards with more rewards to collect.
○ Run your bakery with helpful managers
If your busy bakery is hard to run alone, hire a manager to help.
Serve more customers, complete neighbor orders, and keep growing your bakery.
○ Relaxing play anytime, anywhere
Play even without an internet connection.
No forced ads — enjoy merge puzzles at your own pace on the subway, on a plane, or during a quick break.
Jenny’s bakery story began with a single old note.
Start your journey in Merge Sweets and build your own sweet bakery up toward the sky!
Contact: help@spcomes.com

bluejetty:00165287:ios.description:
SetTime is a free appointment scheduling app built to simplify booking, eliminate no-shows, and grow your business. Manage schedules, send automated reminders, and accept 24/7 client bookings with a smart planner.
Allow clients to book instantly from your website, Google Business profile, or social media (Facebook & Instagram) via custom "Book Now" links or QR codes.
Switching software? We offer 100% free data migration to move clients, services, and appointment history seamlessly.
Download SetTime today for unlimited free access to core scheduling features with no time limits!
Free Plan Key Features
• Appointment Scheduling: Create, manage, and track appointments anywhere, anytime.
• Client Management: Bulk import contacts, track birthdays, add internal/appointment notes, or block clients.
• 24/7 Online Booking Page: Personalized self-booking web page with printable QR code generation.
• No-Show Tracking: Record no-show statuses to maintain accurate attendance records.
• Six Calendar Views: Schedule, Day, Staff Day (side-by-side columns), 3-Day, Week, and Month.
• Availability Management: Set closed days, working days, and time off for business & staff.
• Deposits & Cancellation Policies: Protect schedules with upfront deposits and clear policies.
• Calendar Synchronization: Sync bidirectionally with Apple Calendar and export to Google Calendar.
• Manual Reminders: Send quick appointment confirmations via Email, SMS, or WhatsApp.
• Automated Email Notifications: Send automated confirmations, reminders, follow-ups, cancellations, and reschedules.
• Multi-Language & Multi-Currency: Access in 14 languages with multi-currency.
• Business Analytics: Track revenue, appointments, staff performance, and top services.
• Booking Page Analytics: Monitor page visits, completed bookings, and conversion rates.
• Multi-Device Sync & Widgets: Sync across iPhone, iPad, desktop, and iOS Home Screen widgets.
Pro Plan Additional Features
• Per-Staff Management & Payroll: Create team profiles with working hours, assigned services, and time off. Set staff commission rates and view earnings on a Payroll page.
• Per-Staff Reviews & Ratings: Showcase customer reviews and star ratings tied to staff profiles.
• Automated Client Reviews: Collect verified customer reviews and feedback post-appointment.
• Gift Cards & Loyalty Program: Allow clients to buy gift cards for friends/family to pay upfront. Automatically issue rewards after set visits.
• Group Appointments: Schedule group appointments for multi-client bookings.
• Device & Room Dependencies: Track device and room dependencies.
• Promo Codes & Marketing: Create campaign discount promo codes and track booking counts per code.
• Automated SMS & WhatsApp Reminders: Automated text reminders for maximum attendance.
• Customizable Booking Site & Form Fields: Remove branding, apply custom colors, add SEO tags, showcase photo galleries, and add custom fields.
• Request Unavailable Slots: Let clients request slots outside regular hours for manual approval.
• Expense & Revenue Tracking: Log expenses, automate recurring costs, track overhead, and view profits.
• Recurring Bookings: Schedule repeat appointments and multi-service packages in one session.
• 24/7 Priority Support: Dedicated customer support whenever help is needed.
Built for Every Service Business
• Beauty & Personal Care: Hair salons, barbershops, nail tech studios, spas, lash & makeup artists.
• Health & Wellness: Clinics, dental offices, massage therapists, mental health professionals, medspas.
• Fitness & Coaching: Personal trainers, sports coaches, tutors, fitness studios, consultants.
• Pets & Home Services: Dog groomers, pet care, house cleaning, auto detailing, mobile services.
Support & Legal
Customer Support: support@settime.io
Privacy Policy: https://settime.io/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00023042:ios.description:
Conquer the city, discover the Infinity! Infinity Kingdom is a cartoon-style mmo strategy game. As a resourceful lord, you must defend the land of Norheim against the evil gnomes while protecting yourself from other invading players! 
Three years ago, the gnomes shattered the northern line of defense, led their mechanical army into the fray. Thousands of cities fall and the fate of human kind hangs in the balance. Now Immortals are gathering under your banner. The greatest ones in history are now ready to lead your fearsome troops into battle! Lords! Would you able to repel enemies and restore peace to this scarred land? 
Help! Them Gnomes are wreaking havoc!
You have finally arrived, my Lord! Our territory is in dire situation! The Gnomes have ransacked our cities like a plague of locusts, and our people desperately need your help! The alchemists are ready to help us restore the City, so that the people can come to seek refuge. Rebuild the city, grow faster, build faster, train faster, and then put it all on the line against those enemies! 
Immortals Assemble!
There are more than 50 powerful Immortals from various civilizations ready to the aid of humanity. The Sage Council grants you the supreme right to summon the Immortals at the Hall of Immortals via Philosopher's Stone. With their immensely powerful abilities, Immortals will fight for your cause. Cleopatra, Julius Caesar, Merlin, Robin Hood…Your troops have been assembled! They are ready to fight for you to expel enemies, save the world...or complete a PVE campaign!
Epic Dragons Awaken!
7 types of elements dragons dwell in a mysterious dragon cave, and only the bravest warriors could awaken them. Are you excited to claim an epic dragon egg, hatch it and watch the hatchling grow? Raise them well and they will turn into fierce fighters！Assign your dragon with the same as the element Immortals, and the exclusive Buffs of elemental unit will be activated for you in battles!
Sharpen your strategies, customized your perfect team!
Elemental Unit in battles seems like invincible, but remember the best combinations are yet to be found! Think over all attributes and elemental buffs your units cover, assign powerful Immortals with dragon, take over your enemies in battlefield, and show them who is the king!
Ruins Exploration: Reveal pieces of Norheim's history！
A number of Ruins will be scattered across the World Map. Dispatch your scouts to investigate them to gain Stele Shards, which can be used in your territory's Monuments to reveal pieces of Norheim's history. A boundless of rewards also awaits in your exciting adventure!

bluejetty:00086908:ios.description:
Welcome to Share - Israel Car Sharing!
Sign up to a brilliant and innovative service available 24/7.
What is car-sharing?
Car-sharing allows you to travel without the need to own a vehicle.
Share cars are parked near your home, ready for immediate travel, with no need for advance booking, queues, or paperwork.
Where are the cars?
All over the country!
From north to south, Share cars are waiting to provide you with a simple, easy travel solution.
Download the app now and pick a car near you.
What does the service include?
With our model, you only pay for the kilometers you drive!
Say goodbye to hidden costs: there are no subscription fees, no deductibles, and no fuel charges.
Our flexible hourly service lets you reserve a car in advance or take one instantly for any length of time.
When your trip is over, simply update the app and return the car to its original parking lot
Who is the service for?
Everyone - including new and young drivers with a minimum of one year’s license.
Need to go out of the city?
Is your car in the garage?
Have one family car but sometimes need access to an additional vehicle?
Share is perfect for every need and every journey.
What makes the service special?
Using innovative technology, Share vehicle doors are opened directly from your phone, with no need for smart cards or smart keys.
Plus, Share is the only car sharing service that does not require a subscription fee.
What about security?
The Share app adheres to the most stringent data security standards.
A final word:
Enjoy! And don’t forget to refuel at the end of your journey - the next driver will appreciate it!
Want more info? Visit our website:
https://www.shlomo.co.il/israel/share/

bluejetty:00041909:ios.description:
Welcome to our app: Radio App - Simple Radio Tuner, our team has selected the best and most popular radio station to bring to you a radio streaming tuner free, give you the quality local radio stations and to radio stations from all over the world, covers all the major cities of the world, from Chicago to Acapulco, from Frankfurt to Johannesburg, from Moscow to Tel Aviv, from Shanghai to Melbourne... Now you can listen online all radio stations from these cities and thousands more from all over the World for free.
 You can select a city from the country to review the full frequency band in selected location. FM/AM tuner listed FM stations in the range 80.5—108.1 MHz (76.0-89.9 MHz in Japan, 65.9—74.00 in Russia and CI), AM stations in the range 531 - 1710. The available stations will display in screen, slide left or right to select your station and listen it. 
Maybe have radio stations are not local (from other place in the same country or cross-border), but can be received with good quality in the city area.
Features:
- Enjoy tuner radio in more than 200 countries and territories
- More than 10,000 radio stations in United States.
- Over 100,000 worldwide radio stations with all specific content as: Music, Live sports ( NBA, Football, Soccer, NHL, MMA...), News, Talk, Entertainment, Community, Education, Weather, and more...
- Scan FM, AM radios
- Access multiple countries quickly.
- Save your favorites radio stations for quick access
- Listen in the background
- Listen radio with Air-Play
- Support for Siri Shortcuts and Widgets
Radio Premium is a recurring subscription. You can cancel any time
With Radio Premium, you can access features unlimited:
- You'll be able to set the Sleep Timer to fall asleep to your favorite radio stations.
- High quality and fast connection speed
- Remove Ads
Subscription Pricing and Terms:
Title of service: Tuner Radio Premium
Try 3 days for free. Then $3.99/week or $7.99/month or $47.99/year. Subscription will auto renew after free trial.
Length of subscription: 1 week, 1 month or 1 year access to higher connection speed, unlimited country connection, no ads and unlock sleep timer.
Price of subscription:
 1 week - $3.99, 1 month - $7.99, 1 year - $47.99.
You can cancel subscription any time. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. You will be able to access full feature of the app for the duration of the subscription. Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original one week, month or year unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information. You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period. Any unused portion of a free-trial period, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
Read our full Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy at:

http://tcvtechnology.mobile-software.co/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00094362:ios.description:
As familiar waters stir with waves once again, a group of beautiful female pirates, each with her own unique personality, sets out on a brand-new journey.
You will become the captain of these seas, recruit your favorite companions, and develop their strength and affection. Grow stronger at your own pace through relaxing idle gameplay, while discovering more character stories and captivating scenes as your journey unfolds.
==【Game Features】==
【Charming Characters · Unique Styles】
A variety of beautiful female pirates will make their debut, from cool and mature to lively and spirited. There’s always someone who will capture your heart.
Collect your favorite characters and build your very own pirate lineup.
【Affection Growth · Relationships Evolve】
Build affection with your characters by giving them gifts and more.
As your bond deepens, unlock more character content and watch your once battle-hardened companions become truly special to you.
【Idle Progression · Resources Made Easy】
No need to stay online for long periods. You can continue earning the resources you need to grow.
Develop your characters and increase their strength with ease, so you can focus more on your favorite companions and team combinations.
【Companion Development · Build Your Own Lineup】
Develop your characters’ levels and abilities, and create team combinations based on their unique strengths.
Match your companions wisely to bring out the full potential of your pirate crew in battle.
Collect the pirate companions you love and build a bond that belongs to you both.
The sea awaits your voyage. The next legendary captain could be you.

bluejetty:00141495:ios.description:
Achieve your healthiest, most radiant skin with Beauty Care, your personal skincare companion designed to simplify face care and deliver visible results. Whether you're struggling with acne, dryness, aging signs, or simply want to maintain a glowing complexion, our comprehensive guide transforms your daily routine into an effective self-care ritual.
Your skin deserves expert attention without the confusion. Beauty Care eliminates guesswork by providing personalized skincare routines tailored to your unique skin type, concerns, and lifestyle. No more wasting money on products that don't work or following conflicting advice from countless sources.
Prepare your skin for summer with our specialized May and June seasonal guides. As temperatures rise and sun exposure increases, your skincare needs change dramatically. Our app delivers timely reminders for sunscreen application, hydration tracking to combat heat-related dehydration, and protective routines that shield your face from UV damage while maintaining that coveted summer glow. Learn which lightweight moisturizers work in humidity, how to prevent breakouts from sweat and sunscreen, and master the art of post-sun soothing treatments.
Discover comprehensive skincare education covering every aspect of facial health. Learn the science behind cleansing, understand ingredient benefits, master the correct application order for serums and treatments, and identify which products genuinely address your concerns. Our guide breaks down complex dermatological concepts into simple, actionable steps anyone can follow.
Explore our extensive library of skincare solutions for every concern. Combat acne with proven cleansing techniques and spot treatment strategies. Reduce fine lines and wrinkles through anti-aging protocols featuring retinoids, peptides, and antioxidants. Brighten dark spots and achieve even skin tone with targeted pigmentation guides. Soothe sensitive skin with gentle, hypoallergenic routine recommendations. Minimize pores and control oil production with balanced care approaches.
Understand your products better with our ingredient decoder. Learn what hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, vitamin C, AHAs, BHAs, and ceramides actually do for your face. Discover which ingredients work synergistically and which combinations to avoid. Make informed purchasing decisions that save money and deliver genuine results.
Master professional techniques at home with detailed tutorial content. Learn proper face massage methods that boost circulation and product absorption. Understand the correct pressure and motion for cleansing without damaging your skin barrier. Discover layering sequences that maximize treatment effectiveness. Practice facial exercises that naturally lift and tone.
Access curated routines for every lifestyle and budget. Whether you prefer minimal three-step simplicity or elaborate ten-step regimens, find approaches that fit your schedule. Discover drugstore alternatives to expensive products and learn where investing in quality truly matters. Adapt your routine for travel, gym sessions, and busy mornings without compromising results.
Your journey to confident, radiant skin starts today. Download Beauty Care now and transform your face care routine into a powerful self-care practice. Discover what your skin can achieve with the right guidance, consistency, and care. Beautiful skin isn't reserved for those with perfect genetics or unlimited budgets—it's available to everyone willing to follow a smart, personalized approach.
Beauty Care provides the knowledge and tools you need to look and feel your absolute radiant every single day. Stop wondering if you're doing skincare correctly and start seeing the glowing results you deserve. Your healthiest face is waiting.

bluejetty:00187596:ios.description:
Hi FPT - ĐIỀU KHIỂN INTERNET THÔNG MINH
Ứng dụng Hi FPT được ví như điều khiển thông minh, người bạn đồng hành tin cậy giúp khách hàng FPT quản lý toàn trình Dịch vụ Internet, Truyền hình, Camera và các dịch vụ khác mọi lúc, mọi nơi theo nhu cầu.
Với mong muốn trở thành trợ lý thông minh, người bạn thấu hiểu và đồng hành với khách hàng trong suốt quá trình sử dụng dịch vụ, Hi FPT không ngừng phát triển và tối ưu các tính năng nhằm mang đến trải nghiệm hài lòng nhất cho Khách hàng của FPT.
QUẢN LÝ VÀ ĐIỀU KHIỂN DỊCH VỤ INTERNET, TRUYỀN HÌNH, CAMERA THUẬN TIỆN
Tại ứng dụng Hi FPT, Quý khách hàng có thể dễ dàng quản lý, điều khiển thiết bị Modem và Wi-Fi từ xa, lên lịch sử dụng Internet theo nhu cầu cá nhân và đặc biệt là đảm bảo an toàn kết nối, quản lý nội dung truy cập để bảo vệ gia đình và trẻ em trước những rủi ro tiềm ẩn trên không gian mạng.
Khi cần hỗ trợ, khách hàng có thể tạo yêu cầu ngay trên ứng dụng và được ưu tiên phục vụ so với các kênh khác. Các yêu cầu phục vụ và hỗ trợ về kỹ thuật gửi tới từ Hi FPT luôn được xử lý nhanh nhất nhờ hệ thống phân công tự động, tối ưu, giúp khách hàng có được trải nghiệm tuyệt vời nhất trong suốt quá trình sử dụng dịch vụ của FPT.
Khách hàng có thể dễ dàng theo dõi tiến trình hỗ trợ dịch vụ một cách trực quan ngay tại ứng dụng và đánh giá chất lượng sau khi được phục vụ. FPT luôn trân quý mọi ý kiến đóng góp từ phía khách hàng, để có thể không ngừng nỗ lực cải tiến và nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ.
CHUYỂN ĐỔI DỊCH VỤ, NÂNG CẤP BĂNG THÔNG DỄ DÀNG VỚI VÔ VÀN ƯU ĐÃI ĐỘC QUYỀN
Khách hàng của FPT có thể dễ dàng chuyển đổi dịch vụ, nâng cấp băng thông, mua sắm trang thiết bị bổ sung, ký hoặc thay đổi thông tin hợp đồng trực tuyến và thanh toán online chỉ với một vài thao tác đơn giản trên ứng dụng. Khi thực hiện giao dịch trên Hi FPT, Khách hàng có thể tận hưởng vô vàn các ưu đãi độc quyền đến từ hệ sinh thái của Tập đoàn FPT và đối tác.
Hi FPT cũng là ứng dụng tích điểm, quản lý điểm thưởng thuộc chương trình Khách hàng thân thiết (FGold) của FPT. Điểm FGold có thể dùng để mua các sản phẩm, dịch vụ trong cùng hệ sinh thái FPT và đối tác, hoặc có thể đổi lấy Voucher cước phí để nhận các ưu đãi trong quá trình thanh toán dịch vụ sử dụng.
TÍCH HỢP CÁC GIẢI PHÁP TỐI ƯU VỀ MẶT CÔNG NGHỆ
Với định hướng chuyển đổi số, tiên phong chăm sóc khách hàng bằng công nghệ, FPT hướng đến mục tiêu 100% các giao dịch của khách hàng có thể thực hiện online, các thủ tục trước đây phải thực hiện trực tiếp tại quầy nay đã được đưa lên Hi FPT, giúp khách hàng dễ dàng thực hiện và được phục vụ tối đa, nhanh chóng mà không phải mất quá nhiều thời gian và chi phí.
Công nghệ phát hiện lỗi nhanh và tự động xử lý từ hệ thống giúp khách hàng có thể trải nghiệm dịch vụ Internet một cách thông suốt với chất lượng đường truyền được FPT tối ưu thường xuyên và liên tục.
Hãy cài đặt và sử dụng ứng dụng Hi FPT ngay hôm nay, để chúng tôi được phục vụ Quý khách tốt nhất. Mọi thắc mắc và ý kiến đóng góp, Quý khách vui lòng liên hệ:
- Email: Hifpt@fpt.com
- Fanpage: Hi FPT
- Website: https://hi.fpt.vn
- Hotline: 1900 6600

bluejetty:00072082:ios.description:
App de condomínio completo para moradores, síndicos e administradoras.
Com o Group COM, você acompanha boletos, taxa condominial, comunicados e reservas de áreas comuns de forma simples e rápida. Tenha mais controle financeiro e comunicação direta com o síndico e a administradora.
Tudo do seu condomínio em um só lugar.
Principais funcionalidades:
• Consultar boletos e emitir 2ª via com atualização automática 
• Acompanhar cobranças e taxa condominial 
• Reservar áreas comuns como salão de festas e churrasqueira 
• Receber comunicados e avisos do condomínio 
• Acessar documentos (atas, convenção e prestação de contas) 
• Falar com síndico e administradora 
• Utilizar classificados, achados e perdidos e caronas 
Mais praticidade no seu dia a dia
Organize sua rotina, acompanhe seu financeiro e resolva tudo do condomínio direto pelo celular.
Como acessar
Seu condomínio precisa utilizar o Group COM.
Depois disso:
• Cadastre-se pelo app com o identificador do boleto

[Idle Tower Defense] Guard the Kingdom
[Hero Synergy] Strategy Decides Victory

[Game Background]
In that distant fantasy realm, the King of the Light Kingdom has long safeguarded peace and prosperity. Yet, as shadows of darkness creep ever closer, the vile Orc tribes have shattered the ancient pact of peace, amassing vast armies to launch a frenzied invasion. As the Kingdom's protector, you are entrusted with a dire mission—to lead valiant troops and legendary heroes into heart-stopping battles against the Orcs, defending this sacred land and its people at all costs!

Effortless Placement, Strategy Reigns Supreme: Featuring an innovative idle tower defense mechanic, the game lets you engage in epic warfare without constant screen-watching—even amidst a busy schedule. [Hero System]
Diverse Heroes, Each with Unique Mastery: The game boasts a colorful cast of otherworldly heroes, hailing from varied races and backgrounds. Every hero possesses distinct skills and attributes. Adapt your team composition and tactics to different battle scenarios and enemy types for optimal results.
[Rich Stages]
Adventure Challenges: Embark on a perilous journey through mysterious ruins and treacherous stages, outmaneuvering Orc forces at every turn.
Become the hero who defends the Kingdom, engage in breathtaking life-or-death clashes with the Orcs, and carve your own legendary tale!

bluejetty:00015184:ios.summary:
Turn your smartphone into an advanced tool for capturing and analyzing heart and bodily sounds with our user-friendly app.
Utilizing your device's built-in microphone, this app captures heart and bodily sounds and displays them in both tim
bluejetty:00015184:ios.description:
Turn your smartphone into an advanced tool for capturing and analyzing heart and bodily sounds with our user-friendly app.
Utilizing your device's built-in microphone, this app captures heart and bodily sounds and displays them in both time and frequency domains in real-time.
Experience the uniqueness of your own heartbeat - record, visualize, and share your heart's waveform with ease. Our intuitive app allows you to record and playback your own sound files, and even share them with friends for collaborative learning.
Enhance your medical knowledge and skills with our comprehensive library of recorded heart sounds. Play, listen, and analyze these sounds using our sophisticated spectrogram and graphical interface. This tool is perfect for learning and identifying various heart conditions.
Dive into our heart sound simulator to create and study different conditions: from various murmurs and clicks to lung sounds. The app's advanced processing and filtering capabilities ensure the best auditory and visual experience, with real-time control over filter parameters and live spectrogram display.
How to Use with Airpods:
◆ Wear your Airpods.
◆ Press your device’s microphone to your chest, ideally at the apex of your heart below the left nipple.
How to Use with Headphones:
◆ Mute the microphone via the app to prevent feedback.
◆ Position the device’s microphone directly against your skin, at the heart's apex.
◆ Start recording and then switch to playback mode to listen to your heartbeat through headphones.
Disclaimer: This program is not meant for diagnosis of any medical condition. The data provided can be inaccurate and should only be used for entertainment purposes. This app records and playbacks recorded sound just like any other sound recording app. The quality or validity of the recorded sound is strictly limited to the performance of the built in microphone.
Premium Membership Benefits:
◆ Unlock full library access.
◆ Explore frequency domain views.
◆ Save multiple recordings.
Subscription with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription unless auto-renewal is turned off. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost for the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off going to the users Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a premium subscription during the free trial period. bluejetty:00023003:ios.description:
Swap-Swap Panda is a cute platform game where two pandas go on an adventure to take back the cupcakes stolen by some pesky ninjas. You will cross a wonderfull land full of bamboo forests, fantastic sights, and hazards.
You'll be in control of two pandas, a chubby giant panda and a funny red panda, each of which with different abilities needed to overcome all the obstacles in the levels. That's right, just with teamwork you'll be able to get through all the levels, by switching pandas and controlling one at a time.
Giant panda will be able to swim in lakes carrying red panda on its back, on the other hand red panda is able to climb bamboo and activate switches to open the path for giant panda.
Swap-Swap Panda is a cute adventure that will keep you engaged with many levels and replay values too as you need to collect all the stolen cupcakes in order to fully complete the game.
Features:
• Control two pandas
• Fun puzzle mechanics
• Cute pixel art
• Play in 20 locations
• Traditional platformer controls

bluejetty:00186122:ios.description:
Learning starts with play! Explore educational games for toddlers and preschoolers where children match shapes, sort colorful objects and discover familiar things from the world around them.
Each activity gives your child a simple task they can understand: find the matching piece, put similar objects together or recognize an animal, fruit or vehicle. Clear visuals and playful feedback make it easy to try, learn and try again.
PLAY AND LEARN AT YOUR OWN PACE
• Match objects and complete simple puzzles
• Sort items by shape and category
• Explore picture cards with animals, fruits, vegetables, vehicles and more
• Hear and learn new words
• Collect rewards after completing activities
MADE FOR LITTLE LEARNERS
These toddler learning games encourage children to look closely, notice similarities and solve small problems on their own. As they play, they can practice observation, memory, attention and fine motor skills.
The activities are designed for young children who are beginning to explore preschool games. Simple interactions let them focus on the task, while colorful characters and rewards make each success feel exciting.
PLAY TOGETHER OR INDEPENDENTLY
Children can explore at their own pace, or parents can join in: name the pictures, ask what belongs together and celebrate each new discovery. Whether your child plays for a few minutes or stays for another puzzle, there is always something familiar to recognize and something new to learn.
Discover a playful way to explore shapes, objects and words — one little achievement at a time.

bluejetty:00018879:ios.name: Armchair Commander
bluejetty:00018879:ios.summary: Relive history! This is the only game out there with an unlimited number of missions you can play - there are thousands of them… many created by committed players! Play or create your own missions in World War 2 and all the way through the
bluejetty:00018879:ios.description:
Relive history! This is the only game out there with an unlimited number of missions you can play - there are thousands of them… many created by committed players! Play or create your own missions in World War 2 and all the way through the Cold War. Learn to master the skill of the commander and conquer every enemy!
Wargame & Turn-based Simulation
From the Battle of Stalingrad to the Normandy landings, it’s got the vast majority of WW2 covered. Play as Germany, the Soviet Union, Republic of China, United States, Great Britain, or really any of the 50+ countries with more coming soon. Attack enemy strongholds and defend your cities with 20+ land, naval, and air units. Even the same unit has special functionalities differing by country!
Campaigns & Conquests
There are currently about 30 or so missions and conquest maps. The missions can be played through the story line, and the conquests (you get to choose your country) feature 1939-1943 Europe and 1937-1941 Asia. All the campaign maps can be downloaded and modified at your own will, as seen in the following section...
Sandbox & Custom Maps
Like I said, you can create your own maps; you can even upload them for the world to see! The map editor is readily available for use inside the base game. Every aspect of a mission is customizable: a country’s alliance, resources, cities, airports, troops, veterency, troop attack distance, winning conditions, and even which troops have generals can be customized.
Simulated Politics
From custom events to war declarations, this recent addition allows dynamic games of multiple alliances and betrayals; custom events can also be made to reflect historical events with different types of consequences (changes to resources, alliances, unit experience). Aid can also be given to allies like Lend Lease in the real WW2.
Historical Generals
Hundreds of generals - with more coming by each update - from various countries around the world. Generals are not tied to specific units; they can be sacked from a unit on the spot and be replaced at any time.
About Me
I’m an indie student developer, so this app is very flexible in terms of update content. Please feel free to contact me if you want to make suggestions or collaborate to make the game better.
Game Engine: Unity3d (c# + python)

bluejetty:00136609:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of “Hidden Art”!
Embark on a scavenger hunt to locate and collect various hidden objects scattered across expansive landscapes. 
Tap on each object as you find it to complete the challenge!
Ever dreamt of being a detective like Sherlock Holmes? 
To advance to the next level, consult the list of hidden objects displayed at the bottom of the screen. 
Zoom in on the bustling town map to locate these elusive items. 
Collect the required number of objects to unlock new areas and continue your exploration.
Stuck and in need of a clue or hint? 
If you're a fan of intuitive and easy puzzle games, give 'Hidden Art' a try! 
Take your time to collect objects and unwind—perfect for playing during a parking jam. 
Special items are here to assist you: 'Navigator' points you in the direction of hidden objects, while 'Binoculars' reveal the nearest elusive item.
How to Get the Most Out of “Hidden Art”
1.Locate Hidden Objects Carefully
Take a moment to review the list of items you need to find. There's no need to rush—zoom in and scrutinize the artwork meticulously.
2. Embark on an Extended Adventure with a Map
The charming lives of the townspeople will uplift your spirits, even if your quest to locate all hidden objects proves challenging.
3. Perfection Not Required
Don't sweat it if you can't find everything. Special items are available to assist you on your journey!
If you're a fan of treasure hunting or geocaching, and you enjoy games like Randonautica, Scavenger Hunt, June's Journey, Where's Wally?, or Find Out, then this game is sure to become one of your favorites. 
Download now! Its user-friendly gameplay makes it perfect for sharing with friends and family. 
Get everyone excited and play together!

• Vibrant artwork sure to entertain the whole family.
• Hints and clues available for every stage.

• No time limits—play at your own pace.
• Relaxing and satisfying gameplay.

• Helpful tips, all at no extra cost.
• What are you waiting for? Start your treasure hunt now!

bluejetty:00022231:ios.description:
Help Emma renovate her Grandpa’s beautiful old mansion and follow her story as she tries to bring this manor together. Design the interior and exterior of the house and choose between elegant decorations to give a unique feel to the house! 
Solve crossword puzzles to progress in the story! Beat and complete these crossword levels to unlock new chapters and new rooms to renovate and decorate! Explore the manor’s garden or the garage, renovate the library and create your own party room to celebrate! 
Adventures are around every turn, including a little bit of romance.
The game features all sorts of excitement:
- Fun Word Game: Solve challenging word puzzles by forming words from the given letters.
- Interior Design: Create your dream house! Repair the damage and renovate the old mansion! 
- Multiple Decorations: Choose between different options and decide how the manor will look!
- Exciting crosswords: This game really needs a true word puzzle master, are you the one?
- Experience the Story: Discover Wordington’s story and all the secrets it holds! 
- Amusing characters: Meet Pizza David, Handyman Bob and more. Is there possibly some romance going on between Emma and David? 
- A cute pet: Meet the cute dog Max and see what adventures he brings.
The old mansion is in desperate need of a makeover. Emma can’t do it alone. You can show off your decorating skills by choosing various components for the bedroom, living room, kitchen, garden, and more. Maximize the fun by being in control of all of the design decisions. You’ll get to pick and choose many of the new items that go into the manor, ensuring that you have a say on the final appearance.
As soon as you solve your first crossword puzzle, you are on your way to help Emma fix up the old mansion and turn it into your dream house!
Learn more about the game on Facebook:
Wordington

bluejetty:00115480:ios.description:
Turn email into action.
FiloMail is an AI email and to-do app for Gmail, Microsoft Outlook, and IMAP. Bring multiple accounts into one focused inbox, turn messages into tasks, and get through email with less busywork.
Sign in to FiloMail with a Google or Microsoft account. Once signed in, connect and manage your Gmail, Outlook, and IMAP mailboxes.
EMAIL THAT BECOMES ACTION
• Everyone can create to-dos manually for free, with no Plus subscription required.
• Turn an email into a to-do while keeping the original context
• Keep track of open and completed work
• Move from reading to action without switching apps
AI FOR FILOMAIL PLUS
AI features use your available Plus allowance.
• Summarize long emails on demand
• For supported Gmail mailboxes, optionally process new messages to generate summaries, to-dos, and Smart Labels automatically

FiloMail does not sell personal information. Customer prompts and outputs are not used to train public or foundation models without permission. FiloMail has undergone an independent Cloud Application Security Assessment (CASA) for restricted Gmail access.
Some features require FiloMail Plus and consume AI usage allowance. Availability may vary by account type, provider, platform, and region.

bluejetty:00121399:ios.summary:
Our users will tell better than us:
"A really good groove box, so easy to get beats and hooks going in moments and the sound is just stunning!" - App Store review
"Well this is something special I can tell you, so much has gone into this
bluejetty:00121399:ios.description:
Our users will tell better than us:
"A really good groove box, so easy to get beats and hooks going in moments and the sound is just stunning!" - App Store review
"Well this is something special I can tell you, so much has gone into this and many people are going to just love this" - thesoundtestroom
"Lots of preinstalled sounds, effects and the usability is there. It allows you to be as creative as you like with no need for the numerous sub-menus you find on other software" - App Store review
"This is a very well thought out and inspirational app. It goes much further than just electronic dance music... Highly recommended!" - App Store review
"Where has this been my whole life!... Gorgeous, user friendly, simple and sonically vibrant" - App Store review
-------
Groove Rider GR-16 is a professional step-sequenced groove box, inspired by professional hardware drum machines and rhythm boxes. It has a powerful Poison-202 based two oscillator synthesizer engine, plus a big variety of included PCM drum samples, insert/send/master effects, arpeggiator, automation recording, modulator, ADSR and filter block, and more! Built-in factory pattern library includes patterns in different music styles, which will inspire you (the list will be appended with the regular updates). Check out the patterns demo video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rnGM_rL2cY
One remarkable feature of GR-16 is that all the controls are arranged on one screen, just like on a real groove box device! It lets you access almost all useful parameters from the one screen. Forget about numerous sub-windows and dialogs, which ruined your inspiration in another musical apps! Groove Rider is the fastest path from your imagination to reality!
You can use GR-16 as a ready-to-go realtime musical instrument (groove box) in your jam sessions together with Ableton Link feature to synchronize it with your other music gear. Groove Rider is also very handy for quickly sketching your musical ideas, allowing you to instantly record them directly by using the Record function. Making music becomes easy and fun, in contrast with boring note drawing process and dealing with tons of files and expensive plugins in the DAW's! Don't loose your inspiration, boost it up with Groove Rider!
Features:
• supports Ableton Link, AUv3 (can be hosted as Audio Unit), AudioBus, AudioShare, Inter-App Audio, Core Midi, Virtual Midi In/Out, Bluetooth Midi, Midi Clock sync
• synth engine is Poison-202 based: 2 oscillators, 5 waveforms (Saw, Pulse, Sine, Triangle and Super-Saw)
• synth oscillator modulation types: Ring, Sync, PW and XFM
• 83 available oscillator configurations
• WaveTable synthesis with ability to import user wavetables (Serum .wav format supported)
• Filter module with LP, BP, HP, Notch type filters, 12 and 24 dB/octave
• ADSR envelope, assignable to Amp and Filter
• Modulator module with 9 LFO shapes x 6 destinations (Pitch, Filter, Level, Pan, Osc Edit, IFX Edit)
• portamento
• polyphony up to 32 voices
• 16 sounding parts per pattern

"Lots of preinstalled sounds, effects and the usability is there. It allows you to be as creative as you like with no need for the numerous sub-menus you find on other software" - App Store review

"This is a very well thought out and inspirational app. It goes much further than just electronic dance music... Highly recommended!" - App Store review

"Where has this been my whole life!... Gorgeous, user friendly, simple and sonically vibrant" - App Store review
-------
Groove Rider GR-16 is a professional step-sequenced groove box, inspired by professional hardware drum machines and rhythm boxes. It has a powerful Poison-202 based two oscillator synthesizer engine, plus a big variety of included PCM drum samples, insert/send/master effects, arpeggiator, automation recording, modulator, ADSR and filter block, and more! Built-in factory pattern library includes patterns in different music styles, which will inspire you (the list will be appended with the regular updates). Check out the patterns demo video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rnGM_rL2cY

One remarkable feature of GR-16 is that all the controls are arranged on one screen, just like on a real groove box device! It lets you access almost all useful parameters from the one screen. Forget about numerous sub-windows and dialogs, which ruined your inspiration in another musical apps! Groove Rider is the fastest path from your imagination to reality!

You can use GR-16 as a ready-to-go realtime musical instrument (groove box) in your jam sessions together with Ableton Link feature to synchronize it with your other music gear. Groove Rider is also very handy for quickly sketching your musical ideas, allowing you to instantly record them directly by using the Record function. Making music becomes easy and fun, in contrast with boring note drawing process and dealing with tons of files and expensive plugins in the DAW's! Don't loose your inspiration, boost it up with Groove Rider!

• supports Ableton Link, AUv3 (can be hosted as Audio Unit), AudioBus, AudioShare, Inter-App Audio, Core Midi, Virtual Midi In/Out, Bluetooth Midi, Midi Clock sync

• synth engine is Poison-202 based: 2 oscillators, 5 waveforms (Saw, Pulse, Sine, Triangle and Super-Saw)
• synth oscillator modulation types: Ring, Sync, PW and XFM
• 83 available oscillator configurations
• WaveTable synthesis with ability to import user wavetables (Serum .wav format supported)
• Filter module with LP, BP, HP, Notch type filters, 12 and 24 dB/octave

bluejetty:00127167:ios.summary: A Fun Water Sorting Puzzle Game is here for you! It’s time to test how smart you are. Test your intelligence by solving this liquid sort water puzzle. Sort them all, This puzzle game stimulates your brain in a very fun and challenging way.
bluejetty:00127167:ios.description:
A Fun Water Sorting Puzzle Game is here for you! It’s time to test how smart you are. Test your intelligence by solving this liquid sort water puzzle. Sort them all, This puzzle game stimulates your brain in a very fun and challenging way. Enjoy the mental brain IQ challenge as you stack the colorful waters in the tubes in this water sort game. Let’s see how good you are at juggling the colors in different water tubes in this mind relaxing iq game.
This water sort is a very easy yet challenging game. All you have to do in this whole logic puzzle game is to use your brain and sort colors correctly in every tube. It's time to get your head in the game and sort color puzzles. There are tubes filled with different colors. Quickly sort the colored waters in the tubes until all the same colors are together in each tube and become a champion of this sort puzzle games.
There is a fun rule of this sort puzzle relaxing game that you can only pour water of the same color at the top and the tube you are pouring has enough space in it. So be careful while filling up the tube using your colored water.
Think, strategize, predict, and use logic puzzles at every move and look before pouring whether the other tube has enough space or not. Win jewels at the end of every level, use the jewels to unlock more and more hints.
Be careful while solving the puzzle pieces to make sure you don’t get stuck. This water sort game has simple controls, limitless unique levels, and no time limit.
So what are you waiting for? This water sort game will make sure you enhance your IQ level as well as kill boredom. All in one, isn’t it cool?
Features:
Sort the puzzle pieces into respective tubes.
Collect gems every time you complete a logic puzzle level
Get free hints in case you get stuck in this brain game
Colorful graphics & exciting water sort color sounds

bluejetty:00041742:ios.description:
Welcome to Mergeland, the wonderful Animal Adventure Island! This is a magical area full of animals that need to be rescued. Here, you'll discover the hidden world by merging three identical items to make a new one, and five to make two. You've found the ideal casual puzzle game!
Merge and combine clusters of identical things to clear the cursed fog off the island. You'd acquire new goods and face new challenges each time you rescued an animal. It will become increasingly difficult for you to get to the next level as your land extends around you. Don't worry, the creatures you rescued will assist you with their expertise.
You won't get bored playing our games. Why? We've planned a variety of events with various themes. It could have something to do with seasons, holidays, or even fairy tales. After completing certain events, you will receive coins, gems, or special decorations. A great way to get away from the mainland. There's always something new to explore!
Remember to complete the custom orders to get magics and coin pieces. The number of unlocked animals increases the number of order types. Do you want to know what their favorite meal is? Then you'll have to figure it out for yourself in the game.
Want to play with your friends, family members or colleagues? We thought of this in advance. Connect your Facebook account to our game and invite your friends to play. Are you ready to start creating your own fantasy world? Mergeland - Animal Adventure Island is now available for download!
Where to find us? We are only a click away. https://www.facebook.com/Mergeland-Animal-111274268014073
MergelandAnimalFeedback@outlook.com would like to hear your voice.
By downloading and using this app, you agree to the following terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00138124:ios.description:
Introducing — AI Homework Helper.
Your comprehensive academic companion designed to make homework struggles a thing of the past. 
Whether you're tackling complex math problems, seeking answers to general questions, or diving into subjects like chemistry, biology, and calculus, AI Homework Helper has you covered.
Key Features:
* Math Solver: Effortlessly conquer intricate math problems. Simply scan or input the equation, and AI Homework Helper will guide you through step-by-step solutions, making learning a breeze.
* General Question Solver: Instant answers to a broad spectrum of questions, spanning subjects like history, science, language, and literature. AI Homework Helper's extensive database ensures comprehensive responses for your academic inquiries.
* Chemistry and Biology Assistance: Dive into the world of chemistry and biology with AI Homework Helper. Receive detailed explanations and solutions for problems in these crucial scientific subjects.
* Calculus Support: Master calculus with ease. AI Homework Helper provides step-by-step solutions and explanations for calculus problems, ensuring a thorough understanding of the concepts.
Benefits:
* Time-Saving: Streamline your academic tasks, reducing time spent on problem-solving and research with AI Homework Helper.
* Accuracy: Rest assured that AI Homework Helper provides precise and reliable solutions, giving you confidence in your academic work.
* Productivity Booster: With quick access to solutions and subject-specific support, focus on learning and achieve better results with AI Homework Helper.
* Learning Aid: Utilize AI Homework Helper as a comprehensive learning tool, understanding the step-by-step processes behind solutions to enhance your knowledge.
* Versatility: From math to various academic subjects, AI Homework Helper adapts to cater to your diverse needs.
This app offers an auto-renewing yearly subscription to provide unlimited access to the all-inclusive solution while you maintain an active subscription. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal cost will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms & Conditions: https://apporigins.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://apporigins.com/privacy-policy
If you have any feedback, don't hesitate to reach out to us at hello@apporigins.com
With love!

bluejetty:00040823:ios.description:
Days To is a modern mix of a countdown app and a reminder app to track all your special events and moments. Whether it's a wedding, anniversary, birthday, holiday, graduation, exam, or retirement, our app makes it easy to count down how many days until the date!
Our user-friendly app comes with home screen widgets that let you display your important events on your home screen for easy access. Plus, with notifications that remind you of important dates, you'll never forget an event again. With the Days To Countdown app, stay organized while reaching the milestones of your life!
Days To is also highly customizable as much as it's functional. You can customize your events with backgrounds, colors, frames, and fonts to make each moment uniquely yours!
Key Features:
• Use with Ease
Enjoy a clean and intuitive interface that makes it easy to create, manage, and view your countdowns.
• Home Screen Widgets for Every Style
Display your favorite countdowns directly on your home screen for quick and easy access. Choose from a variety of widget styles and sizes to suit your preferences.

Create personalized countdowns and count ups for all your important events and moments. Choose from different themes and colors to make each event unique. Customize your events with various colors, frames, and font options to add your personal touch!

Choose your background from our selection of stunning images or use your photos to make each one of them even more special!
• Count up from Your Milestones and Moments with Day Since

Set events to repeat weekly, monthly, or yearly, so you never have to create the same countdown multiple times. For example, you can choose to repeat annually if it happens every year like an anniversary, Valentine's Day, Christmas, or Halloween.

Securely backup your events across multiple devices so you can access them from anywhere.

bluejetty:00075479:ios.name: Merge Gangster Heist vs Police
bluejetty:00075479:ios.summary: Prepare yourself for an intense Mafia simulation game adventure! Take charge of cunning enterprises, assemble skilled Capos to execute your commands, and seize fresh territories by any means necessary. Exercise your freedom: demand protecti
bluejetty:00075479:ios.description:
Prepare yourself for an intense Mafia simulation game adventure! Take charge of cunning enterprises, assemble skilled Capos to execute your commands, and seize fresh territories by any means necessary. Exercise your freedom: demand protection fees, carry out robberies, engage in street battles. Embrace either benevolent leadership or ruthless crime lord status. The choice is yours when it comes to whom you steal from and what you pilfer!
Amass immense wealth: plunder banks, acquire new vehicles, and unlock additional skills! To ensure seamless operations, lucrative ventures are essential. Ascend from an obscure gang to a global crime syndicate, engaging in high-stakes heists and audacious bank raids. The only limits that exist are the ones you set. Widen your sphere of influence: seize control of streets and cities to construct your very own Mafia empire. Crush those who dare to oppose you and recruit loyal followers to advance your ambitions.
Gather a collection of Capos: notorious criminals from around the world, each possessing distinct abilities that set them apart. Whether it's an elusive hacker or a sharpshooting assassin, become an unstoppable force! Enjoy the perks of Idle Cash: as the boss, sit back and let your faithful minions handle the dirty work. Remember, every prosperous fortune has a criminal foundation!
Combine characters, form an exceptional team of professionals, and execute the perfect heist! With 12 unique characters and 2 specializations, you have the opportunity to assemble a diverse crew. Explore various locations of varying difficulty, selecting from multiple approaches. This game blends elements from Grand Gangster, idle games, and tycoon games, providing a thrilling and captivating simulation experience. It's akin to playing a police game from the perspective of a gang or Mafia empire. Drawing inspiration from popular titles like Mafia City Grand Gangster, this game delivers a gripping and immersive experience on your mobile device. Earn more money, strategize heists, and ascend as a tycoon in this idle Mafia game. It's an exhilarating fusion of gangster games, empire games, and idle gameplay. Stay vigilant for law enforcement as you navigate your criminal endeavors.

bluejetty:00183980:ios.description:
Convenient. Secure. Free. Mobile Banking from Heartland Bank lets you easily view and manage your money right in the palm of your hand anytime, anywhere! Best of all, it’s free.
Mobile Banking is available to all registered Online Banking customers; just sign in with your Online Banking user name and password.
FEATURES
- View account balances and transaction history
- Transfer money between your Heartland Bank accounts
- Pay bills and pay people
- View scheduled and recent payments
- Deposit checks – Snap a photo of your check and deposit them remotely
- Use your phone’s GPS to find a branch or ATM near you
SECURITY
At Heartland Bank your security is always our top priority.
- Account information is never stored on your phone
- Data transmissions are encrypted with the same secure technology as Online Banking
HOW TO GET STARTED
- Mobile Banking is free from Heartland Bank (but your mobile carrier’s message and data rates may apply)
- You first need to be enrolled in Online Banking from Heartland Bank
- Download the app and log in with your Online Banking username and password.
RESTRICTIONS
- Users must be enrolled in Online Banking
- Bill Pay Payees must be setup in Online Banking
- Deposits are subject to verification and are not available for immediate withdrawal
- See the terms in the app for limits/availability and other restrictions

bluejetty:00088296:ios.description:
Begin your journey with us to make yoga a part of your daily life.
All yoga classes are tailored by our expert yoga team. They serve your specific needs, whether you'd like to lose weight, gain flexibility, fight depression or get a great workout. You can also choose from our huge catalog of freestyle classes based on what your body needs on a day-to-day basis.
BEGINNER IN YOGA?
You’re in the right place. Our classes guide you step by step so that you can progress at your own pace. There’s a class and program for all yogis, brand new or super skilled. Our app has HD capability and lets you practice from the big screen.
Research shows that regular yoga practice brings huge benefits for both body and mind. To make yoga a part of your daily routine, we offer the following features:
- Set weekly goals and let TrackYoga track your progress.
- Collect badges that motivate you further by completing yoga milestones.
- Have reminders sent to your phone to stay on track with your weekly goals.
- Earn free Kriya points for each class you practice. Use these points to unlock premium content.
PROGRAMS - Classes are grouped together to help you achieve specific goals
 - Beginner’s Mind
 - Flexibility Series
 - Full Body Fitness
 - Yoga for Depression
 - Yoga Workout
 - Stress Relief
 - Meditation
 - Pranayama - Power of Breathing
 - Women's Health Program
FREESTYLES - Choose from a variety of classes
 - Stress Relief
 - Beginner’s Mind
 - Back Pain Relief
 - Cold & Flu Relief
 - Pre-Run Yoga
 - Post-Run Yoga
 - Strength Builder
 - Morning Yoga
 - Bed Time Yoga
 - Digestion Booster
 - Yoga for Balance
 - Travel Yoga
 - Yoga for Abs
 - Energy Booster
 - Sun Salutation
 - After Work Yoga
 - Yoga for Busy Bees
TrackYoga mostly follows the Hatha Yoga style.
TrackYoga is free to download and use. Upgrading to TrackYoga Premium will give you full access to all features. All subscriptions are on an auto-renewing basis. 
We at TrackYoga are dedicated fitness professionals and app developers. We strive to make the highest quality products and continually personalize the experience based on your feedback. If you have any suggestions, please feel free to contact us.
Learn more on https://trackyoga.app/

bluejetty:00178578:ios.description:
Bluebeam for iOS keeps you connected to your teams and documents, so you can quickly access the information you need in the field and capture what matters for the office.
- Communicate with markups using tools like callouts, text, clouds, and status indicators
- Import your team's custom Tool Sets from Revu, so your standardized markups are ready to go in the field, even offline
- Attach photos captured in the field directly to a markup, so supporting documentation stays organized without cluttering your drawings
- Open your files stored on your device, Studio Projects, or Studio Sessions
- Join Studio Sessions for live collaboration. If your connection drops, your changes sync when you're back online
- Check out files in Studio Projects to make edits, then check them back in when you're ready
- Work offline by syncing Project files ahead of time or opening PDFs stored on your device
Whether you’re reviewing submittals, placing markups in the field, or tracking revisions with your team, Bluebeam gives you the flexibility to get the job done from anywhere.

bluejetty:00061477:ios.description:
Are you an Office Depot Business customer who wants to access your business account at a moment’s notice, no matter where life takes you? If so, our NEW Office Depot Business app let’s you do almost everything the website does when you’re not at your desk.
Whether you’re a small or medium-size business, large enterprise or government account, you can now access your Custom Discounted Pricing, Best Value items and account information. All synchronized with your http://www.odpbusiness.com account. 
Please note Office Depot Business was previously Office Depot’s Business Solutions Division.
Features:
• Place and track orders at your convenience
• Review Pending Approval orders on-the-go
• Scan item barcode to check pricing and purchase
• Access company-wide and personal shopping lists for easy ordering
• Built with all industry-standard security practices you’ve come to expect from http://www.odpbusiness.com 
GET IT NOW
Simply download the app, log in and enjoy the benefits of mobile access to your Office Depot Business account.
If you’re not already an Office Depot Business customer and you have 15 or more employees with an annual spend greater than $6,000 on office and technology supplies & services, contact us at 888.2.OFFICE to learn how to get started.

bluejetty:00017589:ios.description:
Suite Bancamiga
Canal electrónico de servicio transaccional.
Con este canal, Bancamiga busca ofrecer a sus clientes, tanto personas naturales como jurídicas, una experiencia bancaria más segura, ágil y accesible a través de su aplicación móvil. 
Ofrecemos una visita al banco las 24 horas del día, con sólo acceder a Bancamiga Suite, desde cualquier lugar donde se encuentren nuestros clientes con una conexión a internet.
Servicios Disponibles:
- Posición global.
- Consulta de movimientos.
- Consulta de cuentas.
- Servicios de tarjetas: saldo disponible de tarjetas de crédito, pago de tarjeta prepagada y candado virtual.
- Transferencias propias y otros bancos, registradas en el directorio de Bancamiga en línea.
- Transacciones de pago móvil interbancario, incluyendo pagos persona a persona (P2P), persona a comercio (P2C), comercio a persona (C2P)
- Pagos a Comercios afiliados al servicio P2C.
- Pagos de servicios como electricidad, telecomunicaciones, televisión por suscripción, recargas telefónicas, pesos, estacionamiento, aseo urbano, transporte, entre otros.
- Directorio personalizado.
