bluejetty:00035889:ios.name: ScorePDF: Sheet Music Viewer
bluejetty:00035889:ios.summary:
A sheet music viewer app with easy page turning.
Turn pages with taps and swipes.
You can also reorder the pages of your sheet music.
Easy Page Turning
- You can turn pages with taps and swipes.
- Supports Bluetooth page-turning foot pedal
bluejetty:00035889:ios.description:
A sheet music viewer app with easy page turning.
Turn pages with taps and swipes.
You can also reorder the pages of your sheet music.
Easy Page Turning
- You can turn pages with taps and swipes.
- Supports Bluetooth page-turning foot pedals.
- Tap assignments can be set to: previous page, left/right, top/bottom, next page, or disabled.
- Swipe gestures can be toggled on or off individually for up, down, left, and right.
- Actions other than page turning (such as displaying the menu or writing annotations) can be assigned to gestures that won’t interfere with page turning, such as long-pressing or tapping the top or bottom edges.
- Zoom operations on the sheet music (pinch or double-tap) can also be toggled on or off.
Page Reordering
- Reordering the pages makes page turning easier during repeats, dal segno, codas, and similar situations.
- When adding pages via reordering, you can add and drag multiple pages at once—not just one.
- You can also delete pages or add blank pages.
Annotations on Sheet Music
- You can write handwritten annotations on your sheet music.
- Two types of pens, markers, and an eraser are available, with undo and redo functions.
- Pens and markers allow you to choose line thickness and color, and you can draw straight lines.
- An eyedropper tool lets you pick up colors from the screen.
- You can output a PDF that includes your annotations.
Setlist
- You can group multiple pieces of sheet music into a setlist for continuous viewing without reopening files.
- Tapping the title in the menu bar displays the list of sheet music in the setlist; tapping one jumps to that piece.
Bookmark
- You can add bookmarks to specific pages of your sheet music.
- Bookmarks can have custom titles.
- Tapping the title in the menu bar displays a list of bookmarks; tapping one jumps to that page.
Page Layout
- You can choose from single-page, two-page (spread), fit width, fit height, half page (top/bottom), or half page (left/right) layouts for your sheet music.
- The layout can automatically change based on the screen orientation.
- When selecting fit width, the sheet music is displayed at full screen width, making it easier to view on small devices.
Color Filter
- You can apply a color filter to your sheet music, choosing from sepia, green, or inverted.
- If you find the white of the sheet music too bright, this setting may improve readability.
Adding Sheet Music
- You can add sheet music in PDF format.
- In the sheet music list screen, tapping the plus button at the bottom right lets you add PDF files from your device. (In the setlist screen, tapping the plus button opens the setlist addition screen.)
- You can also add sheet music by sharing PDF files from other apps.
- Multiple pieces of sheet music can be added at once.
Managing Sheet Music
- The label feature lets you add labels to sheet music or setlists, allowing you to filter by multiple labels.
- Tapping the search bar lets you search for sheet music or setlists by title.
- Sheet music and setlists can be sorted by title, creation date, or last viewed.
Customization
- Supports dark mode.
- Allows you to change the theme color.
- Features a simple design adhering to Material Design principles.

bluejetty:00180842:ios.name: inSitu Sales 2.0: DSD & Orders
bluejetty:00180842:ios.summary: inSitu Sales is an all-in-one mobile solution for field sales, consumer products distribution and B2B e-commerce. The app and e-commerce portal offers mobile invoicing, estimate and sales order creation, secure mobile payment processing, di
bluejetty:00180842:ios.description:
inSitu Sales is an all-in-one mobile solution for field sales, consumer products distribution and B2B e-commerce. The app and e-commerce portal offers mobile invoicing, estimate and sales order creation, secure mobile payment processing, digital product catalog, GPS sales route creation and tracking, territory management, and integration with QuickbooksⓇ, SAPⓇ, FreshbooksⓇ, MicroSoft ExcelⓇ, and XeroⓇ software. 
KEY FEATURES:
-MOBILE INVOICING AND ORDERING
With access to product inventory and pricing information, your sales team can quickly and efficiently create estimates, sales orders and invoices in the field. Connect a mobile device to a mobile printer for proof of delivery. 
-ACCEPT CREDIT CARD PAYMENTS ON THE GO
Credit and debit card payments can be securely recorded with the app. Our mobile payment system enables acceptance with manual entry, a card reader, barcode scanner or a bluetooth scanner. 
- GPS TRACKING & ROUTE PLANNING 
Maximize productivity and decrease operational costs with the ability to create assigned territories for your sales teams, plan routes, and track field activity with GPS. 
- DIGITAL CATALOG 
Increase upsell and cross-selling opportunities with the convenience of a digital product catalog with high resolution product images, inventory, pricing, UOM, minimum & case quantity data. Create custom price lists, transfer inventory between warehouses, and generate a PDF catalog for download. Works well at trade shows, warehouses, retail stores - wherever you need to make a sale! 
- SEAMLESS INTEGRATION WITH QuickBooks® 
Two-way QuickBooks® desktop and online data sync: Customers, Items, Inventory sites, price levels, sales orders, estimates, invoices, payments, credit memos, and more. Also syncs seamlessly with SAPⓇ, FreshbooksⓇ, MicroSoft ExcelⓇ, and XeroⓇ software. 
-REAL TIME COMMUNICATION 
Create custom forms and questionnaires with text, photos and captured signatures. Email sales orders, estimates, and invoices to customers and colleagues quickly. Compatible with Bixolon, Zebra and Air Printers to provide customers with receipts and proof of delivery in the field. 
- WORKS ONLINE and OFF
Data entered into the app is stored in the mobile device and transferred once an Internet connection is made. 
-ANALYTICS 
Analyze sales, marketing, inventory and delivery route data by sales rep or customer. Dozens of pre-loaded reports available as well as the ability to create custom reports, surveys and forms.

bluejetty:00156801:ios.description:
EdVisorly is the one stop shop for students looking to transfer from community college to a 4-year university. Discover transfer friendly universities, connect with university admissions teams, plan your community college courses, apply to universities for free and more! 
We get it, the transfer process can be a tricky one. How many credits do I need to transfer? What classes should I take? Is financial aid available? You’ve got questions, and we’ve got the tools to help you answer those questions and make your transfer journey a seamless one! 
DISCOVER TRANSFER FRIENDLY UNIVERSITIES 
Explore schools that identify with your unique needs or interests 
Discover academic facts for each university 
Find noteworthy degree programs 
Get updated financial aid information and tuition costs 
Uncover available university scholarships 
CHAT DIRECTLY WITH UNIVERSITY ADMISSIONS
Message university admissions counselors directly through the app 
Ask questions about courses, your major, etc 
PLAN YOUR COMMUNITY COLLEGE COURSES
Determine what credits you need to transfer 
Find out what courses are required for your major 
JOIN STUDENT CHAT GROUPS 
Connect with like-minded students interested in your major 
Connect with students in your geographic region 
Ask other real students about their transfer journey 
Share tips, ask questions, and more! 
FREE & EASY APPLICATIONS 
Apply to universities through the app for FREE - yep, that means no application fees 
Applications through EdVisorly require less steps, less questions, and less hassle 
TAILOR YOUR EXPERIENCE 
Choose from a variety of identifiers to tailor your app experience 
Identifiers include: First-Generation, Foster Youth, Honors Student, International Student, LGBTQIA+, Faith-Based, Low Income/Pell Eligible, Parent, Veteran, Rural, Student Athlete, Student With a Disability, and Undocumented 
Find more valuable information and transfer student tips on our TikTok: tiktok.com/@joinedvisorly

bluejetty:00088958:ios.name: Monster Knights - Fantasy ARPG
bluejetty:00088958:ios.summary: Calling all aspiring Battle Summoners! Prepare for an epic odyssey as you rally a motley crew of legendary knights and monster heroes. Take direct control of these formidable champions, unleash their might, smash orc hordes, and fight colos
bluejetty:00088958:ios.description:
Calling all aspiring Battle Summoners! Prepare for an epic odyssey as you rally a motley crew of legendary knights and monster heroes. Take direct control of these formidable champions, unleash their might, smash orc hordes, and fight colossal bosses, in hack and slash rumble battles.
Monster Knights blends the best charms of Retro Action RPG and Casual MMO like peanut butter and jelly, serving up an irresistible ARPG experience! Join us now on the newest game server, immersing yourself in this fun retro fantasy ARPG. Summon knights, smash epic monsters, enjoy super brawl hack and slash action.
Please note this Action RPG game is in English only, thank you.
Game Features
- Engaging hack and slash Action RPG features super fun smash brawl style monster battles and epic boss fights, in side-scrolling arcade platformer missions.
- Summon and take direct control of a diverse roster of fantasy retro heroes, including legendary knights, mythical elves, and epic monsters in this ARPG. The dynamic and innovative combat system lets you switch control to any hero mid battle and unleash devastating combos.
- Avoid various environment traps, fight dragons, dodge goblin bombers, smash cannon squads, and defeat epic bosses! Fight through well-designed comical arcade battle stages is super fun.
- Retro style cartoon, comic, and anime graphics with smashing special battle skill effects. Pleasing to the eyes and fun to watch.
- You can quickly Sweep and Raid almost any cleared stages. Skip hours of repetitive grinding, and save time. Your team of legendary heroes will grow stronger each day even with a busy life schedule.
- Featuring Clans, Arena, Tournament, World Chat, and many other exciting retro MMO elements while not being overly demanding. Play at your own pace or fight for the top ranks in this ARPG, it’s your choice.
- No VIP Levels, No in-game Ads. Your support means the world to us! There are Supporter Rewards but no VIP levels to pressure overspending.
- All game progress is securely stored online. Play anywhere, anytime.
Follow our official Monster Knights Facebook page for news and message us for support:
https://www.facebook.com/monsterknightsfb
Backstory
Battle summoners are the most powerful mages in the world, able to summon and control the spirits of legendary war heroes and monsters in battle. After your hometown fell to rampaging orcs years ago, you joined an academy under a master. A decade later, your master vanished, leaving behind a cryptic letter. Now, chasing clues, you arrive at a town near the elven woods under orc siege. This time, you can change things...
Game Features
Full Hero Control
In this fantasy action RPG, take control over dozens of comic heroes. Summon heroes from four races: Human, Elf, Orc, and Demon, and three classes: Warrior, Archer, and Mage. Each brawl war hero in this fantasy anime RPG offers unique powerful skills for you to smash monster hordes! Auto battle is possible to just watch the hack and slash action in this retro anime ARPG.
Engaging MMO Elements
Clans, World Chat, World Bosses, Arena, and various other exciting fantasy MMO elements are seamlessly integrated into this classic retro action RPG. Earn plentiful rewards from diverse PvP gameplay, with no penalties for losing – just come back stronger and try again later!
Rumble Action Battles & Epic Boss Fights
Navigate your summoned monster and knight heroes, and smash through legions of enemies in action arcade platformer style war battles. Simply tap on the hero portrait to swiftly switch between during battles. Heroes move, brawl, hack and slash at your command in this fantasy retro anime ARPG rumble.
Get Monster Knights now, join the fun Arcade Anime Action RPG!

Full Hero Control

Each brawl war hero in this fantasy anime RPG offers unique powerful skills for you to smash monster hordes! Auto battle is possible to just watch the hack and slash action in this retro anime ARPG.

Engaging MMO Elements

Navigate your summoned monster and knight heroes, and smash through legions of enemies in action arcade platformer style war battles. Simply tap on the hero portrait to swiftly switch between during battles. Heroes move, brawl, hack and slash at your command in this fantasy retro anime ARPG rumble.

bluejetty:00161147:ios.name: Telugu Calendar 2027: e-Puja
bluejetty:00161147:ios.summary:
Simple and easy to understand Telugu Calendar app for the years 2026 and 2027 catering to Telugu speaking people across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and around the world. 
An offline Telugu Calendar 2027 app providing detailed Panchanga
bluejetty:00161147:ios.description:
Simple and easy to understand Telugu Calendar app for the years 2026 and 2027 catering to Telugu speaking people across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and around the world. 
An offline Telugu Calendar 2027 app providing detailed Panchangam, Rashi Phalalu, Jatakam, Festival schedules, Virtual Puja mandir, mantra japam and spiritual content.
Telugu Horoscope (Rashi Phalalu, Telugu Jatakam) details are based on both moon sign and sun sign which are provided by renowned astrologer Vakkantham Chandramouli's Janmakundali.com. Prediction details for all the 12 zodiac signs are provided under rashi phalalu section.
Digital puja feature provides e-Mandir experience along with deity's mantra japam for 108 times. As part of e-pooja user can offer flowers, aarti, incense, light diya, ring bell and break coconut.
Telugu Bhagavad Gita, Ramayanam, Mahabharatham, Sribhagavatham, Karthika Puranam and Sthala Puranam mythological stories are written by our dedicated team in an easy-to-understand language which can be read by people of all age groups.
We provide you detailed panchangam results containing Telugu year name, uttarayanam/dakshinayanam, ruthuvu (season name), masam (month name), paksham (fortnight), suryodayam (sunrise), suryasthamayam (sunset), vaaram (week name), tithi, nakshatram, yogam, Karanam, varjyam, durmuhurtham, rahu kalam, yamagandam, Gulika kalam, amrutha gadiyalu and Abhijith muhurtham.
Features:

bluejetty:00163961:ios.description:
Practice listening, reading and vocabulary with New Concept English, Books 1-4.
App menus and study translations support Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean. This version does not include an English-language interface. English lesson text and audio remain in English.
Optimized for iPhone Duo
Unfold to view the lesson alongside vocabulary or learning points when space allows. Fold to return to a single-column layout. Your reading position, playback state and practice input are retained as you switch between the inner and outer displays.
Guided explanations and practice
Explore sentence explanations, word combinations and sentence patterns in 39 lessons from Book 1 and 50 lessons from Book 2. Each supported lesson offers four learning points and eight multiple-choice or word-order questions. Return to the original sentence after practice and keep your progress on your device. Guide screens, explanations and exercises support Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Other lessons remain available for reading and listening.
Lessons and audio
Choose a book and lesson, read the original English alongside a translation, play audio sentence by sentence, and show or hide the translation.
Vocabulary practice
Check meanings and illustrations, listen to pronunciations, and practice word recall, dictation and multiple-choice questions. Some abstract words use diagrams or meaning cards.
Wordbook and search
Review words by learning status and revisit mistakes. Search English words or meanings in the selected study language.
Offline learning
Lesson text, audio and images are included in the app, with no separate book downloads. Ads and external online dictionaries require an internet connection. Learning records stay on your device; this version does not provide accounts or cross-device syncing.
Language settings
Follow your system preferences or choose a supported language in settings. Some original covers and images retain their original text. External dictionaries may not follow the selected app language.

TacticalPad is the most complete tool for coaches, assistant coaches, performance analysts, journalists and sport enthusiasts.
TacticalPad is not only used by football’s technical staff (couch, assistants, observers, etc), but also by journalists, bloggers, teachers and sport enthusiasts. Because of its high quality graphics, it is widely used to generate content for blogs, social networks, lectures, newspapers, etc.
Check below some features and scenarios that make TacticalPad so powerful:
• Projects with multiple tactical boards 
• Animated plays
• 3D visualization
• 3D animation with realistic graphics and actions
• Several options for football/soccer pitches (whiteboards templates), including different sports like: GAA, Football (American), Rugby, Lacrosse, Field hockey, Beach Soccer, Volleyball, etc
• High quality and attractive graphics
• Add visual effects to: highlight players; show connection lines; pitch areas; trail movement paths 
• Export all created content to:
 - Images
 - Videos
 - Documents with images and notes
 - Social networks
 - Whatsapp
• Synchronize and share your projects in the cloud (Google Drive, Dropbox, One Drive) with the feature Repositories
• Use the Notepad feature to categorize add description for your drills, tactical analysis, etc. Also supports The FA 4 Corner Model.
• Attach videos from Youtube and Vimeo
• Many document export templates available for you to create your playbook
• Digital ink support:
 - Free drawing
 - Lines
 - Arrows
 - Shapes (circle, rectangle, polygons)
 - Dashed
 - Configurable color and thickness
 - Eraser
• Lots of training items
• Add you own custom pitches and items
• Team roster settings with:
 - Names
 - Number
 - Positions
 - Lineups
 - Pitcures
 - Other info
• Teams and players’ appearances:
 - Classic button
 - Triangle
 - Jersey
 - Players' pictures
 - Custom image
 - Colors
 - Badge
• Save, load and set your favorite teams
• Use it in the bench, pre-game presentations, training sessions, half time talks, daily chats, home, etc. Use it anytime and anywhere by everyone
• Project to a TV or projector
• There is more, much more. TacticalPad is constantly updated with new features requested by our great community of users and feedback from clubs and federations

bluejetty:00141351:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00141351:ios.description:
Build a better relationship with food - free food diary app.
Food Diary is a free intuitive eating companion designed to help you stop binge eating, understand your habits, and eat without guilt. No calories. No macros. No diet rules. Just a calm, honest food journal that helps you see why you eat the way you do.
What is Food Diary?
Food Diary is a free food journal built around intuitive eating principles. Unlike calorie counters and macro trackers, Food Diary focuses on awareness, not restriction. It's for anyone who feels out of control around food and wants to stop binge eating for good, not just until Monday.
Stop binge eating with your personal food journal!
Most people who struggle with binge eating aren't lacking willpower. They're stuck in a cycle of restrict, binge, guilt, and repeat. Food Diary helps you understand that cycle, break it, and build eating habits that actually last.
Log meals without judgment in your free food diary. See how your mood, hunger, and habits connect over time. Understand the emotional triggers behind binge eating. Build a kinder, more intuitive eating mindset, one meal at a time.
Why Food Diary is the best free food journal for intuitive eating!
Free food diary with no calorie counting or macro tracking. Daily, weekly, and monthly insights from your food journal. Record meals, hunger levels, and emotions in one place. Intuitive eating tips and bite-sized lessons in every update. Personalised patterns that help you stop binge eating over time. A food journal that supports you, not judges you.
Intuitive eating, not another diet.
Food Diary is grounded in intuitive eating and habit psychology. It won't tell you what to eat. It helps you understand yourself, so the restrict-binge-guilt cycle loses its grip. This is a free food journal for people who are done with dieting and ready to try something that actually works.
Who is Food Diary for?
Anyone who wants to stop binge eating without starting another diet. People exploring intuitive eating for the first time. Anyone who feels guilty about food most days and wants that to change. People who've tried every food journal, calorie app, and clean eating plan and are ready for a different approach.
Free to download. Better by design.
Food Diary is free to download and free to start. Premium unlocks weekly insights, personalised food journal analysis, and bite-sized lessons on why.

bluejetty:00021255:ios.description:
Military Retire Pay application designed to view your current, past, and proposed future military pay by rank & years of service. It helps to calculate an estimate of retirement pay based on the provided information.
All the calculations are made based on the 2024 military pay charts based on the December announcement of a 5.2% pay increase by the Department of Defense.
You can choose the year for the calculation. This app supports the pay chart for yer 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024. You can change the year within settings.
This application includes extremely developed algorithms to calculate your retirement pay. You will be provided approximate compensation based on your personalised inputs. You can compare multiple benefits to determine which retirement option is best for you.
Military Retire works for following types of retirement plans:
- Final Pay
- High-3
- BRS (Blended Retirement System)
- CSB/REDUX
- Disability
Features:
• Retirement Pay: Based on rank, time in service(years & months), and date of retirement.
• SBP (Survivor Benefit Plan): Calculate SBP Benefit and Premium. It works to calculate the SBP for given retirement pay.
• Tricare Benefits: Calculate Tricare Premium
• Disability Pay: Calculate disability pay based on disability rating along with other options.
• VGLI Coverage (Veterans Group Life Insurance): Calculate VGLI premium based on the given coverage.
• Create multiple profiles for retirement pay
• Compare Active Pay between two ranks. Graphical representation for easy overview & understanding.
• Share your calculated retirement pay along with other details.
• Mark favorite your profile and put it on top of the list.
• Clear all profiles and its related data in one go from the settings.
• One tap Reset - Reset your working calculation of retirement pay and start from scratch.
• Annual Pay Raise History - See the history of annual pay raise since the year 2007. It helps you to understand the annual raises of the past.
Disclaimer: All the calculations and information provided are estimated compensation based on your personalized inputs. This calculator is provided for informational purposes only. It is not intended to be used as an investment advisory tool or as a guarantee of the duration of the elected monthly payment amount. Please consult your counselor for more details.
Any information is not transmitted to any 3rd party nor it saved on any cloud. All data and calculations are saved within your device only.
No login account required to use this app. Once this app has been downloaded it can work offline for any calculations.
For any other suggestion or feedback do email us on "gosalapps@gmail.com"

bluejetty:00154106:android.description:
With the app Animal Sounds for kids and toddlers your child will learn more than 40 sounds of animals in a playful way.
Discover the animals in 9 different worlds with your child. Animals around a farm or in the stall, exotic animals in a safari, animals around the sea or pond, animals in the wood and meadow.
By tapping the animals they will move and make their respective noise or sound. Also trees, bushes, campfire, lighthouse, boats or flowers and other things can be moved by tapping them.
But pay attention: maybe your child will find the hidden animals.
Start a fascinating voyage of discovery with your child, maybe to bridge any possible waiting time. Or maybe your child is ill and has to be calm, then our App Animal Sounds for kids and toddlers can help you and your child can learn by playing.
Get a first impression of Animal Sounds kids & toddlers and look at our YouTube Video.
We hope you have fun with this new app "Animal Sounds kids & toddlers".
Animal Sounds kids & toddlers is for all Android devices compatible.
Animal Sounds kids & toddlers was developed by TapDevStudio. We are an independent company and we are specialized in developing Apps for kids. Animal Noise for kids & toddlers will be regularly updated and improved. Please help us and send your ideas and suggestions.

bluejetty:00089346:ios.description:
Since 2012 at the App Store.
Apple Entrepreneur Camp alumni.
Featured in "Apps we love" in Brazil.
iSenhas is a secure and smart way to organize and take care of passwords.
Simple to use and user-friendly interface. We intelligently automate the organization of large numbers of passwords with a Smart Folder algorithm and automatic icon detection. 
iSenhas values transparency. Part of the source code is publicly available on GitHub, allowing the community to review, audit, and follow the ongoing evolution of the project's security.
Increase your productivity having all your passwords in hand with:
- Fast unlocking of passwords through Touch ID or Face ID.
- Automatic verification of your passwords strength with a list of vulnerability alerts.
- Dark web leak check tool.
- Icons automatically added to passwords through smart text recognition.
- Smart algorithm for automatic organization of passwords in folders.
- Automatic filling of passwords on your smartphone keyboard.
- Anti theft protection.
- Strong and random password generator with special characters, numbers, upper and lower case letters.
- Storage of infinite passwords on the Premium plan and 5 for free.
- Sharing passwords with other devices using the same email account.
- Algorithm to import passwords from Google, Apple Passwords, 1Password, Dashlane, Bitwarden, Proton Pass, LastPass and Cyclonis.
- History of old passwords.
- AES-256 GCM encryption with zero-knowledge architecture option.
- Storing and managing notes.
- Storing and managing Passkeys.
- Storing and managing documents information.
- Storing and managing two factor authentication codes.
- Storing and managing instant transfer codes like Pix, FedNow, MB Way and others.
No more worrying about creating, storing, managing and remembering your passwords. Gain focus to your day-to-day.
Part of the icons is provided by Icons8.
If you have any questions please contact us, we are looking forward to your feedback to further improve this tool.

Start a magical journey with cute dinosaur pets, and rescue the Nya cat together!

Boost your brain and have fun in this free offline shooting game. With new features, you'll be a warrior for justice to rescue the baby pet dragons and help Nya reunite with his family.

How to play the fun bubble burst game?
- Aim balloons strategically and release the bubbles to shoot.
- Blast balls by matching three or more bubbles.
- Use fewer shots to score higher and try to win 3 stars.

- Drop balls to charge the witch's magical orb creating a bomb bubble.
- Beam Cannon destroys a bubble line in the chosen direction.
- Thunderball crushes a row of everything.
- Blackstorms can absorb any ball of one color.
- Starburst converts unwanted bubbles into magical power.
- More amazing power-ups for you to explore.
Addictive bubble exploding game features.
- Fun levels galore.
- Free offline brain tester game. 
- Continuous level update.
- Beautiful visual effects.
- Cute pet baby and Nya cat.

bluejetty:00137361:ios.description:
Improve your mental health by playing brain games! 
BrainBloom is a brain training app designed to enhance your cognitive abilities with logic games, mental recall exercises, brain puzzles, ADHD games, and skillz games.
Mind Games and Brain Teasers
Challenge your mind with a wide variety of thinking games for adults crafted to hone your cognitive abilities and provide a rewarding brain fitness workout. From engaging skillz games that train your math, vocabulary, and logic skills to ADHD games aimed at improving focus and attention, BrainBloom offers something for everyone. Among the variety of mental health games, BrainBloom offers brain games for seniors designed to preserve cognitive health and keep the mind sharp.
Brain Tests & IQ Assessments
Enhance your personal growth with our diverse assessments. Track cognitive progress with IQ and ADHD tests, and explore personality insights through Brain Type and Archetype evaluations. 
Who is BrainBloom for?
Students: Conquer deadlines and ace exams with improved focus and problem-solving skills.
Professionals: Enhance cognitive performance, stay sharp under pressure, and boost critical thinking for better decision-making.
Lifelong Learners: Keep your mind active and engaged, fostering cognitive health as you age.
Enthusiasts of Connect Two Dots, One Line and other logic puzzles, BrainBloom offers stimulating mind games you'll enjoy.
Whether you’re seeking to boost your productivity or simply enjoy some mental stimulation, BrainBloom provides personalized recommendations based on your performance and preferences, ensuring a unique and effective brain training experience tailored to your needs.
The more you use BrainBloom, the more you'll advance your cognitive abilities with brain teasers that improve problem-solving and refine your critical thinking skills.

Privacy Policy: https://brainbloom.me/privacy_policy_findmy

Jdwal allows you to follow soccer scores, stats, standings, matches, and more... it is simple and easy to use.
Why our app?
- We focus on simplicity & ease of use.
- History seasons & data.
- Widgets support: lock screen & home screen (highly customizable).

- Supports VoiceOver screen reader for accessibility needs.
- Player transfers (Transfer Centre).

- Soccer news.

- Team lineups & formations.
- Match statistics.
- Broadcasting channels and commentators.
- Works offline.

- Premier League
- La Liga
- Serie A
- Ligue 1
- Bundesliga
- MLS
- CAF Champions League
- AFC Champions League
- Saudi Pro League
- Egyptian Premier League
- Moroccan Professional League
- Algerian Ligue 1
and more...

- Monthly subscription: $0.99
- Annual subscription: $5.99

- You can choose between multiple subscription options, monthly or annual.

bluejetty:00089648:ios.description:
Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The Baker's app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery, Pickup and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download the Baker's grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your Plus Card Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items
Helpful Everyday Tools
 • Refill and track Baker's Pharmacy prescriptions
 • Use the store locator to find the nearest Baker's store or fuel center
Improving Your Experience
To provide and personalize our offerings, make recommendations, detect and prevent fraud, and improve our services, we use tools that collect and record your data, which may include your searches for and purchases of health and wellness products. We also may share non-sensitive data with third parties, such as advertising and analytics vendors, social networks, technology providers, and research providers. By continuing to use our websites and apps and shop our store, this means you consent to these practices and accept our Terms (https://www.bakersplus.com/i/terms/website-and-app) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.bakersplus.com/i/privacy-policy).
To use the Baker's app, you need a Baker's digital account. You can create a digital account and link your Baker's Rewards ID through the app. Don't have a Rewards ID? You'll get one when you create your digital account and enroll in Baker's Rewards Program. You must be 18 to register for an account or join our rewards program (to obtain a Rewards ID). Terms apply: https://www.bakersplus.com/i/terms/website-and-app.

No Limit Drag Racing 2 is a car racing game that brings the thrill of real driving simulation to your fingertips. 
Immerse yourself in a hyper-real drag racing game with a physics engine built on real drag racing. No Limit Drag Racing 2 offers an unparalleled mobile car racing game experience that’s as close as you can get to the real thing without actually heading out on the track.
Join millions of players and engage in intense head-to-head competitions, showcasing your racing and drifting skills in one of the most exciting high-speed car games.
DOMINATE THE RACING GAMES SCENE
- Full car customization: Paint, wraps, decals, and more!
- Advanced tuning: Gearing, suspension, timing, and dyno testing.
- Leaderboards: Compete globally and rise to the top!
- Multiplayer: Battle in car racing games against real players worldwide.
- Try drifting in Free Roam mode games to earn bonus points and coins.
- Membership perks: Exclusive badges, discounts, gold bonuses, and more.
COLLECT UNIQUE CARS
- Collect high-end & classic cars, import tuners, trucks, dragsters, bikes, and more. 
- See your dream cars shine in high-octane car racing games.
- Compete using the cars your drag racing heroes drive.

bluejetty:00097134:ios.description:
Sown falls. Monsters Rise. Your planet faces a sudden monster invasion. Now it's your turn to lead. Step up as the royal king who will summon, merge, and evolve adorable heroes to protect your planet from endless waves of invaders!
Evo Defense is an innovative merge & evolve roguelike tower defense game where strategy meets random luck. Every match lasts only 3 minutes but offers hundreds of strategic builds — quick, exciting, and endlessly replayable! Designed for both casual enjoyment and competitive PvP depth. Get ready for the brand new casual strategic TD experience!
[Game Features]
◆ Easy to Start, Fun to Master
Just three simple steps to victory — Summon, Merge, Enhance!
◆ Triple Randomness, Endless Surprises
Summons, skills, and 2-in-1 merging are all random. No two matches are ever the same. Random mechanics and hero progression keep each match fresh.
◆ Quick 3-Minute Matches
Easy one-hand controls and 3-minute matches fit perfectly into mobile lifestyles.
◆ Adorable Yet Strategic
A vibrant visual style with deep tactical choices beneath its cute surface.
Seven hero classes, countless formations and strategic combos!
Richer monster attributes require more adaptive strategy builds (King x Heroes x Weapon x Totem x Cloak x Fort. And more coming...)!
◆ Infinite Challenges & Multiple Modes
Explore diverse game modes that redefine tower defense — PvE stages, creative PvP Arena, Co-op mode, Guild Challenges, Mini Games, and more!
Team up in Co-op, fight alongside guildmates, or climb the global PvP leaderboard. Experience the ultimate test of luck, teamwork, and strategy!
Join us now to start a brand new casual strategic tower defense adventure!

POPULAR PRODUCTS
• Layflat photo books

bluejetty:00023984:ios.name: LCSW Exam Prep 2026
bluejetty:00023984:ios.summary:
LCSW Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you score high on the Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) certification exam administered by the Association of Social Work Boards (ASWB) on your first attempt.
LCSW Exam Pre
bluejetty:00023984:ios.description:
LCSW Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you score high on the Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) certification exam administered by the Association of Social Work Boards (ASWB) on your first attempt.
LCSW Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into concepts related to LCSW exam preparation, but also helps you increase your confidence in passing the exam on your first attempt by practicing hundreds of exam-like questions.
### Passing the exam on the first attempt ###
In LCSW Exam Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the range of official exam requirements. According to the exam requirements, you must master several subjects in order to successfully pass the LCSW exam.
Specifically, these subjects include:
- Human Development, Diversity & Behavior (24%)
- Assessment, Diagnosis & Treatment Planning (30%)
- Psychotherapy, Clinical Intervention & Case Management (27%)
- Professional Values & Ethics (19%)
To help you pass the exam, our exam experts have carefully analyzed and broken down the above subjects. You will need to practice all 4 subjects that will help you pass the exam with confidence!
### Key Features ###
- Over 1000 practice questions with detailed answer explanations for each question
- Specialized practice by content area with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the LCSW exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that every time you practice on LCSW Exam Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions, while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high on not only the LCSW exam, but any other exam!
### Purchases, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://lcsw.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://lcsw.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.htmlIf 
Please let us know if you have any questions or comments about your use by emailing us at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 business days at the latest.

bluejetty:00162637:ios.description:
You no longer need to open dozens of websites and apps - the Tutu app has everything you need to travel. Here you can buy train, plane, and bus tickets, as well as inexpensive hotel, hostel, or apartment rentals. No registration, in a few minutes. 
Specify your destination and compare prices for different modes of transportation to choose the best option. Now in your phone:
Hotels and all kinds of accommodation in Russia and the world. In the app we can:
- Book a hotel, hotel, apartment and other accommodation.
- Choose a suitable hotel in Moscow, St. Petersburg, Sochi, Kaliningrad, Kazan, Anapa, Krasnodar, Adler, Yekaterinburg, Nizhny Novgorod, Novosibirsk and other cities throughout Russia from over 100 thousand options.
- Get support from our experts without leaving the app.
Tickets for trains and not only. In the app you can:
- Read passenger reviews, choose and buy train tickets online.
- Learn train schedule for six months ahead.
- Choose a ticket and keep it for yourself to redeem later.
- Buy a ticket for the train "Sapsan", "Lastochka", "Strizh" and many others.
Airline tickets from trusted carriers. In the application you can:
- View the current airline schedule.
- Buy cheap airline tickets quickly and easily.
- Buy tickets from leading Russian and foreign airlines: Aeroflot, Pobeda, UTair, S7 Airlines, Ural Airlines, and others.
- Book tickets and pay later.
Tickets for buses in Russia, CIS and Europe from 5000 reliable carriers. In the application you can:
- Buy bus tickets online and not stand in line at the bus station.
- View the bus schedule for any destination.
- Get tickets for intercity buses from Moscow, St. Petersburg, Yekaterinburg, Rostov-on-Don, Minsk, Volgograd, Nizhny Novgorod and 10 thousand other cities.
- Learn the route of the bus and read passenger reviews.
Tutu.ru helps travelers on vacation, personal and business trips since 2003.
We are in touch around the clock. If you have any questions please call: 8 800 511-55-63 (calls within Russia are free) or send an email: app@tutu.ru
Tutu.ru - travel service №1 in Russia, according to Similarweb, 2020.
Travel with pleasure!

bluejetty:00099367:ios.name: Snoozers: The End of Snoozing
bluejetty:00099367:ios.summary:
The End of Snoozing ⏰
Snoozers is a beautifully crafted alarm that helps you actually get out of bed. It blends science‑backed wake‑up missions, curated sounds, gentle design, and meaningful insights so your mornings start with clarity, no
bluejetty:00099367:ios.description:
The End of Snoozing ⏰
Snoozers is a beautifully crafted alarm that helps you actually get out of bed. It blends science‑backed wake‑up missions, curated sounds, gentle design, and meaningful insights so your mornings start with clarity, not chaos.
What makes Snoozers different:
Snoozers doesn’t just ring and hope. It engages your brain, guides your habits, and gives you feedback that’s actually useful. Set your goals, choose your mission, pick a sound that fits your vibe, and trust the app to support consistent, confident mornings.
Wake‑up missions (science‑backed):
Turn off your alarm by completing a quick cognitive activation. You choose the challenge and difficulty:
• Math Mission: Solve a series of problems with adjustable difficulty and question count. Great when you need sharp focus fast.
• Typing Mission: Type uplifting phrases you select, with customizable length and number of phrases. Builds momentum and positive tone.
• Memory Mission: Repeat visual patterns with selectable difficulty and attempts. Wake up your recall and attention.
Every mission tracks ring‑to‑start time and completion time, so you can measure progress—not just intentions.
Sounds that set the tone:
Find your perfect morning energy with a curated mix—from soft and gentle birds to fun, motivational, and classic alarm sounds. Preview within the app, switch anytime, and keep favorites handy.
Reliability, by design:
Snoozers is engineered with thoughtful safeguards so your alarms are dependable once you’ve allowed notifications. Smart scheduling aims to keep your alarm on time—even when your phone is locked, or your ringer is off, or Do Not Disturb is on.
Goals that actually stick:
Turn vague ambition into clear targets:
• Wake‑Up Time Goal: Pick your daily “up by” time.
• Mission Speed Goal: Choose a completion target (e.g., finish in under 3 minutes).
Each alarm can count toward one or both goals. Progress compounds—and your streak grows—when you hit them consistently.
Insights that matter:
Understand your mornings at a glance:
• Ring‑to‑Start: How quickly you begin the mission.
• Mission Duration: How long it takes to complete.
• Success Rate: Based on your two goals (wake time and mission speed).
• Streak: Consecutive days meeting both goals, designed to motivate—not shame.
• Day‑of‑Week Patterns and Wake Time snapshots to spot trends and adjust.
You can optionally exclude specific alarms from stats to keep your data clean and honest.
Designed to feel good:
Fluid animations, tactile haptics, and a calm, modern interface keep friction low and focus high. Per‑alarm volume with gentle fade‑in and vibration makes waking humane, not jarring. Weather‑aware greetings and rotating sleep tips add a small moment of care to your morning ritual.
Simple, private, and optional cloud backup:
Your alarms and insights live on your device by default. Prefer peace‑of‑mind backup? Sign in to securely store alarms in the cloud and sync across devices. Change your display name anytime in settings.
Thoughtful details:
• Create, edit, and reorder alarms with ease.
• Pick repeat days and labels that fit your life.
• Preview and switch sounds instantly.
• Mission settings per alarm (difficulty, counts, phrases, attempts).
• Portrait‑first design, fast performance, and minimal battery use.
Privacy & transparency:
Your data is yours. We don’t sell personal information. Cloud backup is opt‑in. You’re always in control.
A note on reliability:
For best results, open Snoozers after install, allow notifications, and keep system permissions enabled. Snoozers is designed to ring reliably under normal iOS conditions with notifications allowed.
Give your future self a head start. Rest easy tonight—wake up ready with Snoozers.
---

To leave all the pirates and treasure seekers in our children dreams and fantasies? Of course not! When life feels uncertain, it helps to talk to someone who can offer clarity.
Orb connects you to experienced readers for live psychic chats, tarot card readings, and medium sessions — all through private, easy-to-use messaging.
Whether you're facing relationship questions, emotional crossroads, or future decisions, Orb offers a space to explore your thoughts, reflect, and gain new perspectives.
What You Can Do:
Start a Live Psychic Chat: 
Ask what's on your heart. A live psychic is just a message away.
Get a Tarot Card Reading: 
Choose your spread and explore the messages behind the cards. Find meaning in what lies ahead.
Talk to a Medium: 
Open a conversation through a spiritual lens. Our mediums offer thoughtful connection and insight.
Use Psychic Txt on Your Terms: 
Send your question anytime and receive responses you can reflect on at your own pace.
Many users turn to psychic readings in times of change, heartache, or uncertainty. Orb is designed to offer a calm, supportive space where you can feel heard — and perhaps see things from a new perspective.
Whether it’s a tarot card reading for insight, a medium session for connection, or simply a moment of stillness through psychic txt, your journey is yours — and it starts here.

-Live and on-demand psychic chat
-Intuitive tarot card reading options
-In-depth psychic readings
-Access to mediums with spiritual perspectives
-Flexible messaging for fast or reflective use
-Topics include love, life path, decisions, and more
-Private and easy-to-use interface

bluejetty:00026751:ios.summary: Weather Hi-Def Radar Forecast is a simple yet powerful weather radar app that features real-time animated weather radar images in vivid color on a highly-responsive interactive map. View future forecasts and detailed weather information wit
bluejetty:00026751:ios.description:
Weather Hi-Def Radar Forecast is a simple yet powerful weather radar app that features real-time animated weather radar images in vivid color on a highly-responsive interactive map. View future forecasts and detailed weather information with map layers, including fire & air quality index. See freezing rain on the radar so you can anticipate hazardous road conditions. Stay ahead of the weather with advanced alerts, including lightning & precipitation notifications so you’re always prepared.
Features include:
• Sharp weather radar imagery display current & future radar images
• View weather map full-screen on your device and hide the app buttons for a crystal clear detailed overview of weather radar activity
• Tap & hold on the map to check current weather conditions and forecasts 
• Get real-time push notifications for severe weather conditions including floods, severe storms, temperature advisories, wildfires, snow, high winds, and air quality
• Set multiple locations for fast & easy access to weather forecasts, to view current road conditions, barometric pressure readings, and detailed weather information for all your saved locations
• View your GPS position, direction of travel, and elevation on the map with location enabled
• Monitor local air pollution data with AQI
• Quickly view hourly weather with Lock & Home Screen Widgets
• Use Fire Overlay to monitor active wildfires near & far
Show Weather Layers on the map to see past weather imagery (for U.S. locations & some non-U.S. locations where available)
• Radar layer
• Clouds layer
• Clouds & Radar layer
• Temperature layer
• Water Temperature layer
• Wind Speed layer
• Snowfall layer
• Road Weather layer
• Wave Height layer
Severe Weather Overlays and alerts on the map to see severe weather warning boxes(U.S. locations only):
• Tap alert boxes on the map to view info
• Tornado and Thunderstorm watches and warnings
• Flood watches and warnings
• Hurricane and Tropical Storm forecast tracks
• Hurricane and Tropical Storm watches and warnings
• Storm Tracks showing direction of storm in the next few minutes
• Winter storm watches and warnings
• Marine and coastal alerts
• Earthquakes
• View Lightning strikes on the map
Purchase Storm Watch Plus to unlock the following:
• Future Animated Radar - See wind, snow, rain and clouds move across the map
• 15-Day Forecast - View in-depth weather forecasts
• Advanced Weather Layers - Road weather, air quality, UV index, wind, surface temps, tides & more
• Severe Weather Overlays - Lightning trikes, wildfires and storms
• Real-time Weather Alerts - Get notifications including flood, fire, snow, hurricanes and severe storms
• Create & Save Map Views - Save your favorite map layers and overlays for easy access anytime
• Activity & Health Forecasts - See how today’s weather affects your activities & health
• Historical Weather Insights - See three year averages and weather this day, one year ago
• Snow Report - View detailed winter conditions including snow depth & snowfall
• Apple Watch App - Check the current weather, forecasts and radar maps, right from your wrist
• Apple CarPlay Widgets- View weather conditions hands free from your vehicle
• Premium Widgets - View weather details on your Home and Lock Screens

• Unlimited downloads to read anywhere

bluejetty:00061516:ios.description:
Get in FULL control over your work and start focusing on things that matter to you the most.
Paymo is a project management, time tracking, and invoicing app that allows you to keep track of work on the go or at your workplace while monitoring all your projects. Create your to-do list, plan projects, assign tasks, communicate in context, and use it as a time tracker or as an employee time clock. You can also track receipts and create professional-looking invoices on the go.
More than 100.000 users from all over the world rely daily on Paymo for project and time tracking or collaboration.
*** TASK MANAGEMENT & COLLABORATION ***
Bring the team on the same page:
- Create tasks, split them into task lists, or add subtasks to make them more manageable
- View tasks by project, due date, or priority as lists or on a Kanban board
- Set estimated time budgets for each task and measure your efforts accurately
- Comment at a task or project level about the latest project updates
- Attach files to tasks, comments, or projects - bring all content together
- Use the search function to find the desired item in seconds
*** TRACK TIME ON THE GO ***
Eliminate guesstimates, increase productivity, and make projects profitable:
- Track time via the stopwatch or add it manually
- Quickly resume timers with a tap on the play button for recent tasks
- See all your time chronologically in the timesheets area, and easily edit existing time entries
- Check employee timesheets and see active timers
*** PLAN & MANAGE WORK ***
Keep an eye on the progress and your team:
- Plan milestones ahead for important deliverables
- Get an overview of each project’s health
- Keep track of clients and their contacts
- Receive a push notification when a project update is available
*** MOBILE INVOICING ***
Run your business on the go:
- Turn timesheets into an invoice
- Preview invoices before sending them
- Accept online payments & add partial payments in advance
- Store mobile expenses with a camera snap
By downloading this app, you agree to our Terms of Service, which can be found at:
www.paymoapp.com/terms/
Get in touch with us: support@paymoapp.com
Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/Paymo

bluejetty:00131675:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00131675:ios.description:
Learn to tie over 240 knots for fishing, climbing, boating, sailing, camping, scouting and other ropework.
Knots 3D is the original 3D knot-tying app, first released in 2011 and rated 4.9 by tens of thousands of users worldwide. Choose a knot app with care, as your safety may depend on it.
Watch each knot tie itself in 3D, slow it down, and turn it around until it makes sense. Browse by category or type, search by name, common synonym or Ashley Book of Knots (ABoK) number, or describe what you need the knot to do. Save your favorite knots for quick review.
Features:
- 241 knots in over a dozen categories, with new knots added regularly
- No ads, no subscriptions and no in-app purchases. Ever!
- Completely OFFLINE and self-contained. No additional downloads or internet access required!
- Watch knots tie themselves and pause or adjust the speed of the animation at any time
- Rotate knots in 360-degree, 3D views to study them from any angle with a swipe of a finger
- "Scrub" over the knot with a finger to advance or rewind the animation
- Mirror (left-hand) mode, zoom, and rotate the view to match how you hold the rope
- Describe a task in your own words, like "tie a boat to a dock", to find the right knots for the job
- High-res graphics with photorealistic rope textures
- Dark mode and light mode
- List, Card and Icon view options
- Create your own custom categories to group knots, such as "Mastered", "Practice" or "Top Ten"
- Add personal notes, links and your own search keywords to any knot
- Share a knot link by text message, email, social media and more
- ABoK numbers for cross-reference to The Ashley Book of Knots
Includes the knots people look for most: Bowline, Clove Hitch, Figure Eight, Trucker's Hitch, Square Knot, Sheet Bend, Prusik, Taut Line Hitch, Cleat Hitch, Palomar Knot, Uni Knot, Double Fisherman's Knot, Alpine Butterfly, Monkey's Fist, Munter Hitch and many more.
Every knot comes with a description of what it is for and a list of common uses. Most also include the other names the knot goes by, strength and reliability notes, structure, related knots, ABoK numbers and history.
Available in 25 languages:
Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian and Vietnamese
Categories:
- Essential Knots
- Arborist
- Boating
- Camping
- Caving
- Climbing
- Decorative
- Diving
- Fire & Rescue
- Fishing
- Military
- Neckties
- Pioneering
- Rope Care
- Scouting
- Theatre & Film
Types:
- Bends
- Binding
- Coils
- Friction Hitches
- Hitches
- Lashings
- Loops
- Mats
- Multi-Loop
- Quick Release
- Stoppers
- Whippings
The complete list of knots:
https://knots3d.com/en/complete-list
Missing a knot? Suggest one from inside the app.
Knots 3D is a learning reference. Learn from a skilled instructor if you plan to use ropes or knots in a situation where failure could cause property damage, injury, or death.

bluejetty:00131027:ios.description:
Metronome by Tiny Boom is a digital metronome built for one thing: a pulse that stays constant through every exercise, pattern, and instrument.
CORE FEATURES
– Tempo
Set your BPM precisely with the tempo wheel, or tap the button in time with your music. Two ways to find the same beat.
– Time signature
Every meter your score calls for — from 4/4 comfort zones to 7/8 territory.
– Subdivisions
Split the beat into eighths, triplets, sixteenths — whatever the passage needs.
– Deep practice
Clear the screen of everything but the essential pulse. Eliminate visual distractions so it's just you, your instrument, and the beat.
– Practice timer
Control session length without interrupting the flow of practice. Set a limit by time or by measures, hit go, forget the clock's even there.
– Accents & sound
Set your own accent pattern, pick a click sound, choose a color that matches your aesthetic.
– Widgets & Live Activities
Control your session directly from your Home and Lock Screens. Start the click, fine-tune your BPM, launch presets, and track your weekly practice streak without even opening the app.
Metronome by Tiny Boom stays one steady thing while everything else in your practice moves. That's the whole idea.
Questions or Feedback: metronome@tinyboom.com
Privacy Policy: https://tinyboom.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://tinyboom.com/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00024837:ios.description:
Welcome to the most amazing Pink Mansion adventure!
A lovely princess has built a wonderful pink dollhouse made of blocks. She loves surprises and has hidden many toys throughout her huge estate. Now it's your turn to join the fun, explore the mansion, and find all the hidden items!
Choose your challenge:
- Playing as a boy? Find the hidden cars tucked away in secret spots.
- Playing as a girl? Search for beautiful dolls and the magical pony.
Explore and Play:
The Pink Princess House is a perfect place for a grand game of hide-and-seek. With several floors, a lush garden, and rooms filled with posh furniture, there's a lot to discover! Can you find the best hiding spots under tables or in wardrobes to win the game?
Useful Items & Tools:
Visit the in-game store to find helpful items for your quest. Use a speed potion to run like lightning or call a cute puppy to help you locate a missing toy. There's even an invisibility potion to help you move unseen!
Escape the Mystery:
Once you've found every hidden toy, locate the secret button to open the exit and complete your adventure. Use the mansion's map to navigate this huge block-world estate.
Whether you love craft games or hide-and-seek, the Pink Princess House offers a fantastic world full of pink blocks and fun challenges for everyone!

bluejetty:00034695:android.description:
Wood Hexa is an addictive hexa sorting puzzle that combines sorting, stacking, and color matching into one brain-teasing challenge. If you love color wood games and hexa sorting puzzle, this game will test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
Engaging Hexa Sorting Gameplay
Your goal is simple but captivating: sort, merge, and stack hexagons into a perfect color-matching wood puzzle. Each level challenges you with a new hexa sorting puzzle, requiring careful moves and strategic planning to clear the board in as few steps as possible.
How to Play Wood Hexa 
Sort & Stack: Move wood hexa blocks into their matching color groups.
Merge Tiles: Combine similar hexagon blocks to clear the puzzle.
Solve Strategically: Plan your moves carefully for the best results.
Complete Levels: Clear all tiles with efficient hexa sorting to advance!
Key Features
🔥 Hexa Sorting Puzzle – A unique twist on classic sorting games.
🎨 Color Matching Fun – Solve puzzles by sorting and merging wood hexa tiles into perfect color arrangements.
🧠 Brain-Teasing Levels – Increasing difficulty keeps the game exciting and challenging.
🔄 Stack & Merge Mechanics – Enjoy the satisfying process of stacking and merging colorful hexa tiles.
🌲 Wood Puzzle Aesthetic – Relaxing, visually appealing wood hexa design for a soothing gameplay experience.
⏳ Endless Challenges – Hundreds of wood hexa sorting puzzles to keep you entertained for hours.
Why You’ll Love Wood Hexa
✅ Perfect for Puzzle Lovers – If you enjoy hexa block puzzles, tile sorting games, or brain-training challenges, this game is for you.
✅ Relaxing Yet Addictive – Combining wood hexa aesthetics and color-matching gameplay creates a soothing, satisfying experience.
✅ Easy to Play, Hard to Master – Simple mechanics make it accessible, but strategic depth ensures long-term engagement.
✅ Satisfying Progression – Each cleared level feels rewarding as you master wood hexa stacking and color sorting.
Can you conquer the ultimate wood hexa puzzle challenge? Download Wood Hexa now and start sorting!

bluejetty:00134458:ios.description:
Always know what is going on at any time, anywhere with Tracki. One of the Smallest GPS tracking devices that gives unique flexibility the Tracki 3G GPS tracker is a Worldwide device that allows you to track in any country. with the built-in SIM card, track your precious things in real-time, alerting and sending notifications through text and email. Tracki's location is accessible on any computer or mobile device, with GPS/GSM/Wi-Fi tracking, accurately locate anything within 10-60 feet (3-20 meters).
FEATURES:
* You can log in to the Tracki app with a user name (your email address) and a password, and you can also sign up and create a new account.
* The app tracks the current location of any Tracki device that was assigned to your account and displays it on a map.
* Switch between Map View and Satellite View.
* Show the location-history of the device in a date-range you choose.
* Set various alarms that the device can trigger when it moves around, and see the list of alarm notifications sent by the device. The available alarms include: speed limit alarm, movement alarm, left and right key pressed, SOS alarm and more.
* Set Geo-fences: draw areas on the map that will function as virtual fences that trigger an alarm when the device crosses them.
We hope you enjoy the GPS tracking app and share it with your friends and family!
Please contact us with questions and suggestions.
The Tracki team

In the game, races take place at locations that fully reproduce the atmosphere of provincial cities and villages. The developers have created a full-fledged virtual environment with well-detailed scenery. The participant will drive along different roads, work out control skills and enjoy realistic gameplay.
In the Traffic Racer Open World game, initially the participant will have at his disposal only the VAZ-2107, on which he will pass the first tests. Over time, the user will accumulate enough money and be able to buy another car. The developers have added more than 40 Russian and imported models with unique characteristics to the project. Among them there are various modifications of VAZ, UAZ, Ford, Mercedes, Chevrolet and other options. Each car can be repainted and improved in design.
The races have different modes with unique passing mechanics. The gamer can freely ride on the roads and admire the surroundings or take part in dynamic time trials. There is a function to switch the time of day and change the weather, which allows you to practice driving in more difficult conditions. The camera displays the surrounding space from several angles. The player will see urban five-story buildings, village houses, stops and other objects.
Features of the game Traffic Racer Open World
More than 120 models of cars.
Possibility of customization.
Detailed locations.
Switching the camera view.
Various control methods.
Enjoy at realistic Russian environment with Russian and Foreign Cars.
Privacy Policy: https://tojgames.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://tojgames.com/terms/

Bible Trivia is fun for the whole family! Easy to use, with questions for all ages and knowledge levels. This app helps review key stories in the Old and New Testaments, while adding some challenge and excitement. Supports up to 4 players. New packs added regularly!
Our goal is simple: Deliver an app that’s rooted in scripture, faithfully accurate, and focused on meaningful content over flashy distractions.
Each question is carefully created and reviewed, going through each chapter of the Bible to develop questions that are strictly Bible based, and accurate.
Key Features
• Multiple choice & fill in the blank
• Easy to use and setup
• Over 4000 trivia questions!
• Includes trivia questions by Book & Topic
• New packs added throughout the year
• Daily trivia challenge (NEW)
• 4 difficulty levels
• Bible questions based on the New International Version
Auto Renewable Subscriptions:
Yearly Pass subscriptions allow for ad free play, and access to all trivia packs during the subscription period. You will be charged through your App Store account. Subscriptions help support the app team, and allow us to continue to provide new content, updates, fixes, and additional features.

bluejetty:00137936:ios.description:
noflair - Your home bar in your pocket
The best app for managing your home bar and deciding which cocktail to drink tonight!
Discover the key features of our cocktail and home bar app:
Home Bar Inventory
- Easily add your bottle collection by scanning the barcode of each individual item.
- Top up your inventory with generic and homemade ingredients like syrups, juices, and more.
- Search and filter across your cocktail books selected from an ever-growing library.
- Create your own drink recipes and homemade ingredient recipes.
Cocktail Recipes
- Browse an extensive collection of cocktail recipes, inclusive of offerings from books and creative mixes from other users.
- Instantly identify which cocktails you can prepare with the ingredients you currently possess.
- Enjoy smart cocktail recipe suggestions, specifically tailored to utilize ingredients nearing their expiration.
Search & Filter
- Discover the perfect cocktail for any occasion using our advanced search and filter features. Search by name, ingredients, flavours, and sources to uncover new favourites or locate specific recipes.
- Identify drinks you can craft using a particular product.
- Determine your next bottle purchase with filtering options such as ingredient type, brand, flavour, or region of production.
Community Interaction
- Join in engaging discussions with other users about drinks, spirits, bars, and the app itself.
- Share your creative recipes with fellow cocktail enthusiasts directly within the app.
- Every user is empowered to contribute, correct, and enhance product data.

bluejetty:00150031:ios.description:
The Texas Pride app will allow the users to view and monitor the precise location of the GPS trackers installed on vehicles and/or assets, whether it’s a single vehicle or an entire fleet of vehicles, from anywhere conveniently from their iPhone or iPad mobile device. 
With the App, users will be able to monitor the speed and battery life of each device by tapping on the icon located on the map. The location also updates automatically, showing the real-time GPS location of the user’s vehicles and/or mobile devices. Users will also have the option of generating the Historical Playback of their tracking data to see precisely where their devices travelled. 
Vehicle updates will be based on user’s data plan - 3 minute, 1 minute, 30 seconds, 10 seconds, 5 seconds, or as fast as 3 second updates.

• It all happens in the app – reserve a car and start your trip directly from your phone
• Charging, insurance, and parking within the zones in Greater Copenhagen and Aarhus are included
• Pick up and drop off where you are – no fixed locations
• Vehicle types for every need – city cars, vans, premium cars, and minibuses

• 24/7 customer service – support 365 days a year

WHEN SHOULD I CHOOSE GREENMOBILITY?
• For work, study, and quick errands
• For shopping, DIY stores, and activities
• For day trips, weekend getaways, and holidays
• For trips to and from the airport
• When your own car is at the workshop – or as an alternative to a second car
HOW TO RENT A CAR
1. Download the GreenMobility app
2. Sign up for free with your driver’s license
3. Find a car near you in the app and rent it
4. Drive – and drop off the car within the zone when you're done

bluejetty:00014079:ios.description:
Fastwork streamlines your freelance hiring experience. With over 280,000+ verified professionals, trusted by over 1.9M clients, in 600+ diverse categories, we guarantee you'll find the perfect fit for your project. Fastwork also creates opportunities for those looking for side gigs, extra income, online jobs, or freelance work in various fields. Anyone can easily sign up and create a profile to start receiving jobs in just a few steps.
Why Fastwork?
- Extensive Expertise: From Graphic & Design to Marketing & Advertising, Writing & Translation, Audio & Video, Web & Programming, Consulting & Advice, or even E-commerce Management, discover freelancers for anything you need.
- Lifestyle Services: Covering everyday needs with at-home and personal services, from home massage, eyelash extensions, nail care, housekeeping, fortune telling, all the way to companion services.
- Transparency & Trust: Each freelancer showcases their work history and past client reviews, empowering you to choose reliable talents with proven achievements.
- Streamlined Payments: Freelancers submit clear quotes and invoices directly within the app, ensuring financial clarity and budget control.
- Unwavering Security: Fastwork acts as a secure escrow platform, holding your funds until you're satisfied with the completed work, eliminating freelance no-shows. - Dedicated Support: Our friendly and responsive customer support team is always readily available to answer your questions and provide assistance.

- Easy Start: Anyone can create a profile and find online jobs quickly, turning skills into income in just a few steps.

- Find Your Talent: Search freelancers by keyword, browse categories, or post a job to identify the best match for your project.
- Explore Profiles: Review detailed profiles, work history, and client reviews to assess freelancer suitability.
- Direct Communication: Initiate conversations with your preferred freelancers directly through the app.
- Clear Quotes: Receive transparent quotes outlining project costs and timelines.
- Project Launch: Once you've chosen your freelancer and accepted their quote, the project commences.
- Secure Payment: Upon project completion and your satisfaction, release the payment conveniently through the app.
Features:
- Find a freelance by using search, browse from categories, or post a job.
- Interact with each other freely by using chat feature to send message, photos, files, voice records, or make a call.
- Receive push and inbox notifications to keep you updated.
- Make payment through our secure and easy to use payment gateway.

bluejetty:00159416:ios.name: Uptivo
bluejetty:00159416:ios.summary: The UPTIVO APP is the ultimate fitness companion, combining real-time biofeedback with next-generation AI coaching to help you train smarter, recover better, and achieve your goals faster. Whether you're just starting out or optimizing peak
bluejetty:00159416:ios.description:
The UPTIVO APP is the ultimate fitness companion, combining real-time biofeedback with next-generation AI coaching to help you train smarter, recover better, and achieve your goals faster. Whether you're just starting out or optimizing peak performance, Uptivo empowers your journey with the support of NATE, your personal AI coach.
Thanks to Uptivo’s unique Color Training system, the app displays your heart rate zones in clear, dynamic colors, allowing you to stay in the optimal intensity zone for every workout.
Compatible with a wide range of Bluetooth heart rate monitors, including POLAR, GARMIN, MYZONE, DECATHLON, WAHOO, and many others.
Key Features:
AI Coaching with NATE
NATE is Uptivo’s intelligent AI coach that transforms your training experience. It analyzes your heart rate, workout history, goals, and even physiological data such as sleep quality, heart rate variability (HRV), stress levels, and recovery status. Based on this data, NATE provides hyper-personalized feedback to help you know when to push, when to rest, and how to make every session count.
Smart Workout Plans with Video Support
NATE doesn’t just guide you — it builds complete, adaptive workout plans tailored to your fitness level and objectives. Each plan includes detailed video demonstrations, along with reps, sets, and weights, so you can train effectively and safely anywhere.
Real-Time Feedback & Motivation
After each session, NATE delivers instant insights into your performance and recovery, with clear and actionable suggestions to avoid overtraining, improve consistency, and stay motivated.
Live Workout Monitoring
Track your sessions with precision. Monitor heart rate, calories burned, intensity zones, and more. Book and manage classes directly from the app, and stay connected with your trainer and club.
Leaderboards & UPP Challenges
Compete with friends and fellow members. Earn Uptivo Performance Points (UPPs), climb the rankings, and unlock exclusive digital badges to showcase your progress.
Detailed Progress Tracking
Automatically sync all your workouts with your Uptivo account and access daily, weekly, and long-term performance reports to stay aligned with your goals.
Wearable Integrations
Supports Apple Watch (watchOS 8.7 or later), Garmin wearables with health tracking functionality, and syncs with Apple Health for seamless heart rate and health data tracking.
Notes: 
Some features require connection to an UPTIVO Club.
Certain health-related features (such as sleep, HRV, and stress analysis) require a compatible Garmin wearable with health tracking capabilities.
Continued use of GPS in the background may significantly reduce battery life.
Link to the Terms of Use (EULA)
https://uptivo.fit/privacy-and-terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00124207:ios.description:
The popular football RPG from SEGA, Pocket Club Manager, now available in English for the first time on mobile devices! Based on the popular “Let’s Make a Professional Soccer Club” series, Pocket Club Manager has been designed from the ground up to be as close to the original series as possible, complete with the same cycle of club management, player training, finance management and football simulation.
 Join other players around the world and compete to create the greatest football club of all time!
Start off small and make it big! Become the Manager of a local football club, recruit real-life football stars, compete against the strongest teams, and take your shot at becoming the best in the world!
Gameplay is fast-paced and easy to pick up and play. Players will improve as your club gets bigger. Upgrade your clubhouse and stadium while conquering one league after another!
■■■　Game Features　■■■
[Brings the “Let’s Make a Professional Soccer Club” game engine to mobile for the first time ever!]
- Original game engine revamped for an even better football experience!
- A high quality, in-depth automated football simulation. Player combinations and team tactics are the key to victory.
- Team strengths and weaknesses are easy to grasp and fun to master. Anyone can enjoy creating a team and training their players!
[FIFPro & Japanese National Player Licenses Included!]
- Over 2,000 European League and Japanese National football players available!
- Original, series-exclusive players are also available! Create your own, unique Dream Team!
[Challenge International Mode!]
- International Mode includes player data from 2002 to the present!
- Compete in huge international games every 4 years to become the world's top Manager!
[The original gameplay returns!]
- The original console game’s gameplay cycle of "Negotiation, Management, Coaching and Playing", now fully realised on mobile platforms!
- Manage your club through the ranks to become the best of the best! Your club’s fate rests in your hands!
[Smartphone Specific Features!]
- Use the Footie Face system to create players using photos taken with your camera!
- Footie Face players can be either male or female. As you progress through the game, you'll even be able to create a team full of all your friends!
