bluejetty:00045566:ios.description:
As humans, we’re hardwired for connection. Belonging to a community makes us feel safe and helps us thrive. 
But so often, living with psoriatic arthritis (PsA) can make you feel physically and emotionally isolated. Not only can it be hard to do things you loved before your diagnosis, but it can also feel like no one understands what it’s like.
Until now.
Our mission is to cultivate a space powered by the PsA community and empowered by each other. From one-to-one chats to conversation forums, we make connecting easy. This is a safe place to find and receive advice, to seek and offer support, and to discover the authentic stories of members, just like you.
Bezzy PsA is a free online platform bringing new meaning to the word “community.” 
Our aim is to create an experience where:
- everyone feels seen, valued, and understood
- everyone’s story matters
- shared vulnerability is the name of the game
Bezzy PsA is a place where you are more than your PsA. It’s a place where, finally, you belong.
HOW IT WORKS
Social-first Content
Like all of your favorite social networks, we’ve designed an activity feed to connect you with other members living with psoriatic arthritis. We pride ourselves on making Bezzy PsA a safe and secure space where you can join live discussions, connect one-to-one, and read the latest articles and personal stories.
Live Chats 
Need to vent? Get advice? Share what’s on your mind? Hop into a daily live chat to join the conversation. They’re often led by our amazing Community Guide, but you can also expect to chat with other advocates and experts, too.
Forums
From treatments to symptoms to daily living, PsA changes everything. Whatever you're feeling on any given day, there's a forum where you can connect and share directly with others.
1:1 Messaging
Let us connect you with a new member from our community every day. We’ll recommend members to you based on your treatment plan, lifestyle interests, and needs. Browse member profiles and request to connect with anyone from our community with members listed as “Online Now.”
Discover Articles and Stories
We believe that shared experiences empower the kind of belonging that can help people not only survive—but thrive—with PsA. Our stories offer perspectives and tips from people who know what it’s like.
Get handpicked wellness and member stories delivered to you each week.
Connect Safely Anytime, Anywhere 
We take thoughtful steps to build safety, security, and privacy into our platform and foster an environment where members feel safe sharing their personal experiences. Check and send messages, see who’s online, and get notified when a new message comes in—so you’ll never miss a thing. 
ABOUT HEALTHLINE
Healthline Media is the top ranked health publisher and number 44 on Comscore’s Top 100 Property rankings. Across all of its properties, Healthline Media each month publishes up to 1,000 scientifically accurate yet reader-friendly articles authored by more than 120 writers and reviewed by more than 100 doctors, clinicians, nutritionists, and other experts. The company’s repository contains more than 70,000 articles, each updated with current protocol.
More than 200 million people worldwide and 86 million people in the U.S. visit Healthline’s sites each month, according to Google Analytics and Comscore, respectively.
Healthline Media is an RVO Health Company

“Dyin’ ain’t much of a livin’, boy.”

 Relax with cinematic Wild West color by number artwork inspired by dusty trails, prairie sunsets, frontier towns, wild horses, and rugged western adventure.
Wild West Color is a relaxing coloring game designed for adults and casual game players who love western movies, cowboy culture, rustic Americana, and immersive art experiences. Escape everyday stress and enjoy a peaceful western journey through color, paint, and art.
 Explore the Wild Frontier
Discover a large collection of Wild West coloring pages featuring:
- Wild horses and ranch life 
- Desert canyons and cactus landscapes 
- Frontier towns and wooden saloons 
- Prairie sunsets and western wilderness scenery 
- Campfires, railroads, wagons, and rustic cabins 
- Vintage western fashion and cowboy aesthetics 
- Adventure-inspired frontier artwork 
Every illustration captures the freedom, solitude, and rugged beauty of the American frontier.
 Relaxing Color by Number Gameplay
Wild West Color features:
- Easy tap-to-color controls 
- Smooth and satisfying coloring interaction 
- Relaxing paint by number gameplay 
- High-quality western-themed art 
- Helpful tools and reward props 
- Subscription option to remove ads 
- Save and share your finished artwork 
- Immersive western atmosphere and cinematic visuals 
- Suitable for all skill levels 
- Frequent updates with new coloring content 
Whether you want to relax after work, reduce stress, or enjoy quiet creative moments, Wild West Color offers a calming frontier escape anytime, anywhere.
 A Western Journey Through Art
From dusty desert roads to glowing prairie sunsets, every coloring page tells a western story waiting to be brought to life.
Slow down, explore the frontier, and discover the timeless spirit of the Wild West through immersive coloring experiences.
 Color the Untamed Frontier.

bluejetty:00137036:ios.description:
FOUR times fewer typos and 100% privacy with the first keyboard made for your iPhone.
Featured on: TechCrunch, Wired, Houston Chronicle, Esquire, Evening Standard, Tech Radar, Mac Observer, App Advice
DID YOU KNOW?
Current keyboards are based on the 140-year-old mechanical typewriter layout. Typewise is different. It’s the first keyboard that is specifically designed for smartphones. It’s revolutionary yet easy to use, and after a couple of messages you’ll love it.
4X FEWER TYPOS
A recent study with 37,000 participants showed that on current keyboards 1 out of 5 words contains typos. With Typewise you finally get rid of these ARRGGHH-moments. Thanks to the hexagon layout, keys are 70% larger and much easier to hit. It helps you to make four times fewer typos.
AI POWERED KEYBOARD
All your editing needs are now met in one keyboard. It features the ability to translate, proofread, adjust tonality, shorten, extend and create inclusive language with just one click.
INTUITIVE GESTURES
Swipe up to capitalize a letter, swipe left to delete or swipe right to restore. It's as simple as that.
SMART AUTOCORRECT
Stop getting annoyed by wrong autocorrections or senseless predictions. Typewise learns what you type and helps you write that perfect sentence.
100% PRIVACY
What you write is personal. That's why the keyboard does NOT require “full access” and none of your typing data is transmitted to the cloud.
To improve tutorial, game and settings in the app, we rely on basic and anonymous usage tracking, which can be turned off completely using the offline mode feature. The keyboard itself is not tracked at all.
https://typewise.app/privacy-policy-app/
SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGES
Having to switch between different languages is cumbersome. With Typewise you can write in all your languages at once. Choose from 40+ languages and type in the accents you really need. Typewise supports:
- English (United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada)
- Afrikaans
- Albanian
- Basque
- Breton
- Catalan
- Croatian
- Czech
- Danish
- Dutch (Belgium, Netherlands)
- Estonian
- Filipino
- Finnish
- French (France, Canada, Switzerland)
- Galician
- German (Austria, Germany, Switzerland)
- Hinglish
- Hungarian
- Icelandic
- Indonesian
- Irish
- Italian
- Latvian
- Lithuanian
- Malaysian
- Norwegian
- Polish
- Portuguese (Portugal, Brazil)
- Romanian
- Serbian
- Slovak
- Slovene
- Spanish
- Swedish
- Swiss German
- Turkish
GET MORE WITH TYPEWISE PRO
- Type in multiple languages without switching
- Get personalized word suggestions
- Additional 16 awesome themes
- Create your own text replacements
- Turn on key vibration
- Turn on tablet mode
- Change swiping behavior
- Change space button sensitivity
- Automatically go back to letters after a space
- Flick down to undo auto corrections
Typewise PRO is a service that costs $1.99 per month or $9.49 per year (prices vary by region). Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and auto-renews at the same price unless disabled in iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your subscription can be managed in your iTunes Account Settings. Review our terms of use: https://typewise.app/terms-of-use-ios/
SUPPORTED DEVICES
Typewise is optimized for iPhones with iOS 13 or later.

Featured on: TechCrunch, Wired, Houston Chronicle, Esquire, Evening Standard, Tech Radar, Mac Observer, App Advice

DID YOU KNOW?
Current keyboards are based on the 140-year-old mechanical typewriter layout. Typewise is different. It’s the first keyboard that is specifically designed for smartphones. It’s revolutionary yet easy to use, and after a couple of messages you’ll love it.

4X FEWER TYPOS
A recent study with 37,000 participants showed that on current keyboards 1 out of 5 words contains typos. With Typewise you finally get rid of these ARRGGHH-moments. Thanks to the hexagon layout, keys are 70% larger and much easier to hit. It helps you to make four times fewer typos.

AI POWERED KEYBOARD
All your editing needs are now met in one keyboard. It features the ability to translate, proofread, adjust tonality, shorten, extend and create inclusive language with just one click.

INTUITIVE GESTURES
Swipe up to capitalize a letter, swipe left to delete or swipe right to restore. It's as simple as that.

SMART AUTOCORRECT
Stop getting annoyed by wrong autocorrections or senseless predictions. Typewise learns what you type and helps you write that perfect sentence.

100% PRIVACY
What you write is personal. That's why the keyboard does NOT require “full access” and none of your typing data is transmitted to the cloud.
To improve tutorial, game and settings in the app, we rely on basic and anonymous usage tracking, which can be turned off completely using the offline mode feature. The keyboard itself is not tracked at all.
https://typewise.app/privacy-policy-app/

SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGES
Having to switch between different languages is cumbersome. With Typewise you can write in all your languages at once. Choose from 40+ languages and type in the accents you really need. Typewise supports:
- English (United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada)
- Afrikaans
- Albanian
- Basque
- Breton
- Catalan
- Croatian
- Czech
- Danish
- Dutch (Belgium, Netherlands)
- Estonian
- Filipino
- Finnish
- French (France, Canada, Switzerland)
- Galician
- German (Austria, Germany, Switzerland)
- Hinglish
- Hungarian
- Icelandic
- Indonesian
- Irish
- Italian
- Latvian
- Lithuanian
- Malaysian
- Norwegian
- Polish
- Portuguese (Portugal, Brazil)
- Romanian
- Serbian
- Slovak
- Slovene
- Spanish
- Swedish
- Swiss German
- Turkish

GET MORE WITH TYPEWISE PRO
- Type in multiple languages without switching
- Get personalized word suggestions
- Additional 16 awesome themes
- Create your own text replacements
- Turn on key vibration
- Turn on tablet mode
- Change swiping behavior
- Change space button sensitivity
- Automatically go back to letters after a space
- Flick down to undo auto corrections

Typewise PRO is a service that costs $1.99 per month or $9.49 per year (prices vary by region). Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and auto-renews at the same price unless disabled in iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your subscription can be managed in your iTunes Account Settings. Review our terms of use: https://typewise.app/terms-of-use-ios/

SUPPORTED DEVICES
Typewise is optimized for iPhones with iOS 13 or later.

bluejetty:00121602:ios.description:
Aplicativo oficial do MacMagazine — um dos maiores sites sobre o universo Apple em língua portuguesa — agora com uma experiência moderna e unificada para iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch e Mac.
Nosso app foi totalmente escrito em SwiftUI, com interface otimizada, navegação fluida e recursos pensados para acompanhar você em qualquer dispositivo. Tudo com foco em leitura confortável, desempenho e personalização.
PRINCIPAIS RECURSOS
• Navegação rápida e intuitiva entre notícias e artigos
• Lista de posts com imagens e leitura otimizada
• Filtros inteligentes para explorar conteúdos (últimas, destaques, temas específicos e mais)
• Busca integrada em todo o conteúdo do site
• Personalização da ordem das abas do app
• Suporte a widgets em três tamanhos
• Interface adaptada ao tamanho de fonte do sistema
• Modo Escuro completo
• Compartilhamento de posts via redes sociais e email
• Notificações push (todos os posts ou apenas destaques)
• Comentários integrados via Disqus
MÍDIAS
• Área dedicada com vídeos do YouTube
• Podcast com player completo (tela cheia, velocidade e capítulos)
• Aba com conteúdos do Instagram
OUTROS RECURSOS
• Leitura rápida de posts pelo Apple Watch
• Login para patrões com navegação sem banners
• Opção de remover anúncios via assinatura mensal ou anual
• Interface preparada para o design Liquid Glass
…e muito mais por vir!
CÓDIGO ABERTO
O app é open source e desenvolvido em conjunto com a comunidade. Se quiser contribuir, procure o projeto no GitHub.
—
MACMAGAZINE.COM.BR
O melhor pedaço da Maçã.
App desenvolvido por Cassio Rossi.

bluejetty:00045192:ios.description:
A patient art class for people who think they can't draw.
Watch a step. Draw it yourself. Make drawings you're proud of.
Start free. You don't need an account or any experience to begin.
TAUGHT ONE STEP AT A TIME
Each lesson is recorded by a real artist. The teacher's step sits beside your canvas: watch it, then draw it yourself, at your own pace.
Never drawn, or coming back after years away? You start with a beginner course. On iPhone, the first course is made for drawing on a phone.
Your first cartoon carries straight into color: you color that same drawing, then share it or keep it private.
LEARN FROM OTHER ARTISTS
Draw along with lessons recorded by artists in the Inkwell community, free for everyone. When you're ready, turn one of your own drawings into a lesson for someone else.
NO PRESSURE
Some days you'll learn something new. Some days you'll trace, color a page or play a drawing game. Some days it's a few minutes on a drawing you started last week. Start wherever you are.
REAL PEOPLE
Inkwell is made by a small team. When you write in, the person who built Inkwell answers. Share your drawings with other people learning in Inkwell when you want to.
WHAT PEOPLE SAY
"I have never had a better teacher than this app has been for me." No skills untill…, App Store review
"Makes me feel like I'm legit in an art class." David Venter, App Store review
"The teachers make me feel like I can actually draw and paint." CrossedAnimal, App Store review
TOOLS
Sketch, paint and color with brushes, layers and palettes. Draw with your finger, or with Apple Pencil on a compatible iPad.
FREE, AND INKWELL DEEP
Free for everyone: the daily session, every coloring page, the drawing games and every community lesson.
Inkwell Deep: the full course library, and keep going the same day instead of tomorrow. Choose monthly or yearly. The yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers; the monthly plan has no free trial.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Terms: https://www.inkwell.studio/terms
Privacy: https://www.inkwell.studio/privacy
You only have to make something.

bluejetty:00166290:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Construction , it’s time to work with automated trollies using bricks to construct monuments . By the help of trollies you will drop off bricks at your construction site.
 Step into the shoes of a virtual builder as you embark on a calming journey of creation and relaxation.
Immerse yourself in a tranquil environment, surrounded by picturesque landscapes and gentle ambient sounds. From the soft rustle of leaves to the distant chirping of birds, every detail is designed to evoke a sense of peace and serenity.
In Conatruction ASMR, construction is not just about erecting structures—it's about embracing mindfulness and finding beauty in the process. As you lay bricks, each action is accompanied by a symphony of soothing ASMR triggers, from the rhythmic tapping of tools to the gentle crinkle of building materials.
The game offers a variety of construction projects, ranging from simple garden sheds to elaborate treehouses, each with its own set of ASMR experiences to discover. Lose yourself in the rhythmic repetition of tasks, allowing the calming sensations to wash over you like gentle waves.
With its harmonious blend of construction gameplay and ASMR relaxation, Construction ASMR offers a unique and immersive experience for players seeking a moment of calm in a busy world. Are you ready to build your inner peace, one gentle tap at a time?
----------------------------------------------------------
Subscription Terms: VIP Construction
Here is the subscription period available in our game:
Weekly subscription for $4.99 starting from first day.
The offer unlocks the following features
- Remove all ads
- Unlimited free Spin Wheel
- x2 Permanent revenue
- x5 Level reward
- All boosters (speed, golden brick, additional bogie, super worker) 
Subscription and Renewal:
The payment is charged to your account upon confirmation of purchase. The subscription is renewed automatically unless you turn it off 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. The subscription automatically renews for the same duration as the original subscription (weekly).
Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period, and the renewal cost will be identified. Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
Canceling a Subscription:
To cancel a subscription, you must do so through your account in the Store. This must be done at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period to avoid being charged for the next period.
For more information, please visit https://support.apple.com/HT207865
If you have any question, feel free to contact us at support@sablostudio.com
Privacy policy and Terms of use: https://sablostudio.com/privacy-policy.html
Link to Subscription terms : https://sablostudio.com/subscription_terms/construction_asmr/terms_English.html

bluejetty:00187009:ios.description:
"Best of App Store for managing your calendar, to-do list, notes, and personal accounts." – Apple.
"Best App for Getting Organized" – CNN, USA Today, Forbes, Cosmopolitan, Mashable, and more.
24me – Your All-in-One Smart Personal Assistant
The award-winning app that helps millions worldwide stay organized and productive. With 24me, your entire life is seamlessly managed in one place: your CALENDAR, TO-DO LIST, NOTES, and Personal Accounts. No more switching between apps - 24me simplifies your day and saves you time for what matters most.
Whether you need a daily planner, task manager, GTD productivity tool, or reminder app, 24me is the ultimate solution to organize your schedule, manage tasks, and stay on top of everything.
What You Can Do with 24me:
■ ALL IN ONE CALENDAR AND PLANNER
Easily manage your schedule with a fully synced calendar that integrates with Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Exchange, Yahoo! Calendar, Apple iCal, and more. See all your events and meetings in one place—never miss a deadline or an important moment.
■ SMART TASK MANAGER & TO-DO LIST 
• Add tasks with a single tap or voice command.
• Use smart reminders to stay on track and avoid procrastination.
• Turn emails into tasks.
• Organize tasks with drag-and-drop simplicity.
■ NOTES AND LISTS MADE SIMPLE
• Take quick notes and create shopping lists.
• Attach photos or voice recordings.
• Keep everything connected to your tasks and calendar.
■ ASSISTANT ON THE GO
• Use your voice to add tasks, notes and meetings.
• Get 24me on your Apple Watch. 
• Join conference calls without having to remember the dial-in number.
• Turn your emails into tasks instantly.
■ CUSTOMIZE IT THE WAY YOU WANT
• Customize label colors, font size, and weight.
• Add your own photos to the calendar.
• Choose your favorite reminder sounds and more.
■ SMART ALERTS TO KEEP YOU ON TRACK 
• Time-to-Leave Notifications: Alerts based on real-time traffic.
• Daily Agenda: Start your day with a personalized summary of your schedule and tasks.
• Weather Alerts: Real-time updates.
• Birthday Reminders: Send greetings or gifts in seconds.
■ SHARE TOGETHER
Collaborate effortlessly to boost productivity
• At home: Share grocery lists and chores with family members.
• At work: Streamline teamwork by sharing tasks and action items with colleagues.
• Stay connected: Share events, reminders, and notes in real time with full sync between all participants.
Why Millions Love 24me
24me combines the best features of a calendar, task manager, daily planner, reminder app, note-taking tool, task list, and checklist—making it the ultimate GTD (Getting Things Done) solution. With built-in collaboration tools, it helps users stay organized, manage schedules, and coordinate tasks effortlessly. Whether for personal organization, family planning, or team productivity, 24me ensures you stay focused and on top of your goals.
Upgrade to 24me Premium to unlock its full potential with powerful features:
• Email to tasks
• Location based reminders
• Custom label colors and font customization
• Duplicate calendar events
• Calendar Photo Gallery
• Nag alerts for persistent reminders
• Timezone support 
• Custom Notification Sounds
• Print Your Schedule
• Priority support
24me Premium offers two subscription options:
$7.99/month
$47.99/year
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions in the Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of Use: http://www.twentyfour.me/terms
Privacy Policy: http://www.twentyfour.me/terms_privacy
Learn more about 24me at www.twentyfour.me

bluejetty:00160792:ios.description:
Welcome to Pixel Starships 2, the ultimate starship management and space strategy game! Dive into a vast universe where you can build, customize, and command your very own starship. With a blend of role-playing, real-time strategy, and spaceship management, Pixel Starships 2 offers an unparalleled gaming experience that will captivate both casual and hardcore gamers.
Key Features:
1. Build Your Starship:
Design and construct your starship from the ground up. Choose from a wide range of modules and components to create the perfect vessel. Whether you prefer a heavily armed battleship, a nimble explorer, or a versatile all-rounder, the choice is yours!
2. Train Your Crew:
Assemble a crew of skilled professionals to operate your starship. Train your crew members to enhance their abilities and improve your ship’s performance. Each crew member has unique skills and traits that can turn the tide of battle in your favor.
3. Epic Space Battles:
Engage in thrilling real-time battles against other players and AI opponents. Use strategy and tactics to outmaneuver your enemies, targeting specific ship systems to cripple their defenses. Victory in battle rewards you with valuable resources and prestigious rankings.
4. Explore the Galaxy:
Venture into the unknown as you explore a vast, procedurally generated galaxy. Discover new planets, encounter alien species, and uncover hidden treasures. Each expedition offers new challenges and opportunities for adventure.
5. Join Alliances:
Team up with other players to form alliances. Collaborate on missions, share resources, and support each other in battles. Alliance wars bring an additional layer of strategy and cooperation to the game, fostering a strong community spirit.
6. Regular Updates:
Pixel Starships 2 is constantly evolving, with regular updates introducing new content, features, and improvements. Stay tuned for exciting new events, challenges, and storylines that will keep you engaged for hours on end.
7. Stunning Pixel Art:
Immerse yourself in the beautifully crafted pixel art style of Pixel Starships 2. The game features intricate designs and animations that bring the universe to life, making every moment visually stunning.
Join millions of players worldwide and embark on an epic journey through the stars. Build your starship, train your crew, and conquer the galaxy in Pixel Starships 2. The universe is waiting for you—download now and start your adventure!
Download Pixel Starships 2 Today!

Freaky Stan is a new relaxing comics puzzle game. You won’t get bored by the multiple levels full of bright colors and an authentic thrilling story to follow. It’s always up to you how to end each storyline - be your own game creator!
Meet Stan, a goofy guy who is desperately in love with the beautiful Star. Will he be able to impress her? Will she answer his feelings? Will we see the love story unfolding before our eyes? bluejetty:00162246:ios.description:
Discover the Truth Behind Your Conversations with Narya
Ever wondered what your texts say about your relationships and friendships?
Narya is more than just a chat recap — it's your personal AI relationship analyst and coach. From emotional patterns to message dynamics, discover how you connect, love, and communicate — both one-on-one and in your groups.
Why Choose Narya?
- AI Relationship Coach: Talk to your AI coach about red flags, emotional imbalances, and communication problems. Get personalized guidance to build a healthier relationship — right from your real messages.
- Relationship Analyzer: Go beyond surface-level texting. Uncover emotional roles like affection, control, avoidance, or desire.
- Group Chat Wrapped: Analyze your friend groups to see who’s the Dominant one, the Gossiper, the Drama Queen, or the Sneaky Follower. Discover who starts conversations, who keeps them alive, and how everyone contributes to the group’s energy.
- Emotional Balance: See who says “I miss you” or “I love you” more, and who often takes the emotional lead.
- Truth & Manipulation: Spot signs of honesty, passive aggression, or manipulation within your chats.
- Chat Rhythm: Track who replies faster, who avoids certain topics, and how conversation effort is shared.
- Connection Index: Discover how aligned your messaging patterns are with your partner or close friend.
- Emoji & Word Trends: Decode the emotional language you and your friends use most.
What’s Inside Narya?
- AI-Driven Relationship Insights: Smart emotional breakdowns of your one-on-one and group conversations.
- AI Relationship Coach: Have real conversations with your coach based on your chat history. Discuss red flags and get expert-like advice tailored to your situation.
- Couple Dynamics Dashboard: Visualize the balance of power, love, and effort in your relationship.
- Group Chat Wrapped Dashboard: Reveal personalities and interaction roles within your friend groups.
- Emotional Analysis: Measure laughter, attraction, curiosity, and emotional investment.
- Reply Behaviors: Understand silence, speed, and conversation control.
- Shareable Reports: Turn your chat data into fun, viral Narya Wrapped stories.
Easy to Use
1) Download Narya
2) Export your chat history from your messaging app
3) Let AI uncover what your messages really mean — and guide your relationship growth
Privacy First
Your data is yours. All analysis happens primarily on your device, and only anonymized information may be used to improve your experience. We never access or store your personal identity.
For Every Relationship & Friendship
Whether it’s your partner, crush, best friend, or friend group — Narya helps you reflect, grow, and connect better by showing you what your conversations say about your bond.
Download now and reveal the emotional truth behind your chats.
Terms of Service: https://whatwrapped.com/termsandconditions
Privacy Policy: https://whatwrapped.com/privacypolicy
Reach us at: support@whatwrapped.com
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with any messaging platform.

STEP & SAVE 
Connect your smartwatch, wearable device or mobile phone and start tracking your steps, every step taken is added to your 'STEPS WALLET' which you can then spend on offers like 2-4-1's, 50% off, free gym passes and much more!

Download the app that is always with you to make every drive easier. 
With the myGMC app, you can:
• Remotely start, lock, and unlock your vehicle.
• Check fuel level, tire pressure, oil life, and more.
• Set your preferred cabin temperature.
• View charging status and locate charging stations.
• Plan trips and navigate with maps. 
• Request help with Roadside Assistance.
• Schedule service, find your dealership, and more.

bluejetty:00035526:ios.description:
Remote & TV Manager turns your iPhone into more than a TV remote. It gives you a smarter way to control, personalize, manage, and quickly restore your TV experience.
Instead of using the same controls for everything you watch, the app can adapt its controls and TV settings to different types of content — from sports and movies to news, music, kids, and more.
A SMARTER WAY TO MANAGE YOUR TV
• Adaptive Remote
Get controls designed around what you are watching. The available quick actions can adapt to different viewing categories such as Sports, Movies, News, Music, Kids, Entertainment, Lifestyle, and Documentary content.
• Adaptive TV Settings
Adjust relevant picture and sound settings without digging through your TV menus. Available controls are based on the capabilities supported by your TV.
• TV Scenes
Create complete TV setups for different moments. Use built-in scenes such as Movie Night, Morning, Night Time, Kids, Party, and more, or save the current state of your TV as your own custom scene.
Apply a saved scene later to quickly restore multiple TV settings together.
• Save Your Current TV Setup
Like the way your TV looks and sounds right now? Capture the current settings, give them a name, and save them for later.
• Settings History & Restore
Remote & TV Manager keeps a recent history of meaningful TV setting changes so you can return to an earlier setup whenever you want.
Review recent changes by time and restore a previous TV configuration without manually rebuilding every setting.
• Quick Remote from Spotlight, Widget & Live Activities
Access useful TV controls directly from Spotlight, Widget & Live Activities without navigating through the full app. The app intergrated deedly with iOS system, allowing you to interact with your TV at the most convenience.
• Quick Channel Access
Keep your frequently used TV apps and channels within easy reach for faster access.
• Full TV Remote
When you need a traditional remote, all the familiar controls are still available — including navigation, volume, mute, power, Home, Back, playback controls, and other supported TV commands.
ONE APP FOR DIFFERENT TV EXPERIENCES
Feature availability may vary depending on TV model, firmware, content source, and supported TV capabilities.
We offer different plans for premium: weekly ($3.99), Monthly ($7.99) & Lifetime ($19.99).

bluejetty:00041667:ios.name: Speed Test | HighSpeedInternet
bluejetty:00041667:ios.summary: HighSpeedInternet.com’s free internet Speed Test helps you see exactly how your internet connection is performing. With just a single tap on your mobile device, test your Wi-Fi (DSL, Fiber, Cable, Satellite) or cellular (5G, 4G, LTE) speeds
bluejetty:00041667:ios.description:
HighSpeedInternet.com’s free internet Speed Test helps you see exactly how your internet connection is performing. With just a single tap on your mobile device, test your Wi-Fi (DSL, Fiber, Cable, Satellite) or cellular (5G, 4G, LTE) speeds quickly and accurately.
Millions of users trust HighSpeedInternet.com to test their internet speed over the web and compare internet service providers. Now you can more easily test using mobile devices and track your speeds over time with our easy-to-use app.
We are not affiliated with internet service or cellular network providers and, therefore, provide an unbiased view of speed results and service options.
- How it Works -
When the speed test starts, it automatically selects the best server to execute the test based on your location. Your test will use a server close to you to keep the results as accurate as possible.
To test download speed, our testing tool downloads a file using your internet connection, and then measures how long the download takes to complete. It measures upload speed the same way, except in reverse.
The video test emulates video streaming by downloading video chunks to measure the quality of your network.
- Benefits -
• Free internet connection speed test app for mobile devices and tablets
• Test download, upload, ping, jitter and packet loss
• Measure Wi-Fi, 4G, 5G and LTE speeds in real-time
• Adaptive bitrate video streaming test to measure network quality for streaming video
• Store historical speed test results
• Tag your test results to identify where the test was taken, using preset options or customized options
• Easily compare speeds to track performance and consistency over time
• Troubleshoot your internet speed issues
• Verify the speeds you are paying for
• Download your speed test history
• Rate and review your internet service provider
• Read reviews and see how others have rated your internet service provider
• Share your speed test result by email
• Easy access to our helpful tool to find internet service providers in your area
• Access tips and FAQs to help you understand results, improve your internet speed and find solutions to internet connectivity problems
• Easily invite your friends to test their speed and compare
Please review our Privacy Policy: https://www.highspeedinternet.com/privacy-policy-terms-and-conditions.

A modern, enjoyable and no-guilt approach to quit smoking.
Quit smoking the easiest way. QuitSure offers 6-day and 6-week programs that removes your desire to smoke - so you quit without cravings, without withdrawal, and without willpower.
You don't have to quit today. You can keep smoking during the entire program and quit only when you're truly ready. No guilt. No pressure.
96% of quit attempts fail - not because you lack willpower, but because most methods fight the wrong battle. QuitSure doesn't ask you to resist cravings. It eliminates them. By the time you reach your quit day, you won't want to smoke anymore.
 - - - 
WHY QUITSURE WORKS
QuitSure is built on the science of why you smoke - and uses that science to undo the addiction at its root.
◆ Based on Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), REBT Therapy, and Classical Conditioning
◆ Grounded in principles of psychology, neuroscience, and habit formation
◆ Personalised to your specific smoking triggers
◆ Created by ex-smokers who truly understand what you're going through
No lifestyle overhaul. No self-control battles. No guilt trips. Just a clear, step-by-step path to becoming smoke-free.

bluejetty:00087304:ios.description:
The Tempdrop app is designed to complement the Tempdrop device - a personalized user-specific thermometer that captures minute temperature variations throughout the night to pinpoint the basal body temperature. Detected variations in temperature correlate with hormonal fluctuations throughout the menstrual cycle. When used with the Tempdrop device, this app can help users to pinpoint ovulation and effectively track and predict the varying phases of the cycle.
Disclaimer: The Tempdrop sensor and app are intended as complementary instruments to enhance your ability to monitor your fertility and share health details. The app and its wearable sensor, in themselves, are not, nor are they intended to be, a fertility monitor, a substitute for contraception, or a birth control method. We recognize the need of some to use the data and information provided to support ongoing health and menstrual cycle tracking, however, it is important to note that this should NOT be used as a substitute for an in-presence qualified professional, medical analysis, advice, guidance, or treatment. We strongly advise seeking a qualified Fertility Awareness instructor or other self-teaching resources to learn a symptothermal method and support your fertility journey.
The provided interpretations and prediction guidelines are not suitable for use with irregular cycles. Optimal performance is dependent on correct and consistent use. Individual usage, wearing, input, and circumstances can affect the data. The user is fully responsible for the individual data inputs. 
The Tempdrop Sensor is approved for use in the USA, and is registered in the FDA database under registration number 3016099071. The device is classified as "Device, Fertility Diagnostic, Proceptive”.
A link to the terms of use - https://www.tempdrop.com/pages/tos
A link to the privacy policy - https://www.tempdrop.com/pages/privacy-policy

Web2Pics is the best app for capturing and saving webpages. Easily record and save full-length screenshots or specific sections of websites. Share and annotate your webpage captures with ease. Manage and organize your captured images within our app’s photo gallery. Access your screenshots anytime and share them effortlessly.

bluejetty:00155979:ios.name: Circular Ring - Health Tracker
bluejetty:00155979:ios.summary: Circular is the world’s most complete health improvement platform, offering 13+ features to help you optimize your wellness. Paired with the Circular Ring, the Circular app provides deep insights into your sleep, recovery, stress, heart hea
bluejetty:00155979:ios.description:
Circular is the world’s most complete health improvement platform, offering 13+ features to help you optimize your wellness. Paired with the Circular Ring, the Circular app provides deep insights into your sleep, recovery, stress, heart health, energy levels, activity, and much more, making it easy to understand and improve your health over time. Through the Circular ring, track your biosignals, 24/7. With the Circular app, unleash the full potential of data.
FEATURES
Each feature is called a Circle, allowing you to personalize your health journey. Activate or customize Circles anytime in the "Manage My Circles" section.
-Sleep Monitoring – Get a detailed sleep quality score with contributors and trends to optimize your rest.
-Energy Score – Understand your daily readiness and recovery with biometric-based scoring.
-Heart Rhythm Monitoring – Track your heart rhythm with real-time insights and detect irregularities.
-Stress Tracking – See how your body responds to daily challenges and learn to manage stress effectively.
-Coherence Training – Use guided breathing exercises with real-time biometric tracking to enhance focus and relaxation.
-Women's Health Tracking – Monitor your cycle and hormonal changes for a better understanding of your body.
-Activity & Sport Sessions – Track workouts, daily movement, and exertion levels to optimize performance.
-Live Measurements – Take spot-check readings of your vitals, and activity data.
-Vital Alerts – Get notified when your biosignal levels exceed your set thresholds.
-Smart Alarm Clock – Wake up at the optimal moment in your sleep cycle.
-Medication Reminders – Setup your medication routine and stay on track with alerts for scheduled doses.
-Personal Diary & Calendar – Add notes and track trends in your health data.
-Challenges & Gamification – Earn Circular Coins, streaks, and badges while improving your health.
PERSONAL AI HEALTH COACH – KIRA
Kira is your AI-driven wellness assistant, helping you interpret your data and make better health decisions with:
Automatic day & night cross-data correlation
Personalized, science-backed recommendations
Event validation & insights based on your lifestyle
ADVANCED ANALYTICS & CALIBRATION
Machine learning-powered scoring – Circular cross-analyzes your health metrics to generate detailed, data-driven wellness scores.
14-Day Calibration – Kira learns your unique patterns by collecting baseline data, setting reference values, and adjusting recommendations to fit your profile.
ADDITIONAL TOOLS
Airplane Mode – Disable data transmission for privacy and extended battery life.
Timer – Set custom vibration alerts.
COMPATIBILITY & SUPPORT
Circular Ring required – The app works exclusively with a Circular Ring.
Bluetooth required – Background Bluetooth usage may reduce battery life.
Important: Circular is not a medical device and does not provide medical diagnoses. For any health concerns, consult a doctor.
Need help? Visit https://www.circular.xyz/help or email support@circular.xyz.
Need Ring? Visit https://www.circular.xyz/
Learn more: https://www.circular.xyz/learn.

bluejetty:00148787:ios.description:
No equipment needed. Home Pilates workouts for beginners!
Tailor a 28-day Pilates fitness program for you! You can easily learn it and enjoy the fun of Pilates while maintaining a healthy body posture! Shape your body, build up your strength and exercise your muscles. Always pay attention to your daily workouts
● Personalized Pilates Workout PlansSet small fitness goals for 28 days, let your body follow the rhythm and feel the changes in your body.
● Freely Practice for Easy Body ShapingYour daily workout only takes 10 to 15 minutes, so you don't need to feel bored or find it hard to persevere because of spending hours on exercise.
● Multiple Types to Choose FromPopular types such as wall Pilates, mat Pilates, lazy yoga are available for you to choose.
● From Novice to ProfessionalWhether you're a beginner or a professional, you can find suitable courses through our easy-to-use instructions. Remember that everyone is at a different level, so give priority to choosing the ones that suit your physical strength and rhythm for practice.
● Applicable to All Body PartsCourses designed by fitness and Pilates experts can help you achieve your goals. You can choose the whole body or specific parts like abdominal muscles, back or legs to make your practice more targeted.
A video learning platform specially created for Pilates enthusiasts, with a vast number of Pilates videos shared and all kinds of professional Pilates tutorials. It's a boon for self-taught Pilates and fitness lovers. With step-by-step teaching, it's especially suitable for beginners, making Pilates simpler and more interesting! You don't need to worry about not being able to learn it anymore!
PilatesFit - Energetic Pilates workouts and aerobic exercises to make your body posture and figure more relaxed and pleasant!

bluejetty:00130565:ios.name: Bibi Farm: Games for Kids 2-5
bluejetty:00130565:ios.developer: Bibi.Pet - Toddlers Games - Colors and Shapes
bluejetty:00130565:ios.summary:
Big news from Bibi.Pet! - Starting today, one subscription unlocks this app, Bibi World, and all the other apps in the Bibi.Pet Explorer series. Start playing and discover more!
It’s time for a trip and the Bibi.Pet are going to the farm!
bluejetty:00130565:ios.description:
Big news from Bibi.Pet! - Starting today, one subscription unlocks this app, Bibi World, and all the other apps in the Bibi.Pet Explorer series. Start playing and discover more!
It’s time for a trip and the Bibi.Pet are going to the farm!
Follow the Bibi.Pet in a completely new adventure and let your imagination run wild; create fun stories and situations together with the farm animals.
You will be able to groom and ride the horse, but be careful not to get yourself covered in mud with the pig. Play happy melodies together with the cow and help the hen with her eggs.
There’s always need for a helping hand on the farm to pick the fruit and vegetables; use them for lots of recipes or sell them at the market, taking them in your tractor!
Lots of other activities are waiting for you in this easy and fun game in which curiosity is stimulated through exploration and interaction with the various objects available.
And as always, Bibi.Pet will accompany you as you discover all the educational activities available.
Suitable for ages 2 to 5 and designed together with experts from the educational field.
The funny little animals that live there have particular shapes and speak their own special language: the Bibi’s language, which only children can understand.
Bibi.Pet are cute, friendly and scatterbrained, and can’t wait to play with all the family!
You can learn and have fun with them with colors, shapes, puzzles and logic games.
Features:
- Have fun with the farm animals
- Play at hide-and-seek among the sunflowers
- Play a song with the cow
- Look after the plants and flowers in the greenhouse
- Grow fruit and vegetables
- Drive the tractor
- Educational games for children over 2 years of age
- Lots of different games for learning while having fun
— CREATIVITY AND IMAGINATION —
In the Bibi.Pet Explorer apps children can play freely, create new stories and express their natural imagination. The open play mode allows children to interact freely with objects and characters, to create their own adventures with no limits or predetermined goals to achieve.
This way, children can experiment independently, developing creativity, logic and awareness. The open structure of Bibi.Pet Explorer encourages a type of play that reflects the child's particular interests and aptitudes, stimulating curiosity and promoting interaction between child and parent.
--- DESIGNED FOR LITTLE ONES --- 
- Absolutely no adverts 
- Designed to entertain children aged from 2 to 6, from little to big!
- Games with SIMPLE rules for children to play alone or with their parents. 
- Perfect for children at play school. 
- A host of entertaining sounds and interactive animation. 
- No need for reading skills, perfect also for pre-school or nursery children. 
- Characters created for boys and girls. 
--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---
Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.
• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy
• Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use
--- Bibi.Pet Who are we? --- 
We produce games for our children, and it is our passion. We produce tailor-made games, without invasive advertising by third parties. 
Some of our games have free trial versions, which means you can try them out first before purchases, supporting our team and enabling us to develop new games and keep all our apps up-to-date. 
We create a variety of games based on: colors and shapes, dressing up, dinosaur games for boys, games for girls, mini-games for smaller children and many other fun and educational games; you can try them all! 
Our thanks to all the families who show their trust in Bibi.Pet!

bluejetty:00148121:ios.summary:

The best 3d royal chess game is here! Play chess in immersive 3d
bluejetty:00148121:ios.description:
As you know, chess is one of the oldest strategy games in the world.
Chess is an excellent board logic game that develops such skills as tactics, strategy, and visual memory.
The best 3d royal chess game is here! Play chess in immersive 3d and epic graphics.
Challenge your friends to match or play against the ai players in the best chess game.
Royal chess is one of the most epic and enjoyable chess games with relaxing music.
### Tips to Become a Chess Champion
- Move the pawn in front of either the king or queen two squares forward. (Only on its opening move can a pawn move two squares.) This opens pathways for your bishops and queen to enter the game. They move on an angle and can’t get out onto the field of battle if pawns are in the way.
- Before you move your queen, rooks, or king, move your knights and bishops toward the center of the board. You want to get these pieces out from behind the pawns so they can attack.
- And front! When it’s your turn, always think to yourself, “What did my opponent’s last move do? What is he up to?” Is he laying traps to capture your pieces? Then decide on your own plan. Always look at all your possibilities. Look at moves that would capture your opponent’s men or threaten his king first. But always double-check your moves before you play them. Ask yourself, “Does my move leave something unprotected?”
- Don’t make too many moves with your pawns or try to pick off your opponent’s pawns.
- Castling is a move that allows you to move your king to safety and bring your rook into play. Once all the squares between your rook and the king are unoccupied you can move the king two squares toward the rook while the rook moves to the square on the king’s other side. If your opponent neglects to castle, you might be able to launch an attack on his king. This is the only move in which more than one piece may be moved in a turn.
- After you’ve brought all your knights and bishops into the game and castled (these moves are your “opening”), the middlegame begins. In the middle game, always be on the lookout for ways to capture your opponent’s men. Take any piece that your opponent doesn’t protect. But look at what will happen to your piece if you take him — will you get picked off? Always be looking for ways to move lots of your men into position to attack the enemy king.
- You’ll take some of your opponent’s pieces. Some of your pieces will be taken. You must figure out what is and isn’t a good swap. Use these points to figure out whether you’re making a good move if you’re going to lose one of them:
Queen: 9 points
Rook: 5 points
Bishop: 3 points
Knight: 3 points
Pawn: 1 point
So is it a good idea to lose a bishop to save a pawn? No!
- If you see a good move, sit on your hands and look for a better one. Patient thinking is the key to chess success.
### Important Chess Terms:
- pawn: moves to one field forward or two fields at the first move of this figure, beats diagonally to one field forward.
- knight: moves to the field two fields along the vertical and one horizontally or one field vertically and two horizontally.
- bishop: moves to any distance diagonally.
- rook: moves to any distance vertically or horizontally.
- queen: moves to any distance vertically, horizontally, or diagonally.
- king: moves to one field in the vertical, horizontal or diagonal.
- "check" the situation in chess when a king is under immediate attack by an opponent's pieces
- "checkmate" the situation in chess when the player whose turn it is to move is in check and has no legal move to escape check.
- "stalemate" -" the situation in chess when the player whose turn it is to move has no legal move and is not in check. (draw)
- "en passant" is a move in which a pawn can take an opponent's pawn if it jumps over a field under the pawn's blow.
The goal of the game is to checkmate the other king.

bluejetty:00015519:ios.summary: Ear training is highly essential for any musician - be it a composer, singer, songwriter or instrumentalist. It practices the ability to connect music theory elements (intervals, chords, scales) with real sounds you hear. The benefits of ma
bluejetty:00015519:ios.description:
Ear training is highly essential for any musician - be it a composer, singer, songwriter or instrumentalist. It practices the ability to connect music theory elements (intervals, chords, scales) with real sounds you hear. The benefits of mastering ear training include improved intonation and musical memory, confidence in improvisation or the ability to transcribe music more easily.
MyEarTraining makes ear training practice possible almost anywhere and anytime on the go, thus saving you from the hassle of assembling musical instruments. You can practically train your ears while waiting at the bus stand, traveling, or even at your coffee desk.
>> APP FOR ALL EXPERIENCE LEVELS
Whether you are new to music theory, need to prepare for an intensive school exam, or are an experienced musician, there are over 100 aural exercises to help you push your music skills. Users with no ear training experience begin with simple perfect intervals, major vs. minor chords and simple rhythms. Advanced users can progress through seventh chord inversions, complex chord progressions and exotic scale modes. You can use tonal exercises with solfeggio or singing exercises to improve your inner ear. Input answers using buttons or virtual piano keyboard. For major music topics, MyEarTraining offers different courses and lessons including basic music theory. Interval songs and practice piano are also included. 
>> COMPLETE EAR TRAINING
MyEarTraining app works by combining different ear training approaches like isolated sounds, singing exercises, and functional exercises (sounds in tonal context) to train your ears, thus maximizing results. It’s designed for musicians who want to improve their relative pitch recognition abilities and get one step further towards perfect pitch.
>> RECOMMENDED BY PROFESSIONALS
** Concept supported by Dr. Andreas Kissenbeck (University of performing Arts Munich)
** “The skill, knowledge and depth of the app is absolutely outstanding.” - Educational App Store
** “I truly recommend MyEarTraining to improve the ability to fully recognize intervals, rhythms, chords and harmonic progressions.” - Giuseppe Buscemi (classical guitarist)
** “#1 Ear Training App. MyEarTraining is an absolute necessity for anyone in the field of music.” - Fossbytes magazine”
>> TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
The app provides updated statistics to track your progress and can be easily synced to other devices. Use the statistics reports to see your strengths or weaknesses. 
>> ALL ESSENTIAL EXERCISE TYPES
- Intervals training - melodic or harmonic, ascending or descending, compound intervals (up to double octave)
- Chords training - including 7ths, 9ths, 11ths, inversions, open and close harmony
- Scales training - major, harmonic major, natural minor, melodic minor, harmonic minor, neapolitan scales, pentatonics... all scales including their modes (e.g. Lydian #5 or Locrian bb7)
- Melodies training - tonal or random melodies up to 10 notes
- Chord inversions training - identify inversion of a known chord
- Chord progressions training - random chord cadences or sequences
- Solfege/functional training - do, re, mi... as single notes or melodies in given tonal center
- Rhythm training - including dotted notes and rests in various time signatures
You can create and parametrize your own custom exercises or challenge yourself with exercises of the day.
>> SCHOOLS
Teachers can use the MyEarTraining app platform to assign exercises to students and control their progress. They can also design their own customized courses and implement student-specific syllabus to help them learn better. For more information visit https://www.myeartraining.net/

bluejetty:00080412:ios.description:
Dippy brings authentic AI friends and characters with tailored conversations just for you. Your AI friends know your likes, dislikes, interests, inner thoughts, and encourage you to be the best version of yourself. Immerse yourself in a creative journey with diverse AI personas, from crafting your ideal companion to immersive role-playing. 
Character Creation
Unleash your imagination—character creation is now open to everyone! Breathe life into any persona, whether inspired by reality or born from fantasy. Craft a character that remains your private secret or share it with a dynamic community of fellow creators. Dive into a vibrant ecosystem where you can interact with others’ characters and join a collective adventure that brings every creation to life!
Image Generation
Awaken your inner artist with our groundbreaking image generation feature, where AI meets limitless creativity. Simply input a prompt, and watch as our advanced technology transforms your vision into stunning art—whether it’s majestic landscapes, mystical fantasy realms, or ultra-realistic portraits. With no restrictions on how many images you can create, you’re free to experiment until you achieve your masterpiece. Perfect for seasoned artists and creative explorers alike!
Unlimited Free Messages
Enjoy conversations without boundaries—chat as long and as often as you like with your favorite characters or NPCs. With unlimited messaging, you can engage in endless dialogues completely free of charge, with no worries about time limits or message caps. Let your conversations flow freely!
BEST IN CLASS
• Experience the most engaging, empathetic, and fun chat immersion
• All your friends actively learn more about you and have perfect memory
• Cool illustrations that showcase their mood based on what they’re thinking
• Characters that feel alive and playful
IMMERSE YOURSELF
 Live out adventures with your AI as your ultimate companion. Explore fantasies, chat with a 24/7 friend for support, and redefine your connection with AI in ways you've never imagined. Be unhinged or wholesome!
  CUSTOMIZATION
 Fully customize your experience, choose from fifteen different colours and name your character whatever you want!
Download the free app! 
Please write to us at support@dippy.ai for any questions. Thanks for having Dippy on your Home Screen!  
Terms of Use: https://www.dippy.ai/terms 
Privacy Policy: https://www.dippy.ai/privacy

bluejetty:00062808:ios.description:
Songwriting, scales & music theory — built around the circle of fifths.
Tonaly helps you write songs, master scales, and finally make sense of music theory. Visual, interactive, and built for guitarists, pianists, producers, and every musician in between.
** #1 Music App in over 20 countries **
** Loved by 250.000+ musicians **
WRITE SONGS THAT WORK
Pick chords from the circle of fifths and combine them into songs that sound great. See how chords connect, change keys instantly, and export your ideas as MIDI to Ableton, Logic, or GarageBand.
LEARN SCALES VISUALLY
Master scales on guitar, piano, bass, ukulele, violin, viola, or cello — with left-hand mode. From major and minor to Dorian, Mixolydian, and 80+ additional scales.
UNDERSTAND MUSIC THEORY
See how keys, chords, and scales connect — instead of memorizing rules. Roman numerals, Nashville numbers, intervals, and chord structures, all explained visually.
FOR EVERY MUSICIAN
Whether you're starting out, finishing your first song, or teaching students — Tonaly adapts to your level and instrument.
KEY FEATURES
- Interactive circle of fifths
- 80+ scales and modes
- 7 instruments with multiple tunings
- MIDI and PDF leadsheet export
- Song templates (Pop, Jazz, Blues & more)
- Time signatures: 4/4, 3/4, 6/8, 7/8, 5/8
- Transposed playback for Bb and Eb instruments
- Color themes including a color blind theme
- German note names (H/B)
- iCloud sync
- Left-hand mode
START FREE
Tonaly offers a free trial – cancel anytime.

Terms of Service: https://tonaly.app/legal/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00129428:ios.name: Stellaris: Galaxy Command
bluejetty:00129428:ios.summary:
Stellaris, the bestselling Sci-Fi strategy game, is finally on your mobile!
The universe has barely survived an inter-dimensional invasion that devastated vast swaths of the galaxy. The United Nations of Earth requires your assistance and
bluejetty:00129428:ios.description:
Stellaris, the bestselling Sci-Fi strategy game, is finally on your mobile!
The universe has barely survived an inter-dimensional invasion that devastated vast swaths of the galaxy. The United Nations of Earth requires your assistance and contribution to rebuild galactic civilization. Take control of your own space station and set a course to distant stars! On your way, you will discover new mysteries in the depths of the universe!
Get ready to explore and discover a spectacular and real-time universe, where thousands of players play in a single galaxy with nearly a thousand star systems to explore! Construct your space station, form and join alliances to occupy regions of space together, trade with other players, build-up your own powerful fleet, and wage war against other players in the galaxy!
A new Stellaris experience, exclusive for mobile:
- Stellaris: Galaxy Command extends the Stellaris universe to mobile, putting space strategy and an epic Stellaris story in the palm of your hands.
- Galaxy Command is inspired by many of the features and mechanics of the PC game, with new trading systems, ethics, political systems, and more.
- With gorgeous visuals and aesthetics inspired by the PC game, fans of Stellaris will find familiar characters, graphics, and gameplay.
Forge Your Alliance:
- Work together with your teammates to build an empire.
- Occupy territories, build defensive structures, set tax rates for passing trades, sign trade deals, and even work collectively to colonize planets.
- Declare “cold” or conventional war and claim victory through economic strength or brute military force.
- Convene with allies to form an attack strategy, then wage war on other players across the universe.
Dominate Intergalactic Trade:
- As you progress, and needs of your population grow, their demand will begin to outpace their own ability to produce everything. You will have to specialize your production through research, which means that you will need to trade with one another to meet basic needs.
- Different sectors of space also contain unique and valuable resources—trade networks will naturally emerge, leading to alliances vying over lucrative territories.
- As a player, you can choose to be a pure trader and buy valuable products from afar and sell nearby for profit. You can also specialize in selling specific resources to earn a greater profit. Alternatively, you could simply use auto-trade to satisfy your basic consumption needs automatically.
Construct a Unique Station:
- Create and freely customize the structure of your station, construct unique buildings, and upgrade them.
Make Critical Decisions:
- Experience mysteries and uncover captivating stories through a familiar event chain system.
- Explore event chain systems capable of telling epic and meaningful stories that will influence your ultimate path.
- Many events reference or are a direct continuation of the event chains from the Stellaris PC game.
Design Your Own Fleet:
- Create and modify your fleet design with in-game ship design mode! Upgrade your fleet for maximum power!
- Join real-time battles and reinforce the fleets of your fellow alliance members.
- Recruit elite admirals to join your empire and lead your fleets to victory!
Features:
- Open world, strategy MMO based on a bestselling Sci-Fi strategy game
- Iconic Stellaris ships and mechanics
- Become a leader or member of an Alliance
- Control Trade Networks
- Customize your spaceships to upgrade power
- Battle with other players all over the galaxy
- Breathtaking sci-fi music
- Generous rewards for missions and quests
- Excellent 3D graphics and beautiful galaxies to explore
- This game is designed for mobile and is free to download.
Download Stellaris: Galaxy Command now and take part in the space opera now!
___________

http://www.gamebeartech.com/privacy-policy-20170516.html?searchText

bluejetty:00129171:ios.description:
Imagine . . . between the visible and the unseen is a guiding force that some call Spirit, the Holy Will, the Divine, the Field, or Consciousness. Using this oracle card app by Colette Baron-Reid will connect you to that larger Consciousness and guide you as you travel along on the journey of your life. 
The themes of the 54 cards in this app represent some of the places you’ll visit, the conditions you may encounter, and the allies and challengers you’ll meet as you navigate a metaphoric map of your life’s journey. 
The enclosed guidebook will help you ask the right questions and interpret the messages in your readings. The Enchanted Map Oracle Card app was created in order to empower you to understand the story of your fate, destiny, and free will; and allow you to chart a course to live a life of deep purpose, true prosperity, and vibrant love. 
Step into the Enchanted Map . . . and watch the magic come alive! 
FEATURES:
- Give readings anywhere, anytime
- Choose between different types of readings
- Save your readings to review at any time
- Email readings to friends
- Browse the entire deck of cards
- Flip cards over to read each card's meaning
- Get the most out of your deck with the guidebook
- Set a daily reminder for a reading
About the Author:
Colette Baron-Reid is a bestselling author, internationally acclaimed Oracle expert, spiritual intuitive, personal transformation thought leader, educator, speaker and host of “INSIDE THE WOONIVERSE”, a weekly podcast series that uncovers personal stories of spiritual awakening and transformation.
Author of 14 best-selling Oracle card decks with over 30 years of experience on global stages, television, radio and film, Colette’s greatest joy is teaching people they can have a direct and personal dialog with the Universe to help them create their best lives.

bluejetty:00171406:ios.summary:

Build your Event Archive
Create a record of every game, concert, and show you've attended, past and present. Our verified event databa
bluejetty:00171406:ios.description:
Momento is your home for live sports and music events. Capture, share, and relive your defining moments.
Build your Event Archive
Create a record of every game, concert, and show you've attended, past and present. Our verified event database spans 800+ sports leagues and over 3.5 million concert performances. Your timeline tells the full story.
Track what matters
Go beyond a simple list. Momento surfaces stats, milestones, and patterns that reveal how your fandom has grown — from your first show to your hundredth game.
Hold on to the Moment
Personalize and share Momentos — digital stubs that bring your event memories to life. Add your own photos, tag the friends you were with, and choose from a collection of Skins to change the look and feel of each Momento. Every Momento captures the details, context, and emotion of being there, turning a single event into a lasting piece of your fan journey
Flex your Fandom
Your profile is your fan identity — a visual showcase shaped by what you've actually experienced. Pick your favorite teams and artists, and let your real-life attendance speak for itself.
Explore the Community
Every event holds stories from many different perspectives. Community View lets you explore photos and videos from other fans who were at the same event, adding new layers to memories you already share.
Relive and Share
Turn memories into custom recaps you can keep or send to friends. Tag the people you were with, add your own photos, and extend the life of every experience.
Built for Real Fans
Momento is IRL-first—a community rooted in real attendance. Discover and connect with fans through the events you've actually been to, not just the ones you follow online.
You earned these moments. Keep them with Momento.

bluejetty:00157893:ios.description:
Lost your headphones? Can’t find your smartwatch? BlueScan: Bluetooth Finder helps you locate your nearby Bluetooth devices quickly and easily—before it’s too late.
Whether it’s your AirPods, fitness tracker, or a hidden smart tag, just launch BlueScan, scan nearby devices, and start moving. Signal strength bars help guide you toward your lost item.
BlueScan: Bluetooth Finder makes tracking effortless:
 • Scan for all Bluetooth devices nearby
 • Real-time signal strength to guide you
 • Device list with distance indicators
 • Rename devices to keep things organized
 • Works with AirPods, Fitbits, smartwatches & more
 • No account needed – fully offline
Avoid losing expensive gear. With BlueScan: Bluetooth Finder, peace of mind is just one tap away.
Using BlueScan Bluetooth Finder is simple:
1. I open the app and scan for nearby Bluetooth devices.
2. I select my lost device from the list.
3. I follow the signal strength to move closer.
4. Once I find it, I tap "I found it!" to confirm.
With BlueScan, I stop wasting time searching for lost gadgets and let the app guide me to them effortlessly.

bluejetty:00128246:ios.description:
The all new KFC Kuwait App is the fastest way to order your favorite KFC chicken online. Ordering food within a few clicks has never been so easy. Pick up the food or get it delivered at your doorstep, have food the way you like.
At KFC, we believe in real cooks, freshly-prepared good food and unrelenting quality control. Our aim is to take convenience to a whole new level and want you to have your favorite chicken options sitting at home.
*Get started and order in minimum steps: 
1. Download the app
2. Choose a preferred mode of language
3. Check your favorite items categorized as part of the menu
4. Add items to the cart
5. Log in to use Saved Addresses or continue as Guest
6. Choose a mode of ordering as pickup or delivery
7. Select location and provide a delivery address/pickup address
8. Proceed to checkout and make payment
9. Track your order and get it delivered as lightning fast delivery
10. Enjoy the food delivered at your doorstep. 
Why you should use KFC App:
*Pickup: 
When driving, pickup your delicious food from any nearest store by ordering from the application. 
*Car Hop:
100% Contactless and hassle-free experience. For our customers, we bring Car Hop service for contactless delivery in your car parked in our premises.
*Late night delivery: 
Late night hunger options. Look no further and simply order food online from KFC & we’ll rush to you with delicious chicken items even at 3 AM. This is available at select locations only.
*Social Login:
Why spent time in the login process when it can be done via social mode. Use your Google or Facebook or Apple account to login with ease.
*Hassle-free payments:
With multiple payment options (including Cash on Delivery, Online payments like Credit/Debit Cards etc.) at your fingertips, it’s now easier than ever to pay for your order. 
*Full KFC Menu: Order from the range of options - KFC Zinger box, Twister box, Mozzarella Burger Box, Meals, KFC buckets & more. Enjoy from a wide range of Chicken burgers, sandwiches, buckets & meals!
*Special Offers:
Coupons, Offers & deals customized only for you so that you can order more and get rewarded at times you order. 
*Have any feedback or queries?
KFC’s customer care is happy to help! Call us at - 1888666 or drop a mail to apps@americana-food.com
For more details, log into https://kuwait.kfc.me/

At KFC, we believe in real cooks, freshly-prepared good food and unrelenting quality control. Our aim is to take convenience to a whole new level and want you to have your favorite chicken options sitting at home.

*Get started and order in minimum steps: 

1. Download the app
2. Choose a preferred mode of language
3. Check your favorite items categorized as part of the menu
4. Add items to the cart
5. Log in to use Saved Addresses or continue as Guest
6. Choose a mode of ordering as pickup or delivery
7. Select location and provide a delivery address/pickup address
8. Proceed to checkout and make payment
9. Track your order and get it delivered as lightning fast delivery
10. Enjoy the food delivered at your doorstep. 

Why you should use KFC App:
*Pickup: 
When driving, pickup your delicious food from any nearest store by ordering from the application.   

*Car Hop:
100% Contactless and hassle-free experience. For our customers, we bring Car Hop service for contactless delivery in your car parked in our premises.

*Late night delivery: 
Late night hunger options. Look no further and simply order food online from KFC & we’ll rush to you with delicious chicken items even at 3 AM. This is available at select locations only.

*Social Login:
Why spent time in the login process when it can be done via social mode. Use your Google or Facebook or Apple account to login with ease.

*Hassle-free payments:
With multiple payment options (including Cash on Delivery, Online payments like Credit/Debit Cards etc.) at your fingertips, it’s now easier than ever to pay for your order. 

*Full KFC Menu: Order from the range of options - KFC Zinger box, Twister box, Mozzarella Burger Box, Meals, KFC buckets & more. Enjoy from a wide range of Chicken burgers, sandwiches, buckets & meals!


*Special Offers:
Coupons, Offers & deals customized only for you so that you can order more and get rewarded at times you order. 

*Have any feedback or queries?
KFC’s customer care is happy to help! Call us at - 1888666 or drop a mail to apps@americana-food.com
For more details, log into https://kuwait.kfc.me/

apple-macos:6786763922.name: Pixel Finance
apple-macos:6786763922.description:
Pixel Finance is a private way to track your whole financial life. Bank accounts, investments, crypto, property and debts all add up to one clear net worth figure, and all of it lives on your iPhone or iPad
There's no sign-up and no server behind the app. We couldn't see your data even if we wanted to, because it never leaves your phone.
TRACK EVERYTHING
• Accounts and cards from any bank, in any currency
• Investments with live prices, and crypto tracked from a public wallet address
• Property, vehicles and valuables, with mortgages and loans counted against them
• Transfers and debt payments that keep both accounts in step
BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
• Log a coffee in three taps
• Budgets that show where the month is heading while you can still do something about it
• Recurring transactions log themselves
• Spending insights: monthly pace, category trends, top merchants
• Proper multi-currency support. Keep GBP, SGD, USD, JPY and more side by side, with the exchange rate saved at the time of each purchase
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account, no cloud copy, no analytics, no ads, no trackers
• Face ID lock, plus a privacy shield in the app switcher
• Stealth mode hides every amount with one tap
• Export everything to CSV whenever you like. It's your data
PIXEL FINANCE PRO (optional subscription)
• Import bank and card statements as PDFs, read entirely on your device
• Scan paper receipts straight into transactions. Photos stay on your phone
• Sync between devices through a cloud folder you own (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, or your own server), end-to-end encrypted before anything is uploaded. We never see your folder or your key
• Unlimited accounts and budgets. The free version includes 10 of each
The only things the app ever fetches are public reference data like exchange rates, market prices and logos. Your ledger stays with you.
Terms of Use: https://pixelfinance.org/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pixelfinance.org/privacy
Questions? hello@pixelfinance.org

apple-macos:6761586100.name: Easy MP3 Player: Your Music
apple-macos:6761586100.description:
Easy MP3 Player is a music player for the songs you already own. Keep your own audio files in ordered playlists, and play them alongside your Apple Music library.
WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
1. Your own files and Apple Music, together
Add songs straight from your Apple Music library and put them in the same playlist as your own MP3 and WAV files. No more switching between two apps to hear the music you actually want.
(An Apple Music subscription is required for Apple Music tracks.)
2. Choose your folder once
Pick the folder that holds your music one time. From then on, your songs are waiting for you the moment you open the app — no digging through the Files app again. Register as many folders as you like, so it does not matter if your music is spread across several places.
3. Reorder with your finger
Press and hold a song, then drag it up or down to change the order. Remove a song you no longer want, right where you are.
4. A playlist for every moment
Create up to 10 playlists with names of your own — "Commute", "Focus", "Before Sleep". Switch between them with a tap, and playback keeps going.
5. A sleep timer that stops for you
Choose 15, 30, 45, 60, or 90 minutes. Playback stops on its own when the time is up.
ALSO INCLUDED
A 10-band equalizer to shape the sound the way you like it.
A vocal reducer (beta) that pulls the vocals back so you can play along or sing over the track.
Search your Apple Music library and drop those songs in next to your own.
Lock screen controls for play, pause, and skip — your music keeps going while you use other apps, even with the screen off.
PREMIUM FEATURES
A single purchase. Once you buy it, there is nothing further to pay.
What premium unlocks:
• All ads removed
• Export your playlists to a file
• Import playlists from a file
The exported file makes your playlists portable when you change devices. After importing, just point the app at the folder holding your music and everything is restored at once.
If you do not purchase:
Adding songs, playback, creating playlists, the equalizer, and the sleep timer are all free. Everything you need to listen to your music is included at no cost.
Restoring a purchase:
If you have bought premium before, open Settings and tap "Restore Purchase" to get it back at no charge. As long as you are signed in with the same Apple ID, it works on your new device with nothing more to pay.
About payment:
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account
• Premium features activate as soon as the purchase is confirmed
• All purchases are handled through Apple's in-app purchase system
PRIVACY AND TERMS
Privacy Policy
https://tenmais.jp/privacy.php
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
This app does not sell or share your personal information with outside parties. Please see the privacy policy above for details.
SUPPORT
Questions or requests are always welcome.
https://tenmais.jp/
This app is built by one person. Your feedback shapes what comes next.
May your favorite music always be close at hand.

firefox-addons:3137413.name: Toolars Developer Toolkit
firefox-addons:3137413.summary: A private side-panel toolkit for developers: convert, inspect, encode and generate text, colors and more. Offline, no account.
firefox-addons:3137413.description:
Toolars Developer Toolkit brings 31 offline developer, writing, design, and lightweight image utilities into Firefox’s sidebar, right beside the page you are working on. Inspect structured data, compare text changes, test patterns or schedules, preview color styles, or clean image metadata without switching tabs.
Open the sidebar from the toolbar or press Alt+Shift+Y. Paste content into the top search bar and Smart Paste detects its format automatically so you can open a matching utility in one click. You can also select text on any page and trigger a Toolars action from the right-click menu, then keep frequently used tools in your favorites.
For example, you can format a JSON payload to inspect nested values, convert a timestamp across time zones, or remove EXIF metadata from a local image before sharing it. Token inspection decodes JWT headers and payloads locally; it does not verify signatures or establish that claims are trustworthy.
All 31 bundled tools run locally in your browser and work offline with no account. The extension does not request site access or inject scripts into web pages, and it includes no analytics, advertising, or remote runtime code. Only favorites, recent tool identifiers, and display preferences stay on your device. Inputs and outputs stay in memory and are never saved as persistent history.
Optional website links open toolars.com only when you choose them for heavier document or batch workflows and never pass selected text, image addresses, or files in the URL. Free to use. Requires Firefox 128 or later. The default shortcut is Alt+Shift+Y and can be changed in Firefox’s extension shortcut settings.
